title: Senior Data Engineer Python AWS SQL
description:

As a Senior Data Engineer you will receive a competitive package:

  • Salary to £110k

Apply now to find out more about this Senior Data Engineer (Python AWS SQL) opportunity.

title: Director, IT & Business Enablement
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, IT & Business Enablement based in United States.

As Director, IT & Business Enablement, you will lead the systems, tools, and technology experience that enable a global workforce to operate effectively.
You will own the full lifecycle of the internal technology environment, from endpoint provisioning and SaaS management to identity systems and employee support.
A key part of the role is driving secure, practical AI adoption across internal workflows and technology systems to improve efficiency and return on investment.
You will balance reliability, security, usability, and business speed while continuously identifying opportunities for automation and optimization.
The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technology operations, vendor management, budgeting, and cross-functional partnership.
You will also build and develop a high-performing IT team while creating scalable processes, documentation, and support systems that act as force multipliers for the organization.

Accountabilities:

  • Own, build, and scale the IT infrastructure, systems, processes, and team responsible for supporting the technology needs of a global workforce.
  • Manage the complete employee technology experience, including new-hire equipment, IT onboarding, endpoint provisioning, application deployment, patching, asset management, and device retirement.
  • Hire, mentor, and develop IT team members while establishing the capabilities and operating practices needed to support evolving business requirements.
  • Administer identity and access management systems that provide secure and appropriate access to corporate applications, systems, and infrastructure.
  • Lead secure AI adoption across the organization by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI capabilities into internal systems and workflows, evaluating AI vendors, and continuously optimizing AI tooling for effectiveness and ROI.
  • Own the internal SaaS and technology stack, evaluating, selecting, consolidating, expanding, and optimizing tools to ensure teams have the right technology and are using it effectively.
  • Partner with finance on software and hardware budgets, vendor relationships, purchasing decisions, utilization, and cost optimization, translating technical choices into clear financial and ROI considerations.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive IT documentation, processes, support workflows, and internal training programs that improve adoption, consistency, and employee productivity.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in IT management, systems administration, technology operations, or a related discipline, including at least 5 years of experience leading and developing teams.
    • Proven experience managing endpoint lifecycles at scale, including provisioning, deployment, application management, patching, and retirement, ideally within a fully remote or hybrid-remote workforce.
    • Strong hands-on experience managing modern SaaS environments, including identity and access management, mobile or endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and other enterprise productivity tools.
    • Demonstrated ability to make thoughtful build-versus-buy and consolidate-versus-expand technology decisions based on business requirements, usability, security, and value.
    • Proven experience leading the adoption and integration of AI into business workflows, including deploying AI-powered support solutions, automating processes, evaluating AI vendors, and driving organization-wide adoption.
    • Experience managing software and hardware budgets and vendor relationships, with the ability to communicate technology investments, costs, utilization, and ROI to finance and senior leadership.
    • Strong track record of building IT documentation, operational processes, support systems, and scalable workflows from the ground up.
    • Excellent cross-functional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts and decisions for engineering teams, finance stakeholders, leadership, and non-technical employees.

      • Parental leave and mental health and wellness benefits.

title: Substitute Electrical Apprenticeship Instructor
description:
Substitute Electrical Apprenticeship Instructor

Location: Heber, UT

Status: Part-Time

Hours: Monday–Thursday; various hours

Pay/Salary: $31.00–$35.00

Summary

Are you passionate about helping others succeed in their careers? Do you have real-world industry experience and a passion for guiding the next generation of electrical professionals? At MTECH, we're looking for a dedicated, student-focused Substitute Electrical Apprenticeship Instructor to join our growing team. This is more than a teaching role—it's an opportunity to help students transform their lives, develop essential skills, and prepare for fulfilling careers in their chosen fields. By modeling industry standards and passion for the craft, you empower students with the knowledge, discipline, and confidence they need to build a successful career.

Why Work with Us?

Mountainland Technical College is committed to delivering high-quality, hands-on education that prepares students for successful employment. As part of our team, you'll be surrounded by professionals who are passionate about technical education and student success. You'll also benefit from:

  • Positive Work Culture: Be a part of a friendly, team-oriented environment where your contributions are valued.
  • Professional Growth: Receive an MTECH tuition waiver after three months (minimum hours may apply), opening doors to further your education and skills.

What You'll Do:

Responsibilities of the Substitute Electrical Apprenticeship Instructor include, but are not limited to:

  • Delivering engaging, hands-on instruction in both classroom and lab settings.
  • Supporting student growth through mentoring, regular feedback, and individualized success planning.
  • Ensuring your curriculum stays current and aligned with real industry expectations.
  • Partnering with fellow instructors, administrators, and industry leaders to maintain a high-quality learning experience.
  • Leading by example in professionalism, safety, and workplace readiness.
  • Demonstrating safety skills and the ability to use and maintain industry-related hand and power tools.
  • Interacting with high school students, parents, business and industry representatives, and the general public in a professional manner.

Your Impact Matters

You'll be a key part of helping students:

  • Master essential technical and professional skills.
  • Successfully complete their training.
  • Earn industry credentials or licensure.
  • Launch into meaningful employment in their field.

You won't just be teaching—you'll be shaping the futures of your students.

What We're Looking For:

We're seeking professionals who are passionate about teaching and committed to excellence. Successful candidates will have:

  • Education: A high school diploma or its equivalent.
  • Experience: A minimum of two years of experience in the Electrical industry.
  • Industry Credentials & Certifications: Must be a licensed Journeyman Electrician or have comparable skills and experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.) and Google Suite tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc.). Experience with Canvas and curriculum development is a plus.
  • Organizational Abilities: Strong skills in communication, time management, and organization to efficiently manage classroom and practical training responsibilities.
  • Attention to Detail: A keen ability to assess student performance, ensure industry standards are met, and maintain accurate records.

Ready to Apply?

By joining our team, you become a mentor, a role model, and a catalyst for change. Your experience and passion can launch new careers, ignite creativity, and build lasting confidence in every student you teach. Apply now and help shape the future, one student, one lesson, one career at a time. Make a difference at MTECH.

title: Data Pipeline Analyst
description:
Description

As a Data Pipeline Analyst, you will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and ensuring data is easily accessible for performance evaluation and decision‑making processes. You will work closely with data stewards, analysts, and other stakeholders to drive data‑driven initiatives and optimise our data infrastructure. The purpose of this role is to create and maintain Qlik Talend pipelines to allow the smooth transition of this data into the database by manipulating the data and performing checks on it to ensure that the data is accurate.

The Valpak Data Insights (VDI) department and Reverse Logistics Group (RLG) regularly receive data files from their customers systems with regards to Product and transactional data. This data is transformed and loaded into the existing databases using an inhouse built application. VDI will be migrating to the Qlik Talend ETL software on the customer files to load data into both existing databases and the new Data Streams system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate and consistently improve Qlik Talend pipelines
  • Create and maintain pipelines for each customer's data
  • Create a reusable toolkit of code for validation and transformations that can be used by other customers
  • Generate automated validation checks on the received data so that it can be handled more efficiently before loading into the database
  • Become an expert in using the Qlik Talend Studio software so that any data transformations requested by the business can be performed
  • Use Java to perform advanced manipulation of the data
  • Make sure that data is handled correctly by Qlik Talend and that poor data is not loaded into the Database
  • Use GitHub to allow source control of the created pipelines
  • Liaise with business to understand customer requirements, and to keep the business informed of pipeline progress
  • Provide feedback to users about the quality of the customers data

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Experience of using ETL software
  • Experience using Microsoft packages, including Excel
  • Knowledge of SQL
  • Knowledge of Java, Qlik Talend and GitHub (desirable)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Great attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities

Qualifications

  • Applicants should be educated to degree level or possess solid work experience in related field.

Job Benefits

  • Dual Location / Hybrid worker Status
  • Participation in our annual Incentive Plan (VIP) - up to 10% bonus
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, volunteering day and your birthday off!
  • Option to buy and sell up to 9 days annual leave
  • Access to voluntary benefits including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, and subsidised gym membership
  • Automatic inclusion in Life Assurance, Critical Illness and Disability Income protection schemes
  • Pension scheme up to 8% employer contribution
  • Access to reward & discount platform
  • Wellbeing initiatives

Job Details

  • Department: Technology
  • Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time
  • Location: Stratford-Upon-Avon
  • Reporting To: Adam Christopherson
  • Compensation: £29,500 - £40,000 / year

title: Teamkoordinatorer til Bostedet Neptunvej
description:
Teamkoordinatorer til Bostedet Neptunvej

Fagligt stærke teamkoordinatorer til Bostedet Neptunvej (3 stillinger)

Er du en erfaren fagprofessionel med lyst til at tage et større fagligt ansvar? Vil du være med til at sætte retning for den pædagogiske praksis og understøtte kolleger i hverdagen?

På Bostedet Neptunvej er vi i gang med en ambitiøs udviklingsrejse. Med afsæt i vores indsats Back to Basics styrker vi fokus på kerneopgaven, faglig kvalitet og sammenhængende indsats til borgerne. Derfor opretter vi nu tre nye stillinger som teamkoordinatorer.

Som teamkoordinator bliver du en central faglig nøgleperson, der skaber struktur, understøtter kollegernes arbejde og bidrager til, at faglige ambitioner omsættes til handling i hverdagen. Du får en rolle med stor indflydelse på den daglige praksis og et tæt samarbejde med afdelingslederen, kollegaer og de øvrige teamkoordinatorer.

Stillingen er samtidig en unik mulighed for dig, der er nysgerrig på at udvide dit ansvar og styrke din indflydelse på tværs af tilbuddet. Du får erfaring med koordinering, faglig sparring, implementering af indsatser og samarbejde på tværs. Rollen giver et stærkt fundament for videre udvikling og for at afprøve opgaver, der indebærer at skabe retning, engagement og resultater gennem andre.

Om Bostedet Neptunvej
Bostedet Neptunvej er et døgntilbud for voksne borgere med udviklingshandicap og betydelige støttebehov. Vi er en del af de døgndækkede botilbud i Center for Handicap og Botilbud, Randers Kommune.

Neptunvej består af 48 handicapvenlige lejligheder fordelt på tre arbejdsfællesskaber. Hvert arbejdsfællesskab rummer to teams, som tilsammen understøtter 16 borgere. Fremover tilknyttes én teamkoordinator til hvert arbejdsfællesskab.
Vi arbejder ud fra en tilgang, hvor borgernes livskvalitet, selvbestemmelse og individuelle behov er omdrejningspunktet for indsatsen. Neptunvej - Randers Kommune

Back to Basics – tættere på kerneopgaven
"Back to Basics" handler om at bringe fagligheden endnu tættere på borgerne og bruge mest mulig tid på det, der skaber værdi i deres hverdag.

Vi arbejder derfor målrettet med:
  • Styrket faglig kvalitet
  • Tydelig struktur og koordinering
  • Høj kvalitet i dokumentationen
  • Praksisnær faglig sparring
  • Tydelig sammenhæng mellem beslutninger, ansvar og handlinger
Som teamkoordinator bliver du en vigtig drivkraft i denne udvikling og får mulighed for at sætte et synligt fagligt aftryk på Neptunvejs fremtid.

Din rolle som teamkoordinator
Du bliver den daglige teamkoordinator i dit arbejdsfællesskab. Du har ikke personaleansvar, men du får et særligt ansvar for at skabe retning, koordinering og faglig kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:
  • Sikre overblik, koordinering og sammenhæng i arbejdsfællesskabets daglige opgaver
  • Understøtte den faglige retning og omsætte beslutninger til praksis
  • Være synlig i driften og tæt på både borgere og kollegaer
  • Yde faglig sparring i komplekse pædagogiske problemstillinger
  • Bidrage til implementering og forankring af faglige indsatser, herunder KRAP og LA2U
  • Understøtte arbejdet med Mit Liv - Min Plan og sikre lokal forankring "Mit liv – Min plan" – Den visuelle borgerplan - Randers Kommune
  • Bidrage til høj kvalitet i den faglige dokumentation
  • Introducere og understøtte nye medarbejdere
  • Bidrage til samarbejdet med pårørende og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • Medvirke til et arbejdsmiljø præget af refleksion, samarbejde og fælles ansvar
Funktionsbeskrivelse for Teamkoordinator

Hvem er du?
Vi søger en kollega, der tager ansvar for både opgaver og relationer og som bidrager til at skabe en tryg og udviklende hverdag med høj kvalitet. Du arbejder reflekteret, træffer velovervejede beslutninger og møder mennesker med engagement og respekt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og en stærk forståelse for arbejdet med mennesker
  • Har erfaring fra handicapområdet eller et andet specialiseret socialområde
  • Trives med koordinering og struktur i en kompleks hverdag

  • Er nysgerrig på egen- og andres praksis

Derfor skal du vælge Neptunvej
Hos os får du mulighed for at kombinere stærk pædagogisk praksis med en vigtig koordinerende funktion og blive en central del af den udvikling, som Neptunvej står midt i.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for at præge og udvikle teamkoordinatorrollen
  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede og kompetente kollegaer
  • Tæt samarbejde med afdelingsleder og øvrige teamkoordinatorer

  • Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling

Stillingerne er på 37 timer ugentligt. Arbejdstiden ligger overvejende i dagtimerne. You will design and develop specialized AI agents capable of coordinating complex workflows and making traceable decisions. The position combines software engineering, AI orchestration, system integration, and application security. You will work with technologies such as MCP, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and Azure OpenAI. title: Production Project Coordinator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Production Project Coordinator based in India.

This role keeps high-volume production orders moving accurately, efficiently, and on schedule from client approval through shipment and invoicing. You will coordinate multiple orders and vendors simultaneously, ensuring specifications, pricing, quantities, documentation, and deadlines are consistently aligned. Working closely with internal teams and external manufacturers, you will proactively identify risks and resolve issues before they affect clients. The position requires a project-management mindset, strong ownership, and persistent follow-through. You will also use AI tools to streamline order management, identify discrepancies, and improve operational efficiency. This is an opportunity to play a central role in a fast-paced production environment where organization, urgency, and attention to detail directly influence customer satisfaction.

Accountabilities:

  • Process newly approved orders promptly in the order management system and maintain accurate, up-to-date information across all open production orders.
  • Submit orders to the appropriate manufacturers and vendors, verifying specifications, quantities, pricing, and required ship dates before production begins.
  • Monitor the daily status of open orders, proactively identify delays, errors, and potential risks, and escalate issues early to the appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare and distribute daily production status reports that clearly identify orders that are on track, delayed, or require immediate attention.
  • Maintain a complete and accurate documentation trail for every order, including purchase orders, vendor proformas, invoices, shipping updates, tracking information, and shipping methods.
  • Review vendor invoices against purchase orders and proformas, coordinating with Finance to ensure invoices are accurate and vendor payments are processed correctly and on time.
  • Act as the primary day-to-day contact for vendors regarding order questions, changes, outstanding information, production updates, and follow-ups.
  • Use AI tools to manage high order volumes more effectively, including summarizing order status, identifying document discrepancies, and drafting vendor communications.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and recommend process improvements that reduce errors, prevent delays, and make production workflows more efficient.
  • Maintain clear next steps for outstanding and at-risk orders, ensuring assigned orders continue progressing without requiring repeated reminders or supervision.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in order management, production coordination, purchasing, or a comparable operational role.
    • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage dozens of simultaneous orders across multiple vendors while maintaining clear visibility into the status and next steps of each order.
    • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify issues such as incorrect quantities, pricing discrepancies, missing documentation, or inconsistencies between purchase orders and vendor proformas.
    • A strong ownership mindset focused on keeping orders accurate and moving forward rather than simply updating their status, with a commitment to documentation, follow-up, and timely escalation.
    • Strong sense of urgency, responsiveness, and follow-through, with the ability to pursue outstanding information and prevent orders from becoming idle due to unresolved questions.
    • Sound judgment when balancing competing deadlines, including the ability to prioritize effectively, resolve routine issues independently, and escalate more complex matters when appropriate.
    • Ability to work proactively and independently, meet commitments, close open items, and maintain accountability without constant supervision.
    • Comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work, with an interest in applying technology to improve productivity, identify errors, and manage large volumes of information.
    • Strong written communication skills for clear, professional, and persistent communication with vendors and internal stakeholders.
    • Ability to learn new software and systems quickly, with training provided on the proprietary order management platform.
    • Experience with Finance or Accounts Payable, including invoice matching, vendor payments, or account reconciliation, is an advantage.
    • Experience working with manufacturers, particularly overseas or multi-vendor production environments, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with shipping methods, freight processes, and tracking logistics is desirable.
    • Willingness to work US business hours as required by the role.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote position for candidates based in India.
      • Opportunity to work in a high-volume, fast-paced production and order management environment.
      • Hands-on exposure to order management, purchasing, vendor coordination, production tracking, shipping, invoicing, and finance processes.
      • Opportunity to work with multiple manufacturers and vendors across complex production workflows.
      • Practical experience using AI tools to improve operational efficiency, automate routine work, and identify potential errors.
      • Training provided on the proprietary order management system.
      • Opportunity to contribute directly to process improvements and build more scalable and efficient operational workflows.
      • High level of ownership and autonomy, with responsibility for driving assigned orders forward from approval through shipment and payment.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) based in Brazil.

This role is ideal for an SDET who sees quality as a fundamental part of software engineering, rather than a final step before release.
You will shape testing standards, automation practices, and quality strategies across products and services.
The position combines strong software development with hands-on expertise in automation, APIs, distributed systems, and end-to-end testing.
You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
Your work will help teams release quickly while maintaining software that is reliable, secure, performant, and resilient.
You will have the opportunity to build and evolve automation frameworks, improve CI/CD integration, and strengthen regression coverage.
This is a collaborative, fast-paced environment suited to a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys challenging assumptions and improving how software is built.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, either from scratch or by extending existing solutions, while ensuring they remain scalable, reusable, and maintainable.
  • Define and uphold test quality standards and contribute to the overall testing strategy for one or more products or services, ensuring consistency and confidence throughout the release process.
  • Develop high-quality integration and end-to-end automated tests that meet production engineering standards, alongside reusable test utilities, mocks, and simulators.
  • Drive automated testing across contract, smoke, regression, and end-to-end scenarios, integrating frameworks effectively into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own the structure, health, and relevance of test suites and regression packs, continuously improving coverage while keeping them lean and valuable.
  • Test front-end, back-end, API, and distributed microservice environments using modern tools and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Postman, and RestAssured.
  • Plan and coordinate performance testing using tools such as K6 and JMeter, helping ensure systems meet expected performance and resilience standards.
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, delivery leads, and other cross-functional stakeholders to embed quality from the beginning of the SDLC and ensure cross-team functionality is properly tested.
  • Participate throughout the testing lifecycle, including exploratory and manual QA activities, issue investigation, change validation, and release sign-off.
  • Investigate defects and production issues, identify root causes, and ensure fixes are properly validated through automated testing.
  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement by challenging existing approaches, identifying opportunities to optimize automation, and helping engineering teams adopt stronger quality practices.

    • Requirements:

    • 4+ years of professional experience in test automation, with strong hands-on expertise in building and maintaining automation frameworks and API testing solutions rather than simply executing predefined tests.
    • Strong proficiency in writing automated tests using TypeScript and solid experience designing and executing end-to-end testing strategies within Agile delivery environments.
    • Demonstrated ability to embed quality early in the SDLC through close collaboration with Product Managers, Engineers, Principal Engineers, Delivery Managers, and other stakeholders.
    • Experience working within Agile continuous delivery teams, including coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to assess, prioritize, and resolve defects based on reproducibility, business impact, and release scope.
    • Strong understanding of software quality principles, automation optimization, and continuous improvement, combined with a proactive approach to identifying better ways of working.
    • A critical and analytical mindset, with curiosity and rigor when investigating failures, uncovering root causes, and evaluating test outcomes.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the confidence to constructively challenge technical and product decisions when necessary to protect software quality.
    • Adaptability and ownership, with the ability to manage changing priorities in fast-paced environments while taking responsibility for the health of QA processes and overall quality outcomes.
    • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader product, business, and user objectives, along with a willingness to continuously learn as systems and technologies evolve.
    • A degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is desirable.
    • Certifications such as CSTAE, ASTQB ISTQB Advanced, or recognized automation testing certifications in technologies such as Cypress or Playwright are desirable.
    • Familiarity with pipeline and event-driven architectures, including technologies such as Kafka, AWS EventBridge, AWS Step Functions, queues, streams, or SnapLogic, is an advantage.

title: SOSU elever med start på Grundforløb 2 januar 2027
description:
Møder du mennesker med respekt, og har du lyst til at hjælpe andre? Er du klar til at starte uddannelse og få løn under hele uddannelsen? – så er det nu, du skal slå til!

Lolland Kommune søger engagerede og uddannelsesparate elever til Social- og Sundhedshjælperuddannelsen eller Social- og Sundhedsassistentuddannelsen med opstart på Grundforløb 2 den 19. januar 2027.

Du kan starte på GF2 i enten Nakskov eller Nykøbing Falster.

Som SOSU-elev bliver du en del af et fagområde, hvor omsorg, faglighed og menneskelige relationer går hånd i hånd. Du lærer at støtte mennesker med fysiske, psykiske og sociale udfordringer og bliver uddannet til at skabe tryghed, livskvalitet og værdighed i hverdagen.

Læs om SSH uddannelsen her (www.sosunyk.dk)

Læs om SSA uddannelsen her (www.sosunyk.dk)

Som SOSU-elev i Lolland Kommune får du:
  • Løn under hele uddannelsen
  • Garanti for oplæringsplads
  • En hverdag med både skole og praksis
  • Faglig og personlig udvikling gennem uddannelsen
  • Gode job- og karrieremuligheder efter uddannelsen

Kan du?
  • Være motiveret og tage ansvar for din uddannelse
  • Møde andre mennesker med respekt
  • Samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker
  • Være mødestabil og engageret
  • Have lyst til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt
SÅ ER DET DIG, VI SØGER! Er du klar?

Uanset om du er på vej ind på arbejdsmarkedet, kommer fra en gymnasial uddannelse, har haft sabbatår, allerede har erfaring fra arbejdsmarkedet eller ønsker et karriereskifte, kan en SOSU-uddannelse være starten på noget nyt.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvad du har lavet før – men at du har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker og er klar til at lære.

SÅ SEND OS EN ANSØGNING!

Optagelseskrav:
  • Bestået dansk og matematik på minimum 9. klasses niveau med karakteren 02 (medsend dokumentation)
  • Gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse, hvis du ikke er dansk statsborger (medbringes til evt. samtale)
  • Har du afsluttet folkeskolen indenfor de sidste 2 år, skal du have bestået GF1.
Grundforløb 2 varer som udgangspunkt 20 uger.

Har du gennemført en af nedenstående uddannelser, vil dit forløb blive forkortet:
  • STX, HTX, HHX, HF eller EUX → 8 ugers GF2.
  • GF2 PA → 4 ugers GF2.
Når du har bestået Grundforløb 2, fortsætter du på hovedforløbet mod enten social- og sundhedshjælper (SSH) eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA).


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn efter gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Du bliver ansat på 37 timer pr. uge.
  • Er du under 25 år, får du elevløn. SSH elevløn svarende til kr. 14.250 pr. måned. SSA elevløn svarende til kr. 15.740 pr. måned.
  • Er du fyldt 25 år, kan du være berettiget til voksenelevløn efter gældende regler svarende til kr. 24.991 pr. måned.
Vi gør opmærksom på at der indhentes straffeattest på de personer der tilbydes stillingen.


Er du klar til at tage første skridt?

Din ansøgning skal indeholde:
  • En personlig og motiveret ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, og hvorfor du ønsker at uddanne dig indenfor SOSU-faget
  • CV, hvor du oplyser, hvad du evt. har af uddannelse og tidligere arbejdserfaring
  • Evt. udtalelser fra arbejdsgivere

Send din ansøgning, dit CV og relevante bilag senest den 1. november 2026. Vi glæder os til at høre, hvorfor netop du ønsker at blive SOSU-elev. Måske er det her, din fremtid begynder.

Har du spørgsmål?

Kontakt SSH/SSA-uddannelsesgruppen på:
sosu@lolland.dk

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Dadeland - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Community Health Aide West Region $5,000 Sign On Bonus
description:
About Company:

Bristol Bay Area Health Corporation (BBAHC) is a tribally operated nonprofit health system providing high‑quality, culturally responsive care in Bristol Bay. BBAHC offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and the chance to live and work in one of Alaska’s most unique and beautiful regions. At BBAHC, employees don’t just have jobs they have meaningful careers. Our team members play a vital role in making a measurable difference in rural healthcare while working in a collaborative, mission‑driven environment. We value integrity, compassion, teamwork, and respect for Alaska Native cultures and traditions.

Whether you’re early in your career or an experienced professional seeking purpose‑driven work, BBAHC provides an opportunity to grow while serving a close‑knit community.

Join us and be part of a team where your work truly matters.

About the Role:

The Community Health Aide plays a vital role in improving public health outcomes by providing direct support and education to diverse communities. This position focuses on bridging gaps between healthcare providers and community members, ensuring access to essential health services and resources. The role involves conducting outreach, facilitating health screenings, and promoting preventive care initiatives tailored to the unique needs of the population. The Community Health Aide collaborates closely with healthcare professionals, local organizations, and government agencies to implement effective health programs. Ultimately, this position aims to empower individuals and families to make informed health decisions, contributing to the overall well-being and resilience of the community.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required or TABE Level D (8th‑grade reading & math)
  • Experience working in community health, social services, or a related environment.
  • Basic knowledge of public health principles and community outreach strategies.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with diverse populations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Resides in assigned community or sub region.
  • Able to provide year-round coverage of clinic hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification as a Community Health Worker (CHW) or similar credential.
  • Associate degree in health sciences or related field.
  • Experience working with underserved or vulnerable populations.
  • Proficiency in multiple languages commonly spoken in the community served.
  • Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR) and data collection tools.
  • Training in cultural competency and health education methodologies.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct community outreach to educate residents about available health services and preventive care.
  • Assist in organizing and facilitating health screenings, immunization drives, and wellness workshops.
  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and community members to improve communication and service delivery.
  • Collect and report data on community health trends to support program development and evaluation.
  • Provide culturally sensitive support and guidance to individuals seeking healthcare resources.
  • Collaborate with local organizations and public health agencies to coordinate health promotion activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activities and participant interactions.
  • Identify barriers to healthcare access within the community and propose actionable solutions.

Skills:

The required skills enable the Community Health Aide to effectively communicate health information and build trust within diverse communities, ensuring outreach efforts are impactful and inclusive. Strong interpersonal skills facilitate collaboration with healthcare providers and community organizations, enhancing program coordination and service delivery. Analytical skills are used daily to collect, interpret, and report health data that inform program improvements and resource allocation. Preferred skills such as multilingual abilities and cultural competency allow the aid to overcome language and cultural barriers, increasing accessibility and engagement. Proficiency with digital tools supports efficient documentation and tracking of community interactions, contributing to data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement of health initiatives.

Working Conditions:

Work hours may vary from part‑time to full‑time based on training level, training requirements, and established clinic hours. The CHA primarily works in an assigned village clinic and consults with a referral physician or supervising healthcare provider via radio, telephone, fax, telemedicine, or email. The position requires sufficient vision, hearing, manual dexterity, mobility, health, and strength to perform frequent handwriting and data entry; use of medical equipment and electronic communication devices; repetitive hand and arm movements; frequent travel by unpressurized aircraft, private vehicles, small boats, snowmachines, or all‑terrain vehicles in all weather conditions; frequent light physical activity (lifting, pushing, pulling up to 20 pounds) and occasional moderate to heavy lifting (20–50 pounds or more); exposure to infectious diseases, blood, bodily fluids, and hazardous situations; and occasional provision of emergency care outside the clinic, including in patients’ homes or outdoor environments in all weather conditions.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Portugal.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.
    • Strong understanding of sound and rhythm, with the ability to intentionally integrate audio and motion to strengthen the overall creative experience.
    • Comfortable working directly from product UI and collaborating with product designers and other technical or creative stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to advocate for creative decisions, explain the reasoning behind them, and proactively influence projects.
    • Experience experimenting with AI-powered creative and video tools, with genuine curiosity about how emerging technology can improve creative workflows and production.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and taking initiative without requiring fully defined briefs or processes.
    • Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external creative partners.
    • Education is not required; practical experience, creative ability, and demonstrated expertise through your portfolio are valued.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment within the eligible EMEA region.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility motion projects spanning product, brand, web, social, campaigns, and events.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy within a small, collaborative creative team.
      • Opportunity to shape and establish a distinctive motion design system and influence how motion is produced across the broader organization.
      • Exposure to emerging AI and creative technologies as part of everyday design and production workflows.
      • Opportunities to build scalable systems, templates, and tooling that expand your impact beyond individual projects.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Typescript)
description:
About Alaffia & Our Mission


Every year, U.S. health plans lose billions to improper payments and administrative waste. That wasted spending ultimately trickles down across the healthcare ecosystem, driving up costs for plans, providers, and patients alike. We’re here to change that paradigm.


Alaffia is a new kind of claims operations partner for health plans. Using expert clinicians and transparent AI, we deliver deeper insights, smarter automation, and consistently better outcomes across the entire lifecycle of claims. With Alaffia, health plans can cut wasted spending more effectively than ever — and provide their members the most affordable care.


We’re a high-growth, venture-backed Series B healthtech startup based in NYC and are actively scaling our company. Join us in helping to build a healthcare system that works better for everyone.


*This position requires current authorization to work in the United States. Unfortunately, we are not in a position to sponsor work visas at this time.


About the Role & What You'll Be Doing


Alaffia is a healthcare AI startup revolutionizing health and data automation. Our AI-driven platform leverages state-of-the-art generative AI and machine learning technologies to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and compliance in medical billing and auditing. As we scale, we are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to build the cutting‑edge AI solutions, drive innovation, and shape the future of healthcare automation.


We are looking for a talented full stack engineer who is passionate about building modern web applications and scalable systems. Our platform leverages cutting‑edge technologies to revolutionize healthcare administration workflow. We seek someone who thrives on solving complex frontend and backend challenges, from crafting intuitive user interfaces to designing robust API architectures. You will have the opportunity to work with Typescript, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL and latest cutting edge AI technologies while implementing features that directly impact healthcare organizations. In this role, you'll be building the future of healthcare automation while tackling challenging problems in web development, system design, and cloud infrastructure.


Key Skills & Qualifications


Code Fluency

  • Write code that captures the essential nature of the solution and is appropriately flexible, reusable, efficient, and adaptable to changing requirements.


  • Provide high quality code review feedback and adopt approaches to foster effective and collaborative code review culture.


  • Strong awareness of the technologies used by the team and the ecosystem around these technologies and able to introduce new ideas to solve business and technical problems.


  • Responsible for successful delivery of their projects, including planning, risk management, design, development, testing, rollout, and maintenance.


  • Identify ways to simplify application code/infrastructure and improve developer efficiency as measured by cycle time, ramp‑up time, or other similar measurements.


  • Experience with enterprise codebases and the ability to onboard into an established product.


  • Preemptively identify and resolve technical risks before they jeopardize the project. Resolve cross‑team dependencies earlier to ensure the successful execution of the project.


  • Avoid re‑inventing the wheel by leveraging other Alaffia Health solutions or off‑the‑shelf solutions with the possible trade‑off in mind.



Software Design

  • Responsible for designing the software or systems in the owned area and ensuring that they meet their design objectives.


  • Give quality feedback on designs written by other members of the team, asking probing, insightful questions that solidify choices and surface erroneous assumptions.


  • Effectively and quickly debug cross‑module issues, and may intuit where bugs might lie due to deep knowledge of the libraries, platforms, and systems that the software relies on.



Architecture Design

  • Create coherent designs with multiple components interacting across API or system boundaries; bugs do not creep in at the boundaries between components due to mismatches in expectations of what is technically feasible.


  • Capable of rolling out a component or major feature (and deprecating an existing system or feature) reliably - including appropriate monitoring, paging, etc are in place, and that failure domains are understood and characterized appropriately, avoid introducing toil and future maintenance work by proactively avoiding scaling issues and providing adequate documentation before large scale rollout. For early stage products, roll out with an eye toward achieving learning goals untainted by poor quality and know when to make appropriate tradeoffs for “failing fast”.


  • Design clear success metrics and achieve those metrics consistently post‑launch through the lifetime of the system or feature. For early stage products, those success metrics may be oriented around learning goals rather than usage goals, given the inherent unpredictability of achieving product/market fit.



Business Acumen

  • Engage in listening sessions to increase learning to guide work/priorities


  • Have a working knowledge of Alaffia Health’s strategy and organization structure to work effectively across the org and able to help other engineers to effectively collaborate effectively



What We're Looking For



  • Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and deploying fullstack applications using Typescript, Node, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, React and Next.js in a production environment.


  • Experience building SasS in the healthcare sector


  • 5+ years industry experience with large scale system


  • Building and deploying user facing AI products


  • Experience with DevOps and cloud providers, such as AWS, Azure, and GCP


  • Hands on experience with Postgres databases and data model design.


  • Implementing robust testing suites to verify the correctness of new and existing features using testing frameworks


  • Developing observability frameworks that include logging and user activity metrics to integrate with Datadog and other observability tooling


  • Leading and engaging in architectural decisions that enable scalability, maintainability and extensibility to support business growth and user needs


  • Autonomous learning, self‑leadership, and the ability to own system components while collaborating with other SME’s


  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.



Our Culture


Alaffia was born out of our founders’ personal connection to the inefficiency of the U.S. healthcare system. We are deeply mission‑driven, with an abiding belief that technology can help create a better future for everyone —and we’re looking for others who share our passion for change to join the team.


What Else Do You Get?



  • Competitive compensation package (cash + equity)


  • Medical, Dental and Vision benefits


  • Flexible, paid vacation policy


  • Work in a flat organizational structure — direct access to Leadership

title: 3rd Shift Group Lead.
description:

A Group Lead will provide support to daily warehouse operations and system processes. A Group Lead is responsible for effectively planning and coordinating workflow for assigned area.   • Strong attention to detail.

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle
  • Life insurance
  • Short/long-term disability coverage
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment such as a protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced. The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

    • 5+ years of professional experience working as a power systems engineer, with substantial experience in bulk power system analysis and modeling.
    • Demonstrated experience with ERCOT Model Quality Test or an equivalent modeling validation process, as well as familiarity with IEEE 2800 and NERC MOD-026-2.
    • Strong experience performing power system impact studies, including steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamic stability analysis.
    • Hands-on proficiency with power system simulation software such as PSCAD and PSS®E.

title: Component and Reliability Engineer
description:
Hey there, Electronics Component & Reliability Engineer! At Quantic Wenzel, we're not your ordinary electronics engineering and manufacturing company. We're the kind of place where "Dream Big, Have Fun, Get Stuff Done" isn't just a slogan; it's the way we roll. What does that mean? It means we want you to unleash your superhuman intelligence, help us push boundaries, take calculated risks, and make a real impact on the future of mission-critical electronics. Plus, you get to do all of this in a people-first environment filled with passionate, innovative, and committed colleagues.

So, if you're ready to take your career to new heights (literally, we are talking rocket science here), keep reading!


Responsibilities:


Collaborative Parts Requirement Definition


Work closely with business development, program management, and engineering team during quoting phases to determine parts requirements and estimate associated costs


Perform detailed reliability and performance analyses when customer specifications are incomplete or unclear.


Testing and Data Analysis for Space Components


Coordinate and oversee testing of parts for Total Ionizing Dose (TID), as well as low and high dose rate testing, to gather critical data on their performance and reliability in space environments.


Cross-functional Coordination


Partner with program managers, planners, and design engineers to ensure integration and fulfillment of customer parts requirements, ensuring compliance with performance standards and timelines.


Root Cause and Failure Analysis


Lead failure analysis and root cause investigations for parts-related issues to identify underlying causes.


Implement effective corrective actions for problem resolution and continuous improvement.


Vendor and Supply Chain Collaboration


Collaborate with program management, engineering, vendors, and purchasing teams to guarantee that all parts meet customer and Wenzel reliability standards and requirements.


Qualification and Certification of Components


Lead the qualification process for critical electronic components used in space applications, ensuring they meet NASA and MIL-STD standards for performance, reliability, and safety.


Radiation Hardness Analysis


Conduct radiation hardness assessments for space components.


Determine the appropriate radiation tolerance and performance requirements to meet customer needs in space environments.


Electrical Parts Stress Analysis


Perform Electrical Parts Stress Analysis (EPSA) to evaluate and ensure the reliability of electronic components


Verify that the parts meet the defined customer specifications under various operational conditions.


Worst Case Analysis (WCA)


Conduct WCA to simulate the most extreme operating conditions and ensure the reliability of products across the entire lifespan of the program, identifying potential risks and design weaknesses.


Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)


Lead FMECA to systematically identify potential failure modes, evaluate their impacts on system performance.


Prioritize risk mitigation efforts to enhance system reliability and safety.


Reliability Metrics and Predictive Analysis


Perform MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) and MTTF (Mean Time To Failure) analyses.


Provide critical reliability metrics to ensure product longevity and mission success over the expected lifecycle of space programs or aerospace applications.


Thermal and Structural Analysis


Conduct thermal and structural analyses to assess the robustness of designs under extreme temperature, mechanical, and environmental conditions.


Ensure components can withstand launch, in-orbit operations, and mission-specific stresses.


Other Analysis


Conduct specialized analyses as needed for high-reliability program development.


Prepare detailed reports to demonstrate compliance with customer requirements.


Examples include Salt-Fog Testing, Fungal Growth Compliance, Aging Analysis, Product Life Testing, and other relevant assessments.

title: AI R&D Intern (IO)
description:

Key Responsibilities

Under the guidance of our data scientists, you will be involved in the full process of developing and deploying a machine learning-powered system:

  • Predictive Modeling: Develop and evaluate advanced machine learning regression models for demand forecasting.

  • Optimization Engine Development: Design and implement the core constraint optimization logic, leveraging frameworks like Google OR-TOols or similar solvers to balance inventory costs, service levels, and operational constraints across 25,000+ stores.

  • Data Pipeline: Perform large-scale dataset preparation, cleaning, and feature engineering on real-world retail data.

  • Proficiency in Python and strong experience with scientific computing packages (e.g., Pandas, Numpy, SciPy).

  • Knowledge and experience in training and evaluating common ML regression models.

  • Proficiency in Git version control system.

  • Problem-solving aptitude, inquisitive mindset, and passion in data & AI/ML.

Highly Desirable

  • Knowledge/experience in constraint optimization and optimization techniques (e.g., linear programming, mixed-integer programming).

  • Familiarity with optimization solvers, particularly Google OR-Tools is highly preferred.

  • Knowledge/experience in deep learning or clustering algorithms.

  • Experience with high-performance data manipulation tools (e.g., Polars) or out-of-memory distributed computing (e.g., Dask).

  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly GCP.

title: Applied AI Research Engineer

  • Collaborate closely with AI research teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate technical concepts into practical, reusable solutions and assets.

    • Strong software engineering capabilities with demonstrated experience building reliable, maintainable, and reusable AI or software systems.
    • Hands-on experience developing agentic systems, reinforcement learning environments, LLM pipelines, or comparable AI applications.

title: Trial Administrator - Cancer Research UK Clinical Trials Unit - 106441 - Grade 5
description:
Position Details

Cancer Clinical Trials Unit, School of Medical Sciences, College of Medicine and Health

University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Full time starting salary is normally in the range £30,062 to £31,900, with potential progression once in post to £35,883

Grade: 5

Closing date: 19th October 2026

There are 2 positions available: Full time, Fixed term contract until June 2027 & Part time, Fixed term contract (0.5 FTE) until October 2027

Our offer to you

People are at the heart of what we are and do.

The University of Birmingham is proud to have been a part of the City of Birmingham and the wider region for over 100 years, and we are equally proud to be recognised as a leading global university. We want to attract talented people from across the city and beyond, support them to succeed, and celebrate their success.

We are committed to helping the people who work here to develop through our sector-leading Birmingham Professional programme which provides all professional services staff with development opportunities and the encouragement to reach their full potential. With almost 5,000 professional services jobs in a wide-range of functions in Edgbaston and in our campus in Dubai, there are plenty of opportunities for you to be able to develop your career at the University.

We believe there is no such thing as a typical member of staff and that diversity is a source of strength that underpins the exchange of ideas, innovation, and debate. We warmly welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diversity is at the heart of who and what we are, and how we work.

Supporting our people to achieve a healthy work/life balance is important both to our employees and to the success of the University and, depending on the role, we offer a variety of flexible working arrangements. We therefore welcome discussions on all forms of flexible working. In addition, you will receive a generous package of benefits including 40 days paid holiday a year, one paid day a year for volunteering, occupational sick pay, and a pension scheme. We also have three high quality subsidised day nurseries.

The University is situated in leafy Edgbaston and there are excellent transport links to our beautiful campus, including main bus routes and a train station on site. On campus we have a state-of-the-art sports centre with pool, shops, places to eat and drink, our own art gallery, museum and botanical gardens.

Find out more about the benefits of working for the University of Birmingham

Role Summary

Trial Administrators are responsible for the administration and collection of clinical research data for one or more cancer trial protocols. They provide secretariat services to multi-disciplinary collaborative research group(s) engaged in clinical trials designed to improve the treatment and care of patients with cancer. Post holders work closely with the Trial Coordinator, ensuring the smooth process of trial administration, whilst providing support to colleagues, both inside and outside the unit, and give day to day operational guidance to Data Managers.

Main Duties

  • Ensure smooth day-to-day running of the study protocol and data collection. This will involve the postholder ensuring he/she has a good understanding of how the general concepts underlying the design, conduct and analysis of clinical trials apply to routine trial management procedures and also how the clinical background and specific research questions being addressed applies to trial administration and data management.
  • Responsible for ensuring that trial data set(s) are complete, accurate and up to date. This will be achieved by running queries to interrogate trial databases and performing regular, systematic checks of information on the database(s) and taking steps to correct any missing, contradictory or incorrect data. In addition the postholder will produce reports and lists on both a regular and ad-hoc basis.
  • Maintain research & administrative databases to produce clean data sets for statistical analysis. This will involve the management of medical data and operation of complex database and information systems in order to code and abstract medical data and routine data entry.
  • Record and code incoming forms etc, checking for inconsistencies, violations and unusual or adverse events. Maintain and circulate coding lists under the guidance of the Statistician, Trial Coordinator and Programmer.
  • Offer initial guidance on interpretation and the development of new codes for non-routine and ad-hoc data.
  • Test data entry, validation and report generation applications (i.e. confirming proper functioning of the trial database systems), reporting errors and suggesting modifications as appropriate. This will also involve creating and testing ad-hoc data bases, forms and report generation.
  • Trial management includes general clerical duties by organising collaborative group meetings, handling petty cash, day to day distribution of trial materials, and drug supplies required by external centres.
  • Preparation and distribution of study documentation and publicity material for the Trial Working Group.
  • Conduct literature searches, using initiative to find missing or inaccurate references and to screen suitable papers. Maintain bibliographic databases by entering data, run duplicate checks and produce reference lists.
  • Develop and document the standard operating procedures applicable to the work of the post, under the guidance of the Trial Coordinator. Train others in their use.
  • Will be expected to consult with the Trial Coordinator when dealing with complex queries, for example offering guidance regarding Serious Adverse Event reporting.
  • Continue to develop and expand trial management skills and experience.
  • Will cover for the Trial coordinator/ project leader and help supervise junior team members.
  • Any other duties as may be required commensurate with the post.
  • Supporting the delivery of clinical research in accordance with the principles of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), the Declaration of Helsinki, applicable legislation (including, but not limited to, the Medicines for Human Use Clinical Trials Regulations, General Data Protection Regulations, Human Tissue Act), the UK Policy Framework for Health and Social Care, Caldicott principles, and applicable NHS Trust and University policies and procedures, (including, but not limited to the University’s Data Protection Policy, Information Security Policy and Code of Practice for Research) in order to protect the research participants and the quality of each study.
  • Other relevant criteria from our equality and diversity knowledge, skills and experience document.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications, Experience

  • A degree (or equivalent) in a relevant biomedical or associated subject, and be able to demonstrate relevant work experience e.g. in clinical trial management or as a clinical research nurse. (May have been obtained during the degree course).
  • An aptitude for large and/ or more complex relational databases (MS Access or SQL Server preferred), including query/report writing and a full range of data verification, cleaning techniques.
  • Experience of using statistics packages such as SPSS, Minitab, BMDP or SAS is desired.
  • Excellent all-round office management and clerical skills must include up-to date computing and office automation skills (e.g. email, excellent word processing & document layout, the use of mail merge etc).
  • Must demonstrate a critical and intelligent attention to detail, high standards of accuracy and apply a sound knowledge of the research framework to the work.
  • Aptitude for learning and applying new skills to ensure effective support and where necessary cover for the Trial Coordinator in order to help supervise junior team members.
  • Experience of conducting literature or internet searches, finding missing or inaccurate information, and maintenance of bibliographic databases.
  • Ability to interact as a team member, as well as working independently, deciding own short-term priorities and timetabling of tasks to meet agreed deadlines.
  • Good communication and an excellent telephone manner.
  • Maintains regular contact with professional research staff and members of the collaborating group. Handles routine communications (on own initiative) with the clinical investigators, research support staff and others in external centres for the collection of data and resolution of queries.
  • Must be pro-active to identify potential problems, applying previous experience of general processes and procedures to take decisions. Work to develop and improve working practices under the Trial Coordinators guidance.
  • Understands the importance of equality and diversity in the workplace.
  • Ability to identify and respond to equality and diversity issues in line with relevant policies and procedures.

You will also mentor engineers and collaborate with distributed teams and technical stakeholders.   • Drive cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices through right-sizing, governance, and ongoing evaluation of cloud consumption and infrastructure efficiency.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, provide technical direction, review designs, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional, and distributed teams to deliver platform initiatives and continuously improve operational practices.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps for Platform Engineer-level roles, or 8+ years of experience with leadership or architect-level responsibilities for Senior Platform Engineer-level roles.
    • Deep, hands-on expertise with GCP and/or AWS, including services such as Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Storage, IAM, Load Balancing, EC2, EKS, and S3.

    • Proven experience developing and supporting CI/CD automation at scale, particularly with GitLab pipelines.
    • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring practices, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and SLO management with platforms such as Datadog.
    • Experience with Istio and service mesh concepts including traffic management, mTLS, observability, and security.
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex cloud, infrastructure, and platform issues.
    • Clear communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams and communicate technical decisions to different audiences.
    • A proactive and ownership-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance hands-on engineering, strategic thinking, operational priorities, and continuous improvement.
    • Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux, progressive delivery techniques, FinOps, cloud cost optimization, Python, Go, Bash, Linux administration, Vault, Packer, service catalogs, or self-service platforms is advantageous.
    • Experience working in regulated environments such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.
    • Relevant certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) are valued.
