title: Electrical & Firmware Test Engineer
description:
About Dexmate

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

The Role

We are looking for an Electrical & Firmware Test Engineer to make sure the electrical systems and embedded software in Dexmate robots work reliably in the real world. You will own validation of power systems, batteries, boards, harnesses, and motor controllers, and build the hardware-in-the-loop infrastructure that tests our firmware before it reaches a robot. You will find problems before customers do — and help fix them.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time at the bench and in the lab — probing boards, building rigs, running tests, and debugging failures yourself. We care most about what you have actually built, tested, and debugged.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute electrical validation plans for power distribution, battery packs and BMS, custom boards, motor drives, sensors, harnesses, and connectors

  • Define reliability test flows for PCBAs, harnesses, and connectors, and run them: power cycling, brown-out and fault conditions, high temperature/high humidity, thermal cycling and shock, connector and harness flex/wear, and long-duration burn-in

  • Run ESD and EMC pre-compliance testing; support FCC, CE, and UL certification with external labs

  • Validate battery safety and performance, and support battery certification (IEC 62133, UN38.3)

  • Build and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test rigs for motor controllers, joint modules, and main compute boards

  • Develop automated firmware regression tests covering communications (CAN, EtherCAT, Ethernet), control loops, safety behaviors, and OTA updates

  • Perform fault-injection testing to verify error handling and safe-state behavior

  • Lead electrical failure analysis at board and system level, working with electrical and firmware engineers to drive fixes

  • Write test procedures and maintain test data and reports

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience — proven test and debug work matters more to us than the degree

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in electrical validation, hardware test, or embedded test for robotics, automotive, industrial, or consumer electronics

  • Strong bench skills: oscilloscopes, current probes, power analyzers, electronic loads, thermal cameras

  • Ability to read schematics and debug at board level

  • Experience testing power electronics, battery systems, or motor drives

  • Proficiency in Python for test automation and comfort working in Linux

  • Familiarity with embedded systems and communication buses (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building HIL test systems and firmware CI pipelines

  • Experience with EtherCAT or real-time motor control systems

  • Hands-on EMC/ESD pre-compliance testing and certification experience (FCC, CE, UL)

  • Knowledge of battery safety standards (IEC 62133, UN38.3, UL 2271)

  • Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 61508)

  • Ability to read and write embedded C/C++

description:

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Som kundesupporter vil du hjælpe kunder med:

  • Hvidevarer til hjemmet: vaskemaskiner, tørretumblere, opvaskemaskiner, køleskabe og ovne

  • Støvsugere og rengøringsprodukter: klassiske og trådløse modeller samt robotstøvsugere

  • Kaffemaskiner og køkkenudstyr: indbyggede og fritstående løsninger

Du vil:

  • Besvare kunders henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Sikre en professionel og venlig kundeoplevelse

Vi forventer:

  • Dansk i både skrift og tale

  • Gode engelskkundskaber

  • Erfaring med kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Teknisk forståelse og IT-kendskab

  • En positiv indstilling og lyst til at lære nyt

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Grækenland byder på en unik kombination af historie, kultur og naturskønne omgivelser. Landet har et solrigt klima med over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et ideelt sted at bo og arbejde.

Hvad kan man opleve?

  • Akropolis i Athen – Et af verdens mest ikoniske historiske steder.

  • Ø-hop i Det Ægæiske Hav – Besøg smukke øer som Santorini, Mykonos og Kreta.

  • Delphi – Oraklet – En historisk by med dybe rødder i græsk mytologi.

  • Knossos-paladset på Kreta – Et af de vigtigste arkæologiske steder i Grækenland.

  • Fantastiske strande – Fra Zakynthos’ blå grotter til Rhodos’ solrige kyster.

Fordele ved at arbejde i Grækenland:

At arbejde i Grækenland kan være en spændende mulighed, især for dem, der ønsker en international karriere.

Fordele inkluderer:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger, hvilket giver en højere livskvalitet.

  • Solrigt klima året rundt, perfekt for dem, der ønsker en lysere og varmere hverdag.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde i en international virksomhed og udvikle værdifulde færdigheder.

  • En afslappet livsstil med en god balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Hvad kan det betyde for din fremtidige karriere?

Et job i Grækenland giver dig mere end sol og kultur — det er en investering i din fremtid. Du får international erfaring i et globalt arbejdsmiljø, styrker dine sprogfærdigheder og udvider dit professionelle netværk på tværs af landegrænser. Mange virksomheder i regionen opererer internationalt, hvilket kan åbne døre til karrieremuligheder i andre europæiske lande.

Samtidig udvikler du stærke kommunikationsevner og lærer at håndtere komplekse kundeinteraktioner med fokus på service og kvalitet. Du får praktisk erfaring med digitale værktøjer og CRM-systemer, og du lærer at arbejde struktureret, problemløsende og med høj grad af ansvar. Et udlandsophold viser initiativ og tilpasningsevne — kvaliteter, som er attraktive for fremtidige arbejdsgivere i både salgs-, marketing- og servicebranchen.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Spain.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.
    • Strong understanding of sound and rhythm, with the ability to intentionally integrate audio and motion to strengthen the overall creative experience.
    • Comfortable working directly from product UI and collaborating with product designers and other technical or creative stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to advocate for creative decisions, explain the reasoning behind them, and proactively influence projects.
    • Experience experimenting with AI-powered creative and video tools, with genuine curiosity about how emerging technology can improve creative workflows and production.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and taking initiative without requiring fully defined briefs or processes.
    • Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external creative partners.
    • Education is not required; practical experience, creative ability, and demonstrated expertise through your portfolio are valued.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment within the eligible EMEA region.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility motion projects spanning product, brand, web, social, campaigns, and events.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy within a small, collaborative creative team.
      • Opportunity to shape and establish a distinctive motion design system and influence how motion is produced across the broader organization.
      • Exposure to emerging AI and creative technologies as part of everyday design and production workflows.
      • Opportunities to build scalable systems, templates, and tooling that expand your impact beyond individual projects.
      • Inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives, empathy, and authentic contributions.
      • Strong focus on professional growth, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous creative development.
      • Flexible remote culture designed to support collaboration across distributed teams.
      • Reasonable accommodations available throughout the recruitment and interview process for candidates who require them.

  • Review engineering design packages and provide timely, documented feedback

  • Monitor construction progress and resolve technical issues during project execution

  • Support cost estimation, scheduling, and business case development

  • Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure alignment with project goals

Other Responsibilities

  • Build effective collaboration across facilities, procurement, manufacturing, IT, and operations teams

  • Communicate project updates, risks, and key milestones to stakeholders and leadership

  • Identify risks, escalate issues proactively, and recommend mitigation strategies

  • Support root cause analysis and technical problem-solving across global sites

  • Contribute to development and standardization of Best Known Methods (BKMs)

  • Drive alignment of engineering priorities with global facilities strategies

AI Responsibilities

title: Senior Commissions Forecasting & Design Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Commissions Forecasting & Design Lead based in United States.

As a Senior Commissions Forecasting & Design Lead, you will own the end-to-end commissions forecasting process within a strategic FP&A and sales operations environment.
You will build reliable, explainable models that translate headcount, attainment, hiring, ramping, quota changes, and plan mechanics into accurate compensation forecasts.
The role also contributes to the design and evolution of global sales compensation programs across segments, roles, geographies, and pay periods.
You will combine financial modeling, incentive design, systems thinking, and business partnership to evaluate plan outcomes and manage payout and operational risk.
Working across Sales, Finance, People, Legal, Payroll, and Business Technology, you will turn complex decisions into scalable, auditable processes and clear requirements.
This is a high-impact individual contributor opportunity for a strategic and detail-oriented professional who can move seamlessly between executive-level analysis, technical modeling, policy design, and field enablement.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the end-to-end commissions forecasting process in partnership with FP&A and Sales Operations, including the forecast calendar, model architecture, assumptions, source data, forecast submissions, and change-control processes.
  • Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual commissions forecasts, analyzing and explaining actuals-to-forecast and forecast-to-plan variances across segments, roles, plan components, headcount movements, attainment levels, and timing.
  • Establish forecasting inputs and operating rhythms with Sales Operations, Finance, People, Payroll, and business leaders, clearly documenting ownership, deadlines, assumptions, validation requirements, and supporting evidence.
  • Support the design and continuous evolution of sales compensation programs across multiple segments, roles, geographies, and pay periods, translating go-to-market strategy into measurable compensation mechanics.
  • Develop and maintain analytical models and scenario analyses covering quotas, crediting rules, accelerators, kickers, draws, SPIFFs, MBOs, ramping structures, exceptions, behavioral incentives, payout volatility, costs, fairness, and implementation complexity.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, GTM Strategy and Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Payroll, and Business Technology to align requirements, trade-offs, approvals, timelines, and implementation decisions.
  • Co-own compensation-design workstreams for major initiatives such as annual plan redesigns, new-product incentives, role or segment changes, and compensation-system migrations.
  • Translate approved compensation designs into clear business requirements, decision logs, process documentation, test cases, and implementation-ready specifications.
  • Review system outputs and reporting to ensure alignment with compensation policies and intended plan behavior, investigating root causes when results are inaccurate, delayed, or difficult for sellers and managers to understand.
  • Establish practical governance for plan changes, exceptions, approvals, and effective dates, maintaining a clear and reusable audit trail.
  • Create and deliver enablement for sales leaders, managers, and compensation partners, explaining complex compensation mechanics clearly and supporting adoption through documentation, resources, and ongoing communication.
  • Develop recurring reporting on attainment, payout behavior, plan participation, exception trends, forecast accuracy, and overall compensation-program effectiveness.
  • Partner with FP&A on forecast submissions, executive commentary, scenario analysis, and reconciliation between forecast assumptions, approved plan designs, and operating data.
  • Improve the seller and manager experience through clearer plan documentation, compensation statements, self-service resources, office hours, and streamlined intake processes.
  • Support audit and IPO-readiness activities by ensuring plan logic, approvals, controls, documentation, and supporting evidence are complete, accurate, and reusable.
  • Mentor analysts and collaborate with systems and operations partners while operating as a senior individual contributor without formal people-management responsibility.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in FP&A, sales compensation, incentive compensation, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, or a closely related analytical discipline, including significant ownership of commissions or variable-compensation forecasting.
    • Demonstrated experience designing, optimizing, or materially changing sales compensation plans within a complex, multi-segment organization.
    • Strong FP&A, analytical, and financial-modeling capabilities, with the ability to work comfortably with large datasets and build transparent forecast, bridge, variance, and scenario models.
    • Deep understanding of compensation mechanics, including quota allocation, attainment, crediting, accelerators, kickers, draws, ramping, clawbacks, SPIFFs, and exception management.
    • Proven ability to partner with FP&A and senior stakeholders while building alignment across Sales, Finance, Operations, People, and Technology teams.
    • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to develop clear policy language, business requirements, process documentation, decision records, and executive-ready recommendations.
    • Strong systems orientation and experience with an incentive compensation management platform such as Xactly, Varicent, CaptivateIQ, Everstage, Anaplan, or an equivalent solution.
    • Excellent verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to explain sophisticated compensation mechanics and financial implications to non-specialist audiences.
    • High ownership, exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
    • Experience supporting a global SaaS, technology, or subscription-based business is preferred.
    • Familiarity with Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, SQL, or business intelligence tools is an advantage.
    • Experience designing compensation programs for both new-logo and account-management organizations is preferred.

title: CAD Administrator
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
  • Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
  • Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
  • Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
  • Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
  • Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
  • Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
  • Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
  • Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
  • Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Associate degree or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
  • CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
  • Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
  • Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
  • Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

  • Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.

title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst based in Mexico.

This is a senior cybersecurity role focused on determining the real-world risk posed by newly discovered vulnerabilities. You’ll provide the technical depth needed to validate exploitability, understand active exploitation, and translate complex findings into actionable intelligence for customers. The role combines vulnerability research, exploit validation, detection engineering, automation, and threat intelligence in a highly technical environment. You’ll design and maintain honeypots, isolated analysis environments, and tooling that help a specialized team assess vulnerabilities at scale. As a technical lead, you’ll establish standards for vulnerability assessment while mentoring junior analysts and expanding intelligence capabilities. The position is remote-friendly and offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals dedicated to staying ahead of evolving threats.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the technical direction of the vulnerability intelligence practice, establishing rigorous standards for vulnerability validation, assessment, and communication.

  • Research newly disclosed vulnerabilities and determine whether reported exploitation claims are technically valid and relevant to real-world environments.

  • Acquire, modify, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in controlled virtual environments to confirm or refute exploitability claims.

  • Design, build, and operate honeypots and sensor systems capable of monitoring real-world exploitation activity.

  • Develop practical mitigation strategies for situations where patching is delayed, unavailable, or insufficient, including configuration hardening, network segmentation, access controls, feature disabling, and other defensive measures.

  • Develop techniques for identifying both attempted and successful exploitation, including the artifacts and indicators defenders should monitor and hunt for.

  • Produce detailed vulnerability intelligence reports explaining how exploits work, who is using them, who is being targeted, and what actions defenders should take.

  • Build and maintain automation that streamlines vulnerability assessment, PoC testing, triage, intelligence collection, and analysis workflows.

  • Identify and evaluate new sources of vulnerability intelligence and integrate valuable sources into the intelligence lifecycle from ingestion through enrichment and delivery.

  • Train, mentor, and support junior team members, raising the technical capabilities and analytical standards of the wider team.

  • Contribute to continuous improvements in vulnerability research methodologies, tooling, detection approaches, and intelligence coverage.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level knowledge of vulnerability research and intelligence, with substantial experience analyzing and validating vulnerabilities in production or research environments.

    • Proven ability to validate and test proof-of-concept exploits and independently assess whether exploitation claims are technically credible.

    • Strong programming ability in at least one language such as Python, Go, C, C++, or a similar language, sufficient to understand exploit code, modify PoCs, and develop custom tooling.

    • Hands-on experience working with virtual machines, containers, and reusable laboratory environments for safe exploitation testing and technical analysis.

    • Strong computer science fundamentals and a thorough understanding of core computing and internet technologies, including TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication, authorization, and real-world system deployment.

    • Ability to develop mitigations beyond simply recommending patches and understand how defensive controls affect exploitation risk.

    • Experience developing methods to detect attempted and successful exploitation and translating technical findings into actionable defensive guidance.

    • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to produce clear and detailed vulnerability intelligence reports for security professionals.

    • A strong bias toward automation and demonstrated ability to build systems that make vulnerability assessment, triage, and analysis more efficient.

    • Experience mentoring or training less experienced security professionals and raising technical standards across a team.

    • Ability to identify new vulnerability intelligence sources and evaluate their reliability, relevance, and potential value.

    • Experience building honeypots or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity is highly desirable.

    • Experience automating proof-of-concept testing and validation is a strong advantage.

    • Experience integrating intelligence sources end-to-end, including evaluation, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and delivery.

    • Additional valuable experience includes original vulnerability research or CVE credits, reverse engineering, detection engineering with Sigma, Snort/Suricata, or YARA, SOC operations, and familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog.

    • Public speaking, conference participation, or published technical security writing is also advantageous.

      • Wellness programs: Access programs designed to support employee health and wellbeing.

title: Logistics & Trade Compliance Specialist
description:
The Logistics & Trade Compliance Specialist organizes and implements a variety of responsibilities related to the flow of materials, products, services and associated systems information. Duties involve but are not limited to supply chain services, inventory control, critical parts availability, material handling, import-export licensing, shipment of products, and third party warehousing. Evaluates customer support and field service commitments to ensure customer requirements are met. Serves as liaison between sales and operations teams to develop concepts and coordinate product knowledge; provides data analysis for production planning and volume studies; and participates in process/rating improvement efforts. Assists in developing logistics plans and procedures.


Responsibilities
• Global & Domestic Logistics Management
o Prepare import customs clearance documents, verify products, and provide delivery instructions to Kintetsu World Express (KWE)
o Manage export operations for faulty item returns and re-calibration, including the creation of Customs Invoices
o Coordinate domestic logistics and track delivery status to ensure timely arrival
o Coordinate reverse logistics, including the return of unused parts, defective items, and service components back to the Singapore hub/warehouse.
• Inventory & Master Data Management
o Instruct and oversee warehouse operations managed by Kintetsu World Express (KWE), including disposal processes for expired products
o Optimize Safety Stock levels to prevent stockouts of high-demand items while reducing excess inventory to improve cash flow
o Manage local part numbers (PCs, peripherals, cables, etc.), including registration, pricing, and discontinuation
o Lead and manage physical inventory counts (stocktakes) and domestic warehouse inventory reconciliation in coordination with 3PL providers.
• Operational Support & Interdepartmental Coordination
o Respond to inquiries from internal stakeholders (Sales/Service/CRC/CSA) and customers regarding delivery status
o Ensure data integrity and consistency for orders and shipments within SAP
o Serve as the primary point of contact for daily operational inquiries and communication with KWE and internal teams to ensure smooth logistics execution.
• Trade Operations
o Coordinate inbound international shipments via air, ocean, and courier channels.
o Actively engaging with brokers for management of trade related matters (import facilitation, on-time clearance, data retention, Customs queries and regulatory compliance)
o Ensure accurate preparation and review of shipping documents including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificates of Origin, and trade permits
o Staying abreast with local trade regulations and ensuring company’s trade practices are aligned and compliant.
o Lead and manage the Internal Compliance Program (ICP)
o Conduct internal audits for assessment of trade risks.
o Lead and manage external / Customs audits.
• Support data analysis and process improvement projects including KPIs
o Customs clearance lead time
o On-time delivery performance
o Inventory accuracy (%)
o Warehouse productivity
o Logistics cost per shipment
o Import compliance adherence
o Customer order fulfillment SLA
o Shipment damage and claim rates
• Systems & Reporting
o Maintain logistics transactions in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.).
o Generate operational reports covering inventory, import lead times, delivery performance, and logistics costs.

title: Senior Advisor, Agreements
description:
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.

At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.

This role is an in‑office position based at our 20 Bay Street, Toronto location. Our team is highly collaborative, and much of our work benefits from in‑person co‑creation, relationship‑building, and hands‑on partnership with leaders across the organization.

Our Capital Projects Group workforce is made up of driven and dedicated professionals who care deeply about working together to deliver infrastructure and make a positive impact in our communities. Join us as we build a knowledgeable and collaborative team that courageously changes how transit projects will be delivered.

Our Third Party Coordination - Agreements team is seeking 2 Senior Advisors, Agreements to provide subject matter expertise in developing agreements to support Project Delivery Teams (PDTs) in delivering the GO Expansion program as part of the Capital Projects Group (CPG). This role will lead the development and negotiation of agreements with senior level staff and executive level counterparts at various municipalities, government entities and other third-party stakeholders required to enable project construction with mitigated risk.

What will I be doing?

  • Develop and coordinate agreement strategies with municipalities, regions, transit agencies and consortium partners to secure agreements supporting project delivery.

  • Provide specialist agreements advice to Project Delivery Teams (PDTs), identifying coordination requirements, forecasting agreement needs, and aligning activities to project schedules.

  • Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to manage contractual, financial, schedule and liability risks throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Monitor risks, constraints and contingencies, proactively addressing issues to minimize additional costs, penalties, delays and adverse impacts to project delivery.

  • Lead negotiations and stakeholder engagement with municipal and regional partners, leveraging technical, political and process knowledge to secure cooperation and advance corporate objectives.

  • Collaborate with Legal, PDTs and internal stakeholders to establish agreement terms, coordinate municipal infrastructure activities, escalate cross-project risks, and drive issues through to resolution.

What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?

  • Demonstrated experience in progressively more responsible roles within a municipal, infrastructure or transportation planning, policy development, consulting, or project management environment with extensive knowledge of agreements and interaction with public sector agencies.

  • Experience with transit construction infrastructure and/or P3 Financing and Procurement projects would be beneficial.

  • Completion of a degree in engineering, applied science, urban planning, environmental studies, business, law or a related discipline

  • Knowledge of the Ontario Planning Act, Municipal Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Environmental Assessment Act, railway and/or subway corridor infrastructure and related construction projects.

  • Possesses a thorough understanding of theoretical and practical applications of professional principles; exercises substantial decision-making latitude to achieve broad objectives.

  • Risk assessment methods to agreements related planning and timelines issues across all projects to avoid punitive (e.g., financial, time, reputation) damages.

  • Negotiating skills to navigate between multiple parties with differing perspectives along with interpersonal skills to develop collaborative internal relationships that facilitate the accomplishment of the Third Party and Agreements group’s objectives.

  • Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

If you’re excited about working with Metrolinx but your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification of this posting, we encourage you to apply. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are always looking for great talent to join our team.

We are committed to the requirements of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and other applicable legislation so if you require accommodation during the hiring process, please let our Recruitment team know by contacting us at: 416-202-5601 or email hr.recruitment@metrolinx.com.

Application Process:

All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Metrolinx will be using email to communicate with you for all job competitions. It is your responsibility to include an updated email address that is checked daily and accepts emails from unknown users. As we send time sensitive correspondence, we recommend that you check your email regularly. If no response is received, we will assume you are no longer interested in pursuing the opportunity. Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate.

For Internal applicants, with the recent implementation of the Internal Mobility Policy, the internal recruitment process has changed for non-union roles. Candidates must be in their current role for 12 months prior to applying for another role and each applicant must be in good standing (not participating in a Performance Improvement Plan). Please review all provisions of the policy before submitting your application.

description:

Du har nu möjlighet att bli en av oss som IT tekniker - varmt välkommen!

IT- och digitaliseringsavdelningen är organiserad inom Mjölby kommun och ansvarar även för IT-verksamheten i Vadstena kommun. Vår uppgift är att skapa en säker och tillgänglig IT-miljö samt stödja verksamheterna i deras digitala utveckling. Genom vår kompetens och våra tjänster bidrar vi till att kommunernas verksamheter kan ge medborgare och kunder en god service.

Tjänsten är placerad på Kommunstyrelsens förvaltning som är en av Mjölby kommuns sex förvaltningar och fungerar som kansli åt kommunfullmäktige, kommunstyrelsen och valnämnden. Med cirka 130 medarbetare driver vi strategiska frågor i hela organisationen., samordnar kommunövergripande arbete och stöttar både den politiska ledningen och övriga förvaltningar. Förvaltningen består av kommunledning, ekonomi och styrning, HR och lön, kansli, IT och digitalisering, kommunikation samt näringsliv och marknad.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som medarbetare i vårt servicedeskteam är du IT-avdelningens ansikte utåt och den naturliga kontaktvägen för alla IT-ärenden (SPOC, Single Point of Contact). Du ger support via telefon och digitala kanaler samt registrerar och hanterar ärenden i vårt ärendehanteringssystem.


Målet är att lösa så många ärenden som möjligt direkt vid första kontakten, genom telefonstöd eller fjärruppkoppling. Ärenden som kräver vidare hantering prioriterar och fördelar du till rätt specialist på IT-avdelningen. Du följer upp ärenden, återkopplar till användarna och stöttar dem i både återkommande och mer komplexa IT-relaterade frågor och problem.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Tjänsten har följande krav:  

	• tre-årig gymnasieutbildning, helst med datateknisk inriktning
	• tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom IT området
	• mycket goda kunskaper i svenska både i tal och skrift
	• bred kompetens inom IT-området och god kunskap kring Microsofts produkter, M365, Windows 11, Exchange, Active Directory.

Det är meriterande om du har:  

	• tidigare erfarenhet av IT-support
	• kunskap om och erfarenhet av Microsoft SCCM
	• tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i kommun
	• tidigare erfarenhet av support av mobila enheter såsom iPads och mobiltelefoner.
	• B-körkort 

Som person söker vi dig som har förmågan att arbeta med andra människor; att lyssna, visa empati och respekt. Du är prestigelös och uppmärksammar och belönar andras bidrag. Vi ser att du kan analysera och bedöma olika typer av data för att dra väl genomtänkta slutsatser samt för att skapa fungerande lösningar.

Du har en hög förmåga att leverera resultat, både vad gäller kvalitet och produktivitet. Du arbetar på ett systematiskt, metodiskt och pålitligt sätt och du har lätt för att fokusera på kundens behov och uppnå god kundtillfredsställelse. Avslutningsvis ser vi även att du har förmågan att följa instruktioner, procedurer, lagstadgade krav och policy samt förhålla dig till uppsatta tidsplaner.

Varför ska du jobba i Mjölby Kommun? 

Vi är stora nog att erbjuda medarbetare goda arbetsvillkor och spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter. Liten nog för nära samarbeten, delaktighet och inflytande. Alldeles lagom, helt enkelt.

Vår kommun är expansiv med cirka 28 900 invånare. Vi har nära till varandra och nära till resten av världen, kommunikationerna är utmärkta. 

Mjölby kommuns vision sammanfattas i en slogan: Världsvan och hemkär. Världsvan står för öppenhet, nytänkande, vilja att växa och tro på framtiden. Hemkär står för stolthet och glädje över hembygden. Hos oss är det enkelt att leva ett gott liv.

title: Patent Agent
description:
Company Overview:

MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding American industrial capability for a new era of autonomy, robotics, and electrification.

We are the only U.S. company with a fully integrated rare earth supply chain—from mining and refining to advanced metal and magnet manufacturing. Our products include both the critical materials used to make permanent magnets and the finished magnets themselves—enabling next-generation technologies in robotics, automation, aerospace, transportation, defense, and energy systems. These materials are the foundation of physical AI—the convergence of computation, movement, and control.

We hire ambitious, mission-driven people who want to tackle complex challenges and shape the future of strategic industries. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, resiliency, and integrity, with a deep commitment to operational excellence and national purpose. MP is rapidly evolving from a materials producer into a leading U.S. manufacturer—and our people are driving that transformation.

Position Overview:

The Patent Agent sits within the Legal department and works directly under the supervision of the Vice President, Associate General Counsel (IP). The Patent Agent will play a critical role in identifying, protecting, and strengthening the Company’s intellectual property portfolio, with a particular focus on materials science, process technology, and manufacturing methods.

This is a fully in-office role requiring strong technical fluency, precision in drafting, and the ability to operate in close partnership with engineering. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and is motivated to contribute to best-in-class legal and engineering teams.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the VP, Associate General Counsel (IP) to support execution of the Company’s patent strategy aligned with core technologies and long-term business priorities.
  • Assist in building and managing a high-value global patent portfolio focused on advanced materials, magnetics, and manufacturing processes.
  • Conduct invention harvesting sessions with engineers and technical teams, with an emphasis on identifying protectable process innovations and performance improvements.
  • Draft high-quality U.S. patent applications, including specifications and claims, for complex technologies.
  • Prosecute U.S. patent applications before the USPTO, including preparation of responses to Office Actions.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on international filings and prosecution
  • Perform patentability searches, landscape analyses, and competitive intelligence reviews.
  • Support freedom-to-operate and risk assessments by gathering and synthesizing relevant technical and patent information for review by supervising counsel.

Other Functions:

  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable summaries for Legal and business stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Company’s core technologies and workflows.
  • Support internal education efforts to improve invention disclosure quality and IP awareness.
  • Support IP aspects of commercial and strategic transactions (e.g., licensing, joint development, supply arrangements) by preparing technical summaries and patent-related materials.
  • Assist with IP due diligence efforts, including portfolio review and documentation support.
  • Help refine and scale internal IP processes, including invention disclosure intake, review, and tracking.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Registered to practice as a patent agent before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).
  • Bachelor’s degree in materials science, chemical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field (advanced degree strongly preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience in patent preparation and prosecution, preferably with exposure to advanced materials or chemical systems and industrial processes or manufacturing technologies.
  • This is a fully onsite position (5 days per week in Las Vegas, NV), but the candidate must have the ability and willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time, including travel to other Company locations and meetings with internal stakeholders or external partners.

Desired Qualities:

  • Demonstrated ability to draft high-quality patent applications in technically complex subject matter.
  • Experience managing or supporting global patent portfolios and coordinating with foreign counsel.
  • Prior in-house experience or experience supporting industrial/manufacturing clients is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to align IP work with commercial priorities and operational realities.
  • Clear and effective communicator with engineers, operators, and senior leadership.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Lilt's Converse product delivers real-time, multi-party translation for high-stakes conversations - from offline, device-based deployments in the field to live meetings on enterprise collaboration platforms. We're expanding Converse to support any number of participants, speaking any combination of languages, joining from a growing set of form factors - with live translation delivered N-way, directly on the meeting stage, and cleared interpreters reviewing only the segments that need a human eye. You will build and operate the backend services that make this work: per-participant audio ingestion, real-time diarization and translation orchestration, and the routing logic that gets a flagged segment in front of the right interpreter and broadcasts their correction back out in real time. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help build a brand-new product surface, on a team whose existing products serve some of the world's largest global brands.

As a Backend Engineer on the Create team, you'll work closely with senior engineers and Product to build the services powering this Converse expansion - the real-time translation pipeline and the meeting-platform integration - taking well-scoped services and features from design through production with support and code review from more senior teammates. You'll help define clean API contracts with the frontend/interpreter-workbench engineers, contribute to the event-driven correction and broadcast system, and grow into owning larger pieces of the backend architecture as the product and team scale.

Location & eligibility: This position requires US citizenship and residence in the United States. Preferred locations are Washington, D.C.; Boston, MA; and Indianapolis, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain backend services for the real-time translation pipeline: audio ingestion, diarization hookups, streaming ASR/MT orchestration, and result fan-out to every configured meeting language

  • Implement the event-driven routing logic that flags low-confidence segments and routes them to the correct on-call interpreter by language

  • Build APIs and services backing the bot/agent participant and meeting side panel that deliver translation into the host meeting platform, with guidance from senior engineers

  • Contribute to the interpreter correction and broadcast system - ensuring corrections are isolated to the correct language and broadcast to all participants in real time

  • Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) for new backend services

  • Instrument services for observability - logging, metrics, tracing - to support debugging of latency-sensitive, multi-party sessions

  • Partner with frontend/fullstack engineers on the Create team to define clean API contracts between backend services and the live meeting UI and interpreter workbench

  • Participate in on-call rotation and help triage production issues as the product moves toward GA

  • Help generate post-meeting assets: diarized transcripts, exportable formats (TXT/WebVTT/JSON), and per-line verification metadata

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2-5 years of professional backend software engineering experience, ideally including production systems that handle real-time or streaming data

  • Experience building REST API endpoints as well as streaming services with WebSockets, gRPC, message queues, or comparable low-latency/event-driven patterns

  • Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript, Java, Python, or a comparable backend language/ecosystem, and the ability to work across more than one when needed

  • Experience building and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs, including authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys/tokens, service accounts)

  • Comfort with relational/NoSQL data modeling for session state, transcripts, and configuration data

  • Solid grasp of testing and delivery practices: CI/CD and automated integration/e2e tests

  • Ability to take a well-scoped ticket or spec and ship it with minimal oversight, while communicating blockers and timeline risk early

  • US citizenship and residence in the United States

Strong Plus

  • Experience with speech/audio pipelines: diarization, streaming ASR, or audio stream handling

  • Experience integrating with third-party platform APIs, SDKs, or webhooks (Slack, Zoom, or similar collaboration platforms)

  • Familiarity with localization/TMS workflows: XLIFF, Translation Memory, MT vs. human translation pipelines

  • Experience with event-driven/pub-sub architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar)

  • Enough frontend/React exposure to reason about API contracts with a real-time, stateful UI

Bonus

  • Hands-on Microsoft Teams app or bot development specifically (Teams Toolkit, Bot Framework, Azure Communication Services, Microsoft Graph)

  • Experience working on 0-to-1 products within a larger, established company

  • Interest or coursework in NLP/ML systems

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) in production, latency-sensitive systems

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Integrations
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do

You'll be joining the Platform Integration Team (PIT Crew) — a high-impact group whose mandate is critical to the scalability and extensibility of the NodeZero platform. The PIT Crew's mission is to transform Horizon3's APIs and integrations from a collection of one-off vendor connectors into a consistent, documented, permission-aware platform. You'll build the systems that let customers connect NodeZero to the tools they already rely on across the security and IT ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll lead through technical judgment, cross-functional partnership, and high-quality execution — owning significant pieces of platform infrastructure while helping set the standard for the team.

In this role, you will:

  • API Platform: evolving our internal GraphQL-federated API into a first-class, customer-facing product — with permissions, multi-account scoping, versioning, schema evolution, and documentation.

  • Integration Platform: building and operating a shared Integration Router so new connectors can be configured and declared rather than built from scratch, with reusable authentication, health checks, and workflow execution.

  • Security-Tool Integrations: shipping and maintaining integrations with the tools customers already use — CrowdStrike, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, Palo Alto, SentinelOne, and others in the SIEM, EDR, and ticketing ecosystem.

  • MCP Platform: expanding our customer-facing MCP server and agentic workflow capabilities across US, EU, and Australia production environments, enabling customers to build their own AI-powered workflows atop NodeZero data.

  • You'll also share on-call responsibility for a substantial production-observability footprint (Datadog, Kafka-triggered services, multiple environments), meaning you're not just shipping integrations — you're operating them.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Design and implement backend APIs in GraphQL — including federated subgraph development, schema evolution, and multi-account query scoping for MSSP and multi-subsidiary customers.

  • Build and extend the Integration Router: connector libraries, workflow configuration, secrets management, vendor adapters, and Kafka-triggered dispatch services.

  • Own production reliability for API and integration services: monitoring, alerting, deployment, vendor API drift, rate limits, retries, and safe failure handling.

  • Contribute to the MCP platform and OAuth proxy layer, including tool authentication and agentic workflow support.

  • Contribute production code that sets the standard for design quality, code quality, and operational rigor.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and security-domain teams (particularly the Pentest Data Platform) to deliver integrated customer experiences.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on the team as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • Ability to own and manage concurrent initiatives, with strong judgment in prioritization and time management.

  • Self-directed and driven — capable of conceiving and implementing solutions independently and as part of a team.

  • A strong desire to continuously learn new technologies in a fast-paced Agile environment.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a high bar for quality.

  • Strong technical documentation ability to support an external developer audience.

  • Effective communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

  • Interest in mentoring junior and mid-level engineers as the team grows.

Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience using modern object-oriented or functional languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, Scala, C++, etc.).

  • Experience building production applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

What Sets You Apart

  • Expert proficiency in SQL, and experience with relational (PostgreSQL) and graph (Neo4j) database architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building GraphQL backends, including federated graph architectures and schema evolution patterns.

  • Experience designing and operating public API platforms — versioning, developer documentation, permission models, and multi-tenant access.

  • Experience building or operating an integrations platform with reusable connector patterns, event-driven workflows (Kafka or similar), and asynchronous execution.

  • Familiarity with OAuth/OIDC, service accounts, or machine identity patterns for programmatic API access.

  • Experience integrating with third-party security or IT platforms — SIEMs, EDR tools, ticketing systems (e.g., CrowdStrike, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, Palo Alto), or workflow automation platforms.

  • Experience with MCP, agentic frameworks, or other tool-protocol ecosystems.

  • Production reliability experience: observability tooling (Datadog or similar), on-call ownership, vendor API drift handling, and safe failure design.

  • Experience with customer-facing developer surfaces: CLI tooling, SDKs, or developer portals.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $170,000 - $235,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Backend Engineer - US
description:
TL;DR

We’re looking for exceptional builders who help us design and ship the foundational infrastructure that lets Conduct scale to the world’s largest enterprises, while accelerating the product teams building on top of it.

Why Conduct

The world’s largest companies are slowed down by the software they run on. We’re building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission.

Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M Series A from top-tier funds, and we’re still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We’re a small, talent-dense team doing our life’s work at Conduct - we value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who we hire

We’re looking for pragmatic, high-agency engineers who thrive in ambiguity and care as much about the system as the feature. Fundamentals matter more to us than familiarity with any specific tool. If you’re strong, you’ll pick it up fast.

You’ll stand out if you:

  • Have 3+ years of backend experience with exposure to platform or infrastructure work. You have seen what it actually takes to go from MVP to scalable, production-grade systems
  • Have strong system design instincts and own problems end-to-end across APIs, infrastructure, and data flows
  • Are experienced with distributed systems, scaling databases (postgres), queueing, and large-scale batch processing
  • Understand how to benchmark and tune systems under real load, and know how to make pragmatic trade-offs when the data is ambiguous
  • Are familiar with LLM infrastructure at scale
  • Raise the bar around you — through code, mentorship, and better systems — and fix problems without waiting for permission

What you’ll own

You’ll have broad ownership across architecture, developer experience and production systems.

The infrastructure problems are real and genuinely hard: we process tens of millions of lines of code per customer, generating large-scale LLM workloads under enterprise-grade reliability requirements. You’ll work on the systems that keep product teams fast and unblocked and that hold up as we onboard some of the largest companies in the world.

In practice that means:

  • Accelerating product teams. You build the platform that lets engineers focus on product, not plumbing: shared abstractions, sensible defaults, internal tooling that compounds.
  • Scaling with confidence. You design and maintain infrastructure that meets stringent enterprise reliability requirements and doesn’t become fragile as we grow.
  • Taming LLM infrastructure. High token throughput, real-time usage, flaky providers — you make it reliable.
  • Raising the floor, not just the ceiling. From auth to observability to job orchestration, you build systems that are well-designed from the start and don’t need to be rebuilt later.

Our Stack

Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you’re strong, we’re sure you’ll pick it up fast. Here’s our setup:

  • React, Vite, TanStack frontend
  • Kotlin backend: Modern and expressive, paired with the maturity, tooling, and depth of the Java ecosystem. Lets us ship fast now without painting ourselves into a corner later.
  • Temporal and PortKey: Absorbs infrastructure complexity around durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing, so we can focus on shipping instead.
  • Specialised LLM Harness: Built from hard-earned experience to give agents maximum freedom and intelligence without compromising on enterprise control, governance, or reliability.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Switzerland.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.
    • Strong understanding of sound and rhythm, with the ability to intentionally integrate audio and motion to strengthen the overall creative experience.
    • Comfortable working directly from product UI and collaborating with product designers and other technical or creative stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to advocate for creative decisions, explain the reasoning behind them, and proactively influence projects.
    • Experience experimenting with AI-powered creative and video tools, with genuine curiosity about how emerging technology can improve creative workflows and production.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and taking initiative without requiring fully defined briefs or processes.
    • Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external creative partners.
    • Education is not required; practical experience, creative ability, and demonstrated expertise through your portfolio are valued.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment within the eligible EMEA region.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility motion projects spanning product, brand, web, social, campaigns, and events.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy within a small, collaborative creative team.
      • Opportunity to shape and establish a distinctive motion design system and influence how motion is produced across the broader organization.
      • Exposure to emerging AI and creative technologies as part of everyday design and production workflows.
      • Opportunities to build scalable systems, templates, and tooling that expand your impact beyond individual projects.
      • Inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives, empathy, and authentic contributions.
      • Strong focus on professional growth, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous creative development.
      • Flexible remote culture designed to support collaboration across distributed teams.
      • Reasonable accommodations available throughout the recruitment and interview process for candidates who require them.
