You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth.
The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed.
You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms.
A major focus will be turning manual and error-prone commercial processes into scalable, automated products that can support new business categories.
You will work with significant autonomy, operating within ambiguity and taking complex problems from definition through production delivery.
This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineer to directly influence critical market infrastructure while helping build the technology behind a more transparent and efficient energy ecosystem.

Accountabilities:

  • Own architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems, clearly defining system boundaries, contracts, dependencies, and failure modes.
  • Design and build the technical foundations connecting new-product initiatives with pricing, settlement, data, billing, and other core platforms.
  • Take commercially driven and sometimes ambiguous problems, define practical technical approaches, and turn them into shippable plans within the squad's strategic direction.
  • Help develop and launch new product categories, contributing to the technical work required to bring new offerings from concept through production and qualified commercial pipeline.
  • Automate and productise tendering, pricing, contracting, onboarding, and other manual workflows that currently limit scalability and create operational risk.
  • Design deal-gating and risk-management tooling that enables the business to safely support new categories of commercial risk.
  • Work effectively across organizational boundaries, delivering integrations and technical outcomes that depend on teams you do not directly manage.
  • Build high-quality software across backend services and, when appropriate, contribute to React and TypeScript frontend development.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, participate actively in code reviews, and contribute to stronger engineering practices and documentation.
  • Help measure and improve the reliability, scalability, and business impact of the systems you build.

    • Requirements:

    • Deep technical expertise in backend engineering and systems design, with a proven track record of making architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems.
    • Strong professional experience with Python and AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
    • Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems.
    • Full Stack or Backend Engineering experience in a startup, scale-up, or fast-paced product environment, with ownership of complex projects from inception through delivery.
    • Ability to work effectively without a complete specification, turning an ambiguous problem into a practical, well-scoped, and shippable technical plan.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering projects where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, requiring strong collaboration and influence without direct authority.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes and customer or business value.
    • Comfortable working hands-on across the stack, with React and TypeScript experience considered a plus rather than a core requirement.
    • Strong engineering judgment, attention to quality, and ability to reason about scalability, reliability, system boundaries, and failure modes.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across technical and organizational boundaries.
    • Experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction is desirable but not required.
    • Experience in energy, fintech, or another regulated or high-stakes commercial environment is advantageous.
    • Exposure to workflow orchestration, real-time pricing engines, or event-driven systems is a plus.
    • Experience creating new product lines or technical capabilities from scratch is highly desirable.

The MDM Functional Lead is the senior functional authority responsible for configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP master data solutions that enable enterprise data governance, operational excellence, and business transformation. The role translates MDM architecture, governance standards, and business requirements into sustainable SAP configuration, functional specifications, workflows, validations, controls, and operating processes.

Working closely with the MDM Architect, business process owners, SAP functional teams, Enterprise Architecture, and technical delivery teams, the MDM Functional Lead ensures master data solutions align with approved future-state designs and support SAP S/4HANA implementations, business integrations, acquisitions, and ongoing optimization. This role serves as the primary functional escalation point for complex SAP master data design and configuration decisions.

Job Location

This role will work remote based in the US.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own functional design and configuration for SAP master data capabilities across Material Master, Business Partner, Customer, Supplier/Vendor, Finance, and other assigned enterprise data domains.
  • Translate MDM architecture principles, data governance requirements, and approved business rules into scalable SAP configuration and functional designs.
  • Analyze business requirements, identify cross-functional impacts, and recommend SAP-standard, configuration-based solutions whenever practical.
  • Configure and maintain workflows, approvals, validations, field controls, defaulting logic, status management, and other controls that support data quality and governance objectives.
  • Prepare and maintain functional specifications, configuration documentation, decision records, process flows, and traceability to approved requirements.
  • Assess proposed system changes for impacts to master data objects, integrations, reporting, security roles, downstream processes, and existing design standards.
  • Partner with the MDM Architect to convert enterprise data models, standards, ownership structures, and governance controls into executable SAP solutions.
  • Ensure SAP master data configuration supports consistent definitions, standardized processes, data stewardship, auditability, and enterprise controls.
  • Facilitate design workshops with business process owners and functional leads to define future-state master data requirements and resolve design decisions.
  • Maintain alignment between master data design and the business processes supported across Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Manufacturing.
  • Act as the functional escalation point for complex master data issues, design conflicts, configuration defects, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Develop functional test scenarios and expected results for configuration, integrations, workflows, controls, and end-to-end master data processes.
  • Lead or support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, defect triage, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Validate that converted and newly created master data functions correctly within SAP business processes and downstream integrations.
  • Support cutover planning, configuration migration, data conversion validation, go-live, hypercare, and transition to steady-state support.
  • Provide on-site support during critical workshops, deployments, integrations, and SAP go-live events as business needs require.
  • Serve as the primary functional liaison among MDM, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, project leadership, and implementation partners.
  • Provide clear recommendations and trade-off analysis that balance enterprise standardization, business requirements, maintainability, risk, and delivery timelines.
  • Coordinate master data design dependencies across functional workstreams and support timely resolution of design decisions and defects.
  • Coach MDM team members and business data stewards on SAP master data design, configuration impacts, governance controls, and support processes.
  • Provide functional leadership for acquisitions, divestitures, business integrations, continuous improvement initiatives, and future SAP deployments.
  • Monitor master data solution performance, recurring defects, data quality trends, and control effectiveness, and recommend sustainable improvements.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for configuration-related master data issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate master data processes using SAP capabilities and approved supporting technologies.
  • Ensure incidents, requests, enhancements, and production changes follow established support, testing, documentation, and change-control processes.
  • Evaluate emerging SAP capabilities and recommend enhancements that improve scalability, user experience, data quality, and governance compliance.
  • Up to 25% travel may be required to support business process workshops, project deployments, integration activities, and SAP go-live events. Travel requirements may increase during critical implementation phases.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience, including significant responsibility for master data processes, functional design, or configuration.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting one or more enterprise master data domains such as Material, Business Partner, Customer, Supplier/Vendor, or Finance master data.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA master data functionality and supporting at least one large ERP implementation or transformation.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise MDM, data governance, data quality, data conversion, functional testing, and production support practices.
  • Experience creating functional specifications, configuration documentation, process flows, test scenarios, and requirements traceability.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Fiori and SAP data migration or integration concepts; experience with SAP Data Services or related technologies is preferred.
  • Experience in manufacturing, building products, construction materials, supply chain, finance, sales, or industrial operations is preferred.
  • Demonstrated functional leadership with the ability to guide design decisions, resolve ambiguity, and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to translate technical SAP concepts into clear business language and convert business needs into maintainable system solutions.
  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across business, MDM, architecture, functional, technical, project, and implementation-partner teams.
  • Commitment to accountability, standardization, continuous improvement, documentation quality, and disciplined change management.

Compensation

title: Temp to Hire Fab Tech
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Jireh Semiconductor is looking to fill several entry-level roles. Become a Fab Technician and start your career today! This position performs functions associated with all wafer production operations, including photolithography, thin film, etch, BGBM and diffusion. Performs set-up, calibration and preventative maintenance tasks on wafer fabrication equipment. Multiple compressed workweek shifts available, see below.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Operates & evaluates all process and metrology equipment within assigned area, upon successful completion of certification by trainer and engineer.
  • Assures equipment meets all qualification and maintenance schedules as required by specification before processing product.
  • Evaluates both product and qualification wafers through measurement and/or visual inspection. Responsible for accurate entry of that data into workstream system for assessment of processing using SPC controls.
  • Escalates any failure of product and/or qualification wafers to engineering for evaluation.
  • Escalates any process or metrology equipment errors to the equipment technicians for repair and recovery.
  • Follows safe work practices and procedures to assure the safety of oneself and others, Escalates any safety violations or concerns to supervisor to address.
  • Responsible for proper disposal of any and all waste generated on site as required by Cleanroom Protocol specification.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to carry pods weighing up to 12 pounds using two hands repetitively over a 12 hour period. Must be able to pick pods from and place pods to storage racks ranging in height from the knees to the shoulders.
  • Must be able to push/pull carts of pods ranging from 50 to 100 pounds as necessary for transport of material from one area to the next.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended time periods during a 12 hour shift.
  • Must be able to comply with clean room specifications that require all technicians to wear a clean room suit, including hood, mask, protective eye-wear and clean room boots.
  • Manual process areas (CMP, Sort, BGBM) also required to grasp cassette handle with one hand while supporting cassette, weighing up to 12 pounds, with the other hand to manually load process equipment in the area.

Temp to hire opening 6-12 months, conversion based on company needs. This position will be staffed by an existing agency partner.

Shifts Available:

A shift Front End Days Sunday-Tuesday every other Wednesday

C shift Back End Days every other Wednesday Thur-Sat

D shift Back Nights Wed-Fri every other Saturday

QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • No experience required!
  • Must have basic computer skills needed to run automated process controls.
  • Must be able to make calculations required for data entry to SPC controls, using a calculator as needed.
  • Must be able to visually inspect wafers, pods, process tools, etc. for evaluation of processes.
  • Must be able to read and comprehend specifications to achieve certifications required for technician duties.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with team, supervisor, and support personnel to achieve productive goals while maintaining commitments to the safety and quality of the workplace.

COMPANY INFORMATION:

Jireh Semiconductor is the in-house wafer fab for Alpha and Omega Semiconductor (AOS) located in Hillsboro, OR. We manufacturing silicon wafers that eventually end up in many of your favorite products! AOS is committed to excellence in design, manufacturing, and responsiveness to our customers through the continued development of new technologies, products and innovative solutions. We bring to the market devices designed to benefit our customers by meeting their product specific needs. Our mission is to bring value to our customers, shareholders and employees. Learn more at aosmd.com

description:

Job Description

IPSecure is seeking a Senior Kubernetes Software Engineer with extensive software development experience and strong Kubernetes expertise to design, develop, and support scalable, containerized applications. This role will collaborate with DevOps and platform engineering teams to automate deployment pipelines, strengthen application reliability, and resolve complex challenges across Kubernetes environments. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, infrastructure automation, and production systems, along with a commitment to continuous improvement and collaborative problem-solving.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, containerized applications within Kubernetes environments (Kubeadm, RKE2) to ensure consistent and reliable delivery.
  • Author and maintain Kubernetes manifests, including Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets, following best practices for configuration management.
  • Implement, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment workflows for Kubernetes-based applications.
  • Diagnose and resolve deployment, infrastructure, and runtime issues across Kubernetes clusters to maintain high availability and performance.
  • Monitor application health and resource utilization, leveraging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar for proactive performance management.
  • Develop and maintain centralized logging and monitoring solutions for observability and incident response in Kubernetes environments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineering teams to enhance Kubernetes infrastructure, improve application resilience, and streamline delivery processes.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code initiatives using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Helm to standardize and automate infrastructure provisioning.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and advancements in Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, and container orchestration strategies (Podman, Docker, Bootc).
  • Participate actively in agile development ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to continuous improvement and team alignment.

Basic Qualifications

Security Clearance: Must possess an active Secret clearance and ability to obtain TS/SCI clearance is required to be considered

Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline. Equivalentexperiencemay be substituted.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in software development, including building, deploying, and supporting production-grade applications.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deployment, orchestration, scaling, and cluster management.
  • Proven understanding of containerization technologies, particularly Docker, and their role in modern application architecture.
  • In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes networking, service discovery, DNS, ingress controllers, and load balancing mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Go, Python, Java, or Node.js, used in application and infrastructure development.
  • Practical experience with CI/CD tools and pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI) for automated testing, building, and deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools, including Terraform, Ansible, or AWS CloudFormation, to automate provisioning and configuration.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Fluentd, and the Elastic Stack for system and application visibility.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on debugging complex, distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Experience with serverless technologies (e.g., Knative, OpenFaaS).

  • Contribution to open-source Kubernetes projects.

As a Sr. Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in analyzing large datasets, uncovering insights, and driving data-driven decision-making within our organization. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on a wide range of projects. You will have the opportunity to unleash your data wizardry and embark on a thrilling data expedition with us. You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth.
The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed.
You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms.
A major focus will be turning manual and error-prone commercial processes into scalable, automated products that can support new business categories.
You will work with significant autonomy, operating within ambiguity and taking complex problems from definition through production delivery.
This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineer to directly influence critical market infrastructure while helping build the technology behind a more transparent and efficient energy ecosystem.

Accountabilities:

  • Own architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems, clearly defining system boundaries, contracts, dependencies, and failure modes.
  • Design and build the technical foundations connecting new-product initiatives with pricing, settlement, data, billing, and other core platforms.
  • Take commercially driven and sometimes ambiguous problems, define practical technical approaches, and turn them into shippable plans within the squad's strategic direction.
  • Help develop and launch new product categories, contributing to the technical work required to bring new offerings from concept through production and qualified commercial pipeline.
  • Automate and productise tendering, pricing, contracting, onboarding, and other manual workflows that currently limit scalability and create operational risk.
  • Design deal-gating and risk-management tooling that enables the business to safely support new categories of commercial risk.
  • Work effectively across organizational boundaries, delivering integrations and technical outcomes that depend on teams you do not directly manage.
  • Build high-quality software across backend services and, when appropriate, contribute to React and TypeScript frontend development.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, participate actively in code reviews, and contribute to stronger engineering practices and documentation.
  • Help measure and improve the reliability, scalability, and business impact of the systems you build.

    • Requirements:

title: Legal Intern
description:
Programme Eligibility

To join one of our 12-month Internships you must meet one of the following criteria:

  1. You’re currently an undergraduate studying at University and returning to full time education in Autumn 2028
  2. You’re looking to gain work experience after completing your A-Levels, an equivalent course or an Apprenticeship

Additionally, you must also:

  • Be eligible to work in the UK without restriction for the duration of the internship from Monday 5th July 2027 – Friday 21st July 2028
  • Be able to work in NBCUniversal's Central London office on-site four days per week

We recommend applying to just one internship role, this helps ensure your application is considered for the opportunity that best matches your interests and skills. Choosing one allows us to focus on what excites you most and where you’ll shine brightest.

What will I be doing?

We are recruiting a number of Legal Interns across our Film and TV businesses based at our Central London office.

Legal Intern (Business Affairs, Content Group)

The Legal Intern work within Universal Pictures Content Group, dealing with the acquisition, distribution and production of Film and TV content.

  • You will work with lawyers from the start of the deal where a title has been board approved, the signing of the deal, through to the completion of legal delivery.
  • The role involves working closely with the Marketing, Operations, Content Strategy and Finance teams, providing the opportunity to gain a strong insight into the wider business.
  • You will manage and update spreadsheets with deal details and rights information.
  • You will also communicate with members of the international business throughout Europe and the US, confirming the rights positions of titles. The Intern enters rights information into the database which requires the interpretation of signed agreements.
  • The role also involves sourcing and drafting documentation essential for the content release and sharing it with the business.

Legal Intern (Business and Legal Affairs, BALA)

Working within the central business & legal affairs (BALA) team which supports scripted TV production for Universal Global Television, you’ll work closely with a team of 6 BALA execs and have a varied role assisting the team in a range of tasks related to the development, production and financing of scripted television. This includes, without limitation:

  • Producing deal summaries & helping to track deal negotiations (e.g., through creating grids and trackers)
  • Assisting with a range of drafting requests (e.g., amendments, side letters, turnaround agreements)
  • Attending meetings and taking notes where relevant
  • Assisting with a variety of ad-hoc requests e.g., research on companies/writers; chain of title research
  • Assisting where needed with key contracts and systems management matters (e.g., tracking option dates)
  • Helping to liaise with internal teams e.g., Finance, Production etc. on various matters (e.g., ensuring payments have been processed)

Legal Intern (Networks & Hayu)

Working within a friendly and dedicated legal team that supports the international TV channels business of a US Studio (NBCUniversal); NBCUniversal’s Hayu streaming business and its compliance team.

Work will include:

  • Drafting & Review of contracts and other legal documents
  • Legal Research
  • Managing tracking and signing processes
  • Working on precedents and using these for business transactions
  • Assisting the Networks team in relation to our TV and direct-to-consumer business
  • Assisting the Compliance team re the company’s policies relating to bribery, gifts, entertainment, interaction with government bodies and Code of Conduct
  • Assisting the Hayu team in their role as counsel to Hayu, NBCUniversal’s reality TV streaming platform

Legal Intellectual Property Intern (Corporate)

As an Intellectual Property Intern, you will support the protection and enforcement of NBCUniversal’s prized portfolio of popular film and television brands and content, ranging from franchises like Despicable Me/Minions to Jurassic Park/Jurassic World. You will support managing and operating our anticounterfeiting and enforcement programs, researching IP rights and investigating infringements, drafting cease and desist letters and assist with the training of law enforcement authorities, as well as having exposure to a broader range of IP issues.

Legal Intern (Business & Legal Affairs, Franchise Products & Partnerships (FPP) )

Franchise Products & Partnerships (FPP) globally drives expansion of the company's intellectual properties, franchises, characters and stories through innovative physical and digital products, content, and consumer experiences. Along with franchise brand management, FPP’s core businesses include Consumer Products and Games and Digital Platforms. We take properties such as Jurassic World, Minions, Back to the Future, Wicked, Shrek and Gabby’s Dollhouse from our creative content engines like Universal Pictures, Illumination and DreamWorks Animation and partner with best-in-class category leaders (e.g. Mattel, Lego, H&M, Lush, Microsoft, etc.) to create amazing products for our fans.

The Legal Intern works within FPP Business & Legal Affairs team, a highly collaborative and commercially-focused team that provides legal support and advice to category and creative teams across our European offices.

As a Legal Intern, you will:

  • Collaborate with lawyers and contract managers drafting agreements and legal documents related to consumer product licensing arrangements, retail/marketing activations, NDA’s and service agreements.
  • Assist in tracking and following up on contracts that have been sent externally for review and signature, ensuring deals are brought to completion within designated timeframes.
  • Prepare documents for electronic signature and ensure signed contracts, amendments and correspondence are archived and organised within our internal document management systems.
  • Support the B&LA department with additional tasks as needed to achieve business and speed-to-market goals.
  • Work closely with commercial, finance, franchise, creative, and other legal teams within the company, offering valuable insight to how we protect and licence our brands.

This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your legal skills. NBCUniversal has a great record of nurturing and retaining talent, of developing and training lawyers and a very active SRA Training Programme for its paralegals.

What will I learn from this opportunity?

Our Legal Internships are a unique opportunity to work for one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies. From broadcast and cable networks, news and sports platforms, to film, world-renowned theme parks and a diverse suite of digital properties, we take pride in all that we do and all that we represent.

The Legal Intern’s role at NBCUniversal is highly varied and provides the chance to engage with commercial and legal issues within the media and entertainment industry. You will learn valuable skills by undertaking a variety of legal tasks and you will also gain an insight into the wider business.

What do I need to bring to the role?

  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Analytical and logical reasoning
  • Team work & strong interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Adaptability & ability to prioritise/manage a broad and fast-moving workload

Internship Programme Benefits & Perks

In addition to valuable hands-on experience, UK interns receive a competitive benefits package that supports their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Additional perks include exclusive employee discounts, access to ‘myPerks’ NBCU’s employee programme with opportunities to win tickets to attend movie premieres, swag bundles and more. Plus, you’ll get free streaming access to your favourite platforms like Hayu and NOW TV.

title: Consultant: Education Specialist
description:
The International Organization for Migration (IOM), in partnership with the Department of Environment, Climate Change and Emergency Management (DECEM) and the FSM Department of Education (DOE), is implementing the project "Safer Schools, Stronger Shelters: Advancing Community Resilience in the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM)." The project aims to support the national and state governments in strengthening climate adaptation and disaster risk reduction efforts through the education sector and community preparedness initiatives.

The consultancy will focus on component 1, mainstreaming DRR and CCA into the FSM education system and will ensure necessary and relevant integration and support under component that focus on infrastructure and strengthening EES management capacities. Recognizing the important role of education in building long-term resilience, the project seeks to mainstream Climate Change Adaptation (CCA) and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) into the FSM education system through the development of an Action Plan, review and development of learning materials, and capacity development of teachers. The consultant will support the review of existing curriculum resources and initiatives, facilitate stakeholder consultations, develop recommendations and an Action Plan, and contribute to the development and piloting of DRR/CCA learning modules and supporting materials.

IOM seeks to engage a Curriculum Integration Specialist Consultant who will work closely with the Department of Education and relevant stakeholders to conduct curriculum assessments, identify entry points for integrating resilience-related themes into existing learning frameworks, develop curriculum integration resources and learning materials including review and update of the existing learning materials, support stakeholder consultations, and facilitate training of trainers (ToTs), teacher training and piloting activities. The assignment will contribute to ensuring that students acquire practical knowledge, skills, and attitudes that promote disaster preparedness, climate resilience, environmental stewardship, and sustainable development within the FSM. The consultant will ensure that all recommendations are evidence-based, aligned with FSM education priorities, and reflective of indigenous knowledge, local context, and good practices from previous initiatives such as CADRE and CADRE+.

This assignment will be carried out under the IOM FSM Community Resilience Unit, and the candidate will work under the direct supervision of the Project Officer (Community Resilience) and in close coordination with Programme Coordinator (Community Resilience) as well as other relevant project managers, coordinators and head of sub-offices.

  1. Conduct an in-depth assessment of existing mechanisms, policies, curricula, learning materials, and initiatives supporting DRR and CCA education in FSM.

  2. Review existing educational resources developed under CADRE, CADRE+, and other relevant programmes.

  3. Assess opportunities and challenges for mainstreaming DRR and CCA into the existing primary school curriculum and support the review, adaptation, and/or development of DRR and CCA learning modules and educational materials.

  4. Identify gaps in existing DRR/CCA curriculum content, teaching methodologies, teacher capacities, institutional arrangements, and educational resources required for sustainable integration in FSM education system.

  5. Ensure indigenous knowledge, local practices, and cultural considerations are adequately reflected in the assessment.

  6. Facilitate consultations with DOE, DECEM, State Departments of Education, teachers, students, civil society organizations, and development partners.

  7. Prepare and facilitate validation workshops at national and state levels, document and consolidate stakeholder feedback and recommendations.

  8. Lead the development of an evidence-based Action Plan for mainstreaming DRR and CCA into the FSM education system.

  9. Develop recommendations for curriculum integration, ToR, teacher training, and educational resource development.

  10. Ensure materials are age-appropriate, culturally relevant, inclusive, and aligned with FSM education standards.

  11. Integrate gender, disability inclusion, climate adaptation, environmental sustainability, and indigenous knowledge considerations into all materials.

  12. Support the development of teacher guidance and resource materials and integrate practical preparedness concepts, including school safety, emergency procedures, hazard awareness, and community resilience principles, into learning materials where appropriate.

  13. Support the design of Training of Trainers (ToT) packages,methodologies and facilitate ToT trainings.

  14. Prepare inception, assessment, workshop, Action Plan, and final consultancy reports and maintain regular coordination with IOM and project partners.

  15. Present findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.

  16. Undertake duty travel as required.

  17. Perform such other duties as may be assigned.

Summary of the Key Deliverables:

  • Inception Report including methodology, workplan, stakeholder engagement approach, and assessment framework.

  • Assessment Report on existing DRR/CCA education policies, curricula, learning materials, teacher capacities, and gaps for mainstreaming.

  • Stakeholder Consultations and Validation Workshops conducted at national and state levels, with findings and recommendations documented.

  • DRR and CCA Education Action Plan developed, including priorities, implementation roadmap, roles and responsibilities, and sustainability measures.

  • DRR/CCA Learning Materials Package reviewed, adapted, and/or developed, including student learning materials and teacher resource guides.

  • Training of Trainers (ToT) Package developed to support capacity building of teachers and education stakeholders.

  • Teacher and Stakeholder Training Workshops delivered, including training reports and recommendations.

  • Pilot Testing and Validation Report documenting results, lessons learned, and recommendations for refinement of learning materials.

  • Final Consultancy Report summarizing activities undertaken, outputs delivered, key findings, recommendations, and next steps for implementation.

Performance Indicators for the Evaluation of Results:

  • Satisfactory completion of Tasks specified in the TOR based on supervisor’s performance evaluation.

  • Planning, organization, and timeliness for managing and delivering outputs.

  • Quality and comprehensiveness of assessment and recommendations.

  • Effective coordination and stakeholders engagements and capacity building.

  • Quality of data and information collected and coordinated with partners, quality of reports, compliance with standard and sustainability principles.

  • Quality, inclusiveness, and relevance of learning materials developed.

Education, Experience and/or Skills required:

  • Master’s degree in education, Curriculum Development, Climate Change, Disaster Risk Reduction, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or related field with at least two years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Bachelor's degree in the above fields with at least five years of relevant professional experience.

  • Demonstrated experience in curriculum development or education sector programming.

  • Experience in Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), environmental education, or resilience programming.

  • Experience facilitating multi-stakeholder consultations and workshops.

  • Experience working with government institutions and education authorities.

  • Experience in the Pacific region or small island developing states is highly desirable.

  • Knowledge of indigenous knowledge systems and community-based approaches is an advantage.

Travel Required: YES

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.

  • Knowledge of any local languages (Pohnpeian, Kosraean, Chuukese and Yapese) is desirable.

Competencies

Values

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.

  • Integrity and transparency maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.

  • Professionalism: demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.

  • Courage: demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.

  • Empathy: shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – Behavioural indicators

  • Teamwork: develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.

  • Delivering results: produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.

  • Managing and sharing knowledge: continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.

  • Accountability: takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.

  • Communication: encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

title: Graduate Rotating Equipment & Reliability Engineer
description:
With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower‑carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies.

These positions sit within our Consulting division encompasses professionals with industry-leading expertise in areas including decarbonisation, hydrogen, carbon capture and storage, renewables advisory, asset optimisation, and digital solutions. A multi-sector business unit, we are focused on providing consulting solutions during the planning, analysis, operation and optimisation of assets, facilities, and infrastructure.

Responsibilities

There are a variety of tasks and responsibilities you might be assigned however some common tasks that many of our graduate engineers perform include:

  • Assisting senior engineers with projects: You may be asked to help with research, testing, or other tasks related to ongoing projects.
  • Learning Wood processes and procedures: It's important to understand how Wood operates and the specific procedures and protocols you'll be expected to follow.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams: Engineering projects often involve multiple disciplines and teams, so you may need to work with colleagues from other areas of Wood.
  • Debugging and troubleshooting: If a product or system isn't working as intended, you may be called upon to help identify and resolve the problem.
  • Preparing reports and presentations: You may need to communicate your findings and progress to your team, manager, or other stakeholders.
  • Continuously improving your skills and knowledge: The engineering field is constantly evolving, so it's important to stay up to date with new developments and best practices.

What we can offer

  • Global graduate program including development workshops, online learning, lunch and learns, networking & social events
  • Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to leaders of industry across renewables and emerging energy sectors
  • Graduate network - We have a lively & vibrant graduate network which organises many social and learning events throughout the year.
  • Flexible working arrangements that balance client, team and individual needs offering hybrid and remote working where relevant
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business with employee networks committed to giving all employees a voice
  • Competitive salary with regular salary reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
  • Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
  • Global mentoring program/connections; where you will work alongside passionate & talented mentors locally & globally who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession

What we look for in these roles:

  • Completed your Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering degree by the end of 2026 or earlier.
  • Attention to detail: You will be responsible for creating detailed designs and specifications and must pay close attention to detail to ensure the accuracy and safety of the work.
  • Teamwork: Most engineering projects require collaboration and teamwork, so strong interpersonal and collaboration skills are essential
  • Adaptability: Engineering is a constantly evolving field, and as a graduate engineer you should be able to adapt to new technologies and techniques.
  • Problem solving: Engineering often requires finding creative solutions to complex problems. Good critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills are highly valued.
  • Communication skills: The ability to communicate technical information in a clear and concise manner is important for a graduate engineer. This includes the ability to write reports, give presentations, and explain complex technical concepts to non-technical colleagues.
  • Continuous Learning: Technologies and methodologies are constantly changing so staying up to date is an important attribute
  • Creativity: have that innate ability to “think outside the box”
  • Analytical ability: ability to think analytically to fully define a problem and develop solutions suited to the problem.
  • Logical thinking: ability to understand how a system works, what can go wrong and how to fix it. This requires the ability to think logically and evaluate and understand each element that makes up the system
  • Leadership: well-developed “human skills” so you can smoothly perform non-technical duties.
  • Respect for health and safety protocols: this is more of a requirement than a skill but adherence to policies that aim to eliminate or mitigate risk is a necessity.

You must also upload your resume and academic transcripts to be considered.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Ireland.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the intersection of applied AI and large-scale data systems, turning millions of short-form videos every day into structured representations of culture and consumer behavior. Plot makes unstructured social media legible at scale, enabling brands to build a deep, systematic understanding of trends, audiences, and influence.

You’ll join a small but mighty team where engineers own systems end-to-end — not tickets. You’ll work directly with founders, shape foundational architecture, and make decisions that define how Plot scales for years to come. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, deep systems thinking, and building infrastructure that unlocks entire product surfaces, Plot is the place. It’s also a great fit if you aspire to be a technical founder one day — we operate with a strong founder’s mindset.

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the core data systems that power Plot. You’ll take responsibility for how millions of enriched videos flow from ingestion → storage → analytics → product surfaces.

  • Stabilize and harden high-throughput write paths. Our pipelines ingest and enrich data continuously; you’ll diagnose failure modes, reduce error rates, and make ingestion reliable, observable, and predictable.

  • Design data access patterns that stay fast under pressure. You’ll ensure dashboards and analytical queries remain responsive even while large volumes of data are being written concurrently.

  • Separate transactional and analytical concerns. You’ll lead decisions around which workloads belong where, and design the systems and contracts that keep them from stepping on each other.

  • Build read-optimized models for insight, not just storage. This includes partitioning strategies, rollups, and schemas that reflect how data is actually queried — by humans and by AI.

  • Enable AI-native analytics. You’ll shape how our internal tools and AI agents query and reason over data, making it possible to answer complex analytical questions without brute-force scans.

  • Make architectural calls that matter. You’ll evaluate tradeoffs, write RFCs, and guide the evolution of Plot’s data platform as scale, product needs, and AI capabilities grow.

  • Raise the bar for reliability and performance across the team. You’ll define best practices, unblock other engineers, and become a go-to resource for data-related decisions.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience operating Postgres in production under real-world read/write concurrency. You understand partitioning, locking, autovacuum, connection pooling, and why systems fail in subtle ways.

  • Strong systems intuition. You think in bottlenecks, failure modes, and tradeoffs — not just indexes or tooling.

  • Experience designing or owning analytical data architectures, including read-optimized schemas, aggregations, or large‑scale querying patterns.

  • Comfort leading ambiguous, high‑impact work. You can take a messy system, form a clear mental model, and chart a pragmatic path forward.

  • High ownership mindset. You like digging into logs, metrics, and real data — and you care deeply about correctness, reliability, and long‑term maintainability.

  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and a desire to build foundational systems that other engineers and AI systems depend on. No degree requirements.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience

title: Staff Engineer - Pricing

This is a senior backend engineering role focused on building the infrastructure that powers a large-scale creator data platform. You’ll design and operate systems responsible for collecting and maintaining data on more than 400 million creator profiles across major social platforms. The role involves solving complex distributed-systems challenges around reliability, freshness, scalability, external dependencies, and cost efficiency. You’ll have end-to-end ownership, from shaping ambiguous problems and designing architectures to deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving production systems. You’ll work with high-volume data, third-party APIs, proxy networks, and cloud infrastructure where small technical improvements can have a significant business impact. The environment is remote-first, async-oriented, collaborative, and designed to give senior engineers substantial autonomy.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and evolve backend systems responsible for collecting and maintaining 400M+ creator profiles across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Design resilient services that can handle third-party API instability, rate limits, provider outages, platform changes, partial failures, and other external disruptions.

  • Improve the economics of large-scale data collection by optimizing requests, proxy usage, retries, storage, compute, and other infrastructure costs.

title: Test Systems Engineer
description:
About Dexmate

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

The Role

We are looking for Test Systems Engineers to build the machines that test our robots and to keep our new test lab running. You will design automated test rigs, data logging, and dashboards so durability tests can run around the clock, and you will run whole-robot functional and working-condition tests that reflect how customers actually use our robots. You are the force multiplier: the more you automate, the more the team can test.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test stations and rigs combining mechanical fixtures, motors, sensors, PLCs or microcontrollers, and software

  • Build data acquisition and logging systems, and dashboards that track test status and results across all test stations

  • Automate long-duration durability and duty-cycle tests to run unattended overnight and on weekends, with alerts and automatic shutdown on failure — scaling to dozens of modules on test in parallel

  • Qualify every test station for accuracy, repeatability, and stability before its data is trusted

  • Design simple interface boards and harnesses for test setups, and work with equipment suppliers on custom stations

  • Run whole-robot functional tests: mobility, manipulation, payload, terrain, and continuous operation

  • Develop and run working-condition tests based on real customer scenarios and environments

  • Assemble, configure, and prepare robots and subsystems for testing

  • Keep the lab running: equipment setup and calibration, spare parts and inventory, and lab safety (battery handling, robot motion safety zones)

  • Support mechanical and electrical test engineers in executing their test plans

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience

  • 3+ years building test equipment, automation, or robotic systems

  • Proficiency in Python for automation and data handling, and comfort with Linux command line

  • Hands-on experience with sensors, motors, and DAQ or PLC systems

  • Comfortable with mechanical assembly, wiring, and basic fabrication

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ROS/ROS 2 or robot middleware

  • Experience building test dashboards and databases

  • Background in robotics competitions, makerspaces, or building robots end-to-end

  • Experience running a hardware lab, including equipment calibration and safety programs

title: NX Developer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains internal systems, applications, and infrastructure across the enterprise. We are looking for an NX Developer to join our team and develop customizations, automation, and administrative tooling for our Siemens NX CAD environment.

About the Role

Anduril's engineers design and build autonomous systems that protect those who serve. Behind every model, drawing, and assembly is the Siemens NX environment that makes rapid iteration possible. As an NX Developer on the Engineering Systems and Tools team, you'll be the person who makes that environment faster, smarter, and more reliable — building custom automation, tooling, and integrations that let our mechanical and electrical engineers focus on the work that matters instead of fighting their tools. You'll write real code (NXOpen API, Python, C++), own the full lifecycle of internal developer tools, and work directly with the engineers who depend on them. This isn't IT support - it's product development for an internal user base that's building things that actually matter.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain NX Open API customizations (NX Open C/C++, NX Open Python, NX Open .NET) to automate repetitive design tasks and enforce engineering standards
  • Build and manage NX CAD administrative tools including templates, part families, reuse libraries, and check-mate rules to ensure consistency across the engineering organization
  • Create custom NX dialogs, menus, and toolbars that streamline workflows for mechanical and electrical design teams
  • Develop journal-based automation scripts and NX Open applications to accelerate modeling, drafting, and BOM generation processes
  • Collaborate with PLM engineers to ensure seamless NX–Teamcenter integration in managed mode, including classification, naming rules, and revision workflows
  • Work with a high-functioning team of solution engineers and cross-functional teams with an emphasis on finishing business-critical projects
  • Help troubleshoot NX technical issues including those related to deployment, site configuration, custom toolkit distribution, and ongoing end-user support

Who You Are:
Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology startup that is rapidly scaling itself. Our culture is one of ambition, hard work, relentless pursuit of excellence, and deliberate disruption. The successful candidate will be one who demonstrates the follow core characteristics:

  • Outcome-Oriented - they determine what benefits the business needs and work backwards from those outcomes. The antiquated IT concept of “system availability” is abhorrent to the ideal candidate, they care about if the business actually got value from their product, not if it was just made to specification
  • Customer Focused - they display user empathy to boost engagement and build experiences that delight
  • Strong Product Sense - they know when in the product’s lifecycle to focus on optimizing the end user experience and when to focus on enterprise-level functionality
  • Dive Deep - they sweat the details and roll up their sleeves to uncover the root causes for systemic issues, be it technical shortfalls or lack of user comprehension of a product
  • Ownership - they care deeply not just about their products, but for all the business outcomes that their systems supports as well, holding themselves accountable for everything it both does and fails to do
  • Agility - they change directions easily and without regret, quickly adapting to shifting business priorities
  • First Principles Thinking - they approach problems and develop solutions not based on what a vendor recommends or because it’s how they did things at their last job, but from a deep appreciation of what is best for the enterprise
  • Exceptional strategic problem-solving capabilities - adept at navigating complex technical trade-offs

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a CAD development role, ideally in a fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environment
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical degree
  • Proficiency in NX Open API development using one or more of: C/C++, Python, Java, or .NET (C#/VB.NET)
  • Hands-on experience with NX CAD administration including templates, drafting standards, part families, reuse libraries, and role-based configurations
  • Experience creating and maintaining NX journaling scripts and custom automation toolkits
  • Strong understanding of CAD data management concepts including naming conventions, revision control, and BOM structures
  • Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints

Preferred QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Siemens Teamcenter integration in NX managed mode, including classification, workflows, and naming rules
  • Familiarity with NX Check-Mate for automated design validation and quality checks
  • Experience with NX deployment and site-level configuration (ugii_env, custom directories, toolkit distribution)
  • Knowledge of GRIP or KF (Knowledge Fusion) programming within NX
  • Experience integrating CAD tools with downstream systems (PLM, ERP, MES, etc.)
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve user issues, and work autonomously to solve problems
US Salary Range
$111,000—$147,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed — we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a cloud backend team within our AI Detection and Response (AIDR) group. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for building and operating the next generation of AIDR provisioning and orchestration systems. When customers onboard to the AIDR platform, your team ensures they become operational seamlessly — from initializing customer stores and configuring security policies, to setting up management groups, provisioning data stores, and enabling configuration across dependent services. Your team manages the automation of this complex orchestration to deliver a frictionless customer experience at massive scale.

You'll play a critical role in enhancing existing provisioning flows and architecting next-generation systems that support millions of AI security events per second across petabytes of critical data. This is a player-coach role — while your primary focus is leading and growing your team, you will also contribute code, prototype solutions, and stay deeply embedded in the technical work when needed. This is an opportunity to lead at the intersection of people leadership and technical excellence, building both high-performing teams and high-performing systems that protect organizations worldwide from sophisticated AI-based threats.

PLEASE NOTE: This role is hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week on-site at one of the posted locations.

Success Means:

  • Building and leading a high-performing engineering team that delivers with velocity while maintaining the highest standards of quality, security, and reliability

  • Architecting and driving the evolution of provisioning and orchestration systems that scale seamlessly as AIDR's customer base grows

  • Driving operational excellence through proactive system improvements, robust monitoring, and rapid incident resolution

  • Fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence

  • Partnering effectively with product management, peer engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to align on priorities and deliver business outcomes

  • Attracting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers building cloud-native provisioning and orchestration services for the AIDR platform

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for customer lifecycle management — onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and orchestration across dependent services

  • Drive architectural decisions for highly scalable, reliable, and secure distributed systems

  • Contribute directly to the codebase as needed — whether unblocking critical deliverables, prototyping new approaches, fixing production issues, or filling gaps during team scaling (expect ~20-30% hands‑on coding depending on team needs)

  • Partner with product management to translate business requirements into technical strategy and execution plans

  • Establish and maintain engineering best practices including code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD, and operational runbooks

  • Manage team capacity, sprint planning, and delivery commitments while balancing technical debt and innovation

  • Drive operational excellence — own service reliability, incident response, root cause analysis, and preventive measures for your team's services

  • Collaborate with peer engineering managers and architects across CrowdStrike to ensure seamless integration with the broader Falcon ecosystem

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard top engineering talent; conduct performance reviews and support career development

  • Remove blockers, shield the team from distractions, and create an environment where engineers do their best work

  • Participate actively in design reviews and code reviews, providing meaningful technical guidance and making informed architectural trade‑offs

What You'll Need:

  • 10+ years of software development experience building enterprise‑grade cloud products, with at least 3+ years in an engineering management role leading backend teams

  • Strong hands‑on coding ability — you can still write production-quality code and are willing to do so when the team needs it

  • Proven experience building and leading teams that develop microservices running in cloud‑native environments at scale

  • Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud architectures, and microservices patterns

  • Deep understanding of customer provisioning, orchestration, and lifecycle management systems

  • Experience with at least one cloud‑native programming language: Go, Python, or Java (Go preferred)

Familiarity with:

  • Cloud architectures and microservices

  • Web Services: REST, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, or similar API technologies

  • Data storage systems: PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, or similar databases

  • Container technologies: Docker, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration platforms

  • Message/event systems: Kafka, Pulsar, or similar

  • Proven track record of deploying and operating services in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/OCI/Azure)

  • Experience managing service reliability, on‑call rotations, and incident response processes

  • Strong people leadership skills — demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high‑performing engineers

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and delivery management

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision‑making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency, and drive business outcomes

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience in cybersecurity companies or security‑focused products

  • Deep understanding of AI/ML security challenges, threats, and mitigation strategies

  • Experience building customer onboarding, provisioning, or multi‑tenant orchestration systems at scale

  • Experience managing teams that own platform/infrastructure services consumed by multiple product teams

  • Hands‑on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and/or Microsoft Azure

  • Experience with real‑time data processing systems (Kafka, Pulsar)

  • Familiarity with MS CoPilot Ecosystem and MS Agent Studio

  • Golang experience

  • Experience leading teams through major system migrations or re‑architecture efforts

  • Track record of building engineering culture and processes from the ground up

  • Contributions to open source libraries and/or frameworks

title: VP, Product Analytics
description:
We are looking for a hands-on VP, Product Analytics to lead Product Analytics and build an AI-native analytics operating system across the company’s crypto, stocks, prediction markets, perpetuals, and stock futures products.

You will set the analytics strategy, lead and develop the Product Analytics team, and ensure data consistently shapes product and business decisions. This is a player-coach role: you will operate at executive level while remaining technically close enough to review PRs, guide data modeling and pipeline design, and challenge analytical conclusions.

You will own product and business reporting, experimentation, release measurement, diagnostic analysis, the Amplitude data stack, and the systems through which analytics work is delivered at scale.

Lead Product Analytics

  • Set the vision, priorities, operating model, and quality standards for Product Analytics.

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team.

  • Review analytical and data-engineering PRs, providing guidance on SQL, data models, pipelines, metric definitions, and methodology.

  • Represent Product Analytics in executive and product decision-making.

  • Allocate team capacity toward the company’s highest-impact opportunities.

Build an AI-native analytics operating system

  • Design how analytics work moves from business questions to trusted decisions across intake, data discovery, analysis, validation, reporting, and knowledge management.

  • Build reusable AI tools to automate repetitive workflows, encode analytical standards, and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of delivery.

  • Establish appropriate governance, validation, and human review for high-stakes decisions.

  • Measure the system’s impact on turnaround time, analytical quality, experimentation throughput, and team capacity.

Own product and business reporting

  • Establish trusted KPIs, source-of-truth metrics, dashboards, and executive business reviews.

  • Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and focused on decisions—not simply monitoring performance.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, CRM, Growth, and other functions to align definitions, priorities, and business interpretation.

Build an experimentation culture

  • Make experimentation and evidence core parts of product development.

  • Establish standards for hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, experiment design, causal interpretation, and rollout decisions.

  • Use AI and automation to streamline experiment intake, validation, analysis, and readouts while maintaining analytical rigor.

  • Help product teams move from opinion-led decisions to repeatable test-and-learn practices.

Own analytics platforms and data quality

  • Own the Amplitude data stack, including instrumentation strategy, event taxonomy, governance, data quality, and integration with warehouse reporting.

  • Set standards for product instrumentation and ensure new releases can be measured reliably.

  • Set standards for and review analytical models and pipelines, ensuring metrics remain traceable, reproducible, and trusted as products evolve.

Drive high-impact analysis

  • Lead diagnostic deep-dives into activation, conversion, retention, user behavior, market liquidity, trading execution performance, and product health.

  • Define measurement frameworks and success criteria for major product launches.

  • Oversee post-release evaluations that inform whether the company should iterate, scale, or stop.

  • Identify root causes, challenge weak hypotheses, and translate complex findings into clear recommendations and product actions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Leadership operates from trusted, consistent product and business metrics.

  • The Product Analytics team has clear priorities, strong technical standards, and consistently high-quality output.

  • AI-enabled workflows materially improve analytical speed, quality, and capacity.

  • Product teams use experimentation and evidence as standard parts of development.

  • Amplitude instrumentation and taxonomy are reliable, governed, and useful.

  • Major product launches have clear success criteria and rigorous post-release evaluation.

  • High-impact analyses lead to concrete product, operational, and business decisions.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience leading Product Analytics teams in a complex, fast-moving organization.

  • Strong hands-on technical judgment, advanced SQL, and experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to redesign analytics operations—not merely improve individual productivity.

  • Ability to design and implement AI-enabled workflows, reusable agents or tools, validation controls, and analytics knowledge systems.

  • Experience owning a product analytics platform; deep Amplitude experience is strongly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of experimentation, causal inference, product measurement, and diagnostic analysis.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear decisions.

  • Strong product judgment, people leadership, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Consumer fintech, trading, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy products.

  • Exchange mechanics, market liquidity, and experience with multi-asset products.

  • Leading company-wide adoption of new analytics technologies and ways of working.
