title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Platform Engineer based in Portugal.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on raising the standard for how software is built, tested, delivered, and operated.
You will shape the platform foundations that product teams and AI coding agents rely on to move quickly and reliably.
The role spans developer experience, CI/CD, infrastructure, automated testing, observability, security, and secure software delivery.
You will establish engineering standards, build reusable tooling and golden paths, and help teams adopt workflows that create measurable leverage.
A key focus will be AI harness engineering: designing development environments and engineering systems where AI agents can work effectively and safely.
You will operate as a builder and technical leader, staying close to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and the evolving needs of engineering teams.
This is an opportunity to have organization-wide impact while helping define how modern software teams collaborate with increasingly capable AI agents.

Accountabilities:

  • Shape the platform and infrastructure foundations that product teams build and operate their services on, balancing standardization with team autonomy.
  • Improve the complete engineering development loop, including local development, CI/CD, deployment processes, production feedback, and developer workflows.
  • Define and drive engineering standards for automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and secure software delivery, while helping product teams adopt them effectively.
  • Build shared tooling, templates, reusable components, and golden paths that reduce friction and provide practical leverage across the engineering organization.
  • Own secure delivery practices end to end by integrating security scanning, secrets management, dependency controls, software supply-chain protections, and penetration-testing workflows into core development and delivery pipelines.
  • Monitor and respond to the evolving security landscape, particularly as AI coding agents change how vulnerabilities are introduced, discovered, and potentially exploited.
  • Improve repositories, development conventions, tooling, documentation, test coverage, and feedback loops so AI coding agents can navigate codebases efficiently and produce reliable results.
  • Measure the effectiveness of platform initiatives through DORA metrics and qualitative feedback from engineering teams, using those insights to continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by setting direction while remaining deeply involved in code, infrastructure, automation, and pipeline implementation.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and operating production-grade systems.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and developing internal platforms, with strong judgment around what should be abstracted, exposed, standardized, or left flexible.
    • Deep expertise in CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, developer tooling, and modern software delivery practices.
    • Strong understanding of software security and secure delivery approaches, including shift-left security and SecDevOps principles.
    • Product-oriented mindset toward internal platforms, treating engineers and AI agents as users and measuring whether tooling genuinely improves their productivity.
    • Practical fluency with AI coding agents, including an understanding of how they operate, where they encounter friction, and how engineering environments can be designed to make them more effective.
    • Ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can define strategy while personally contributing to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.
    • Strong systems thinking and the ability to identify organization-wide opportunities for standardization, automation, reliability, and developer productivity.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence product teams and drive adoption of shared engineering practices.
    • Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright and knowledge of how to scale automated testing environments is a strong plus.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment where established processes and playbooks may still be evolving.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to shape the future of software development and AI-assisted engineering.
      • High level of ownership with direct visibility into the impact of your technical decisions.
      • Individual-contributor-focused culture that values engineers who lead through execution and create momentum by building.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with highly experienced AI and software engineering professionals.
      • Global and flexible remote work environment, with an emphasis on results rather than location.
      • Equity participation designed to align individual success with the long-term growth of the organization.
      • Significant opportunity to influence platform strategy, engineering standards, security practices, and AI-enabled development workflows.
      • Inclusive environment committed to diversity and equal opportunity.

title: Disaster Emotional and Spiritual Care Program Manager
description:
This posting will close November 2, 2026, at 11:00 pm central time.


About the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America
The Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA) is one of the largest Christian denominations in the United States, with 3 million members in more than 8,600 worshiping communities across the 50 states and in the Caribbean region. Known as the church of “God’s work. Our hands.,” the ELCA emphasizes the saving grace of God through faith in Jesus Christ, unity among Christians and service in the world. The ELCA’s roots are in the writings of the German church reformer Martin Luther.


The Lutheran Center (national office) is located in Chicago, Illinois. A staff of approximately 400, under the leadership of the Presiding Bishop, serve as administrators, advisors, conveners, partners, and resource people for the ELCA and its ministries. Staff lead the work of national, domestic, and global ministries and programs including Lutheran Disaster Response, ELCA World Hunger, Service & Justice, Christian Community and Leadership, and Innovation. We are also home to five of our separately incorporated ministries: The Mission Investment Fund of the ELCA, Women of the ELCA, Lutheran Men in Mission, the ELCA Foundation and the ELCA Federal Credit Union.


About the position

Through the Service and Justice unit, the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA) Churchwide Organization (CWO) shall foster and facilitate this church’s engagement in service with and among communities and promote efforts to call and act for justice. The work of ELCA Service and Justice includes engaging in mission, service, and justice in accompaniment with churches and organizations in other countries. The Service and Justice unit serves as a channel through which churches in other countries engage in mission to this church and society.


Lutheran Disaster Response (LDR), a ministry of the ELCA, accompanies communities impacted by disaster through response, recovery, preparedness and resilience-building efforts in the United States and globally. Grounded in Lutheran theology, LDR works alongside congregations, synods, community organizations and global partners to share God’s hope, healing and renewal with people whose lives have been disrupted by disaster.


This position serves as the Disaster Emotional and Spiritual Care (DESC) program manager for a three-year Lilly Endowment-funded capacity-building initiative focused on strengthening, deepening, and expanding LDR’s Disaster Emotional and Spiritual Care (DESC) initiative. This role will provide centralized leadership for building a coordinated, scalable, and sustainable emotional and spiritual care infrastructure across ELCA synods.


This role will oversee the development, implementation, and growth of synodically-based and regional DESC teams. This includes coordinating training efforts, managing logistics, supporting volunteer team development, and serving as a key liaison between LDR staff, synods, facilitators, and partners. This role will help move LDR from an ad hoc model of emotional and spiritual care to a structured, replicable, and sustainable system.


This is a full-time, term contract (starts fall 2026, ends March 31, 2029), exempt, Chicago-based position. This position has responsibilities that will require being in the office a minimum of 2 days each week and more as needed.


The eligibility of a candidate for positions may depend on the residency of the candidate, and the budget for the role, including salary or pay, insurance coverage, and/or tax burden. Candidates for this position must reside within the fifty United States or the District of Columbia and be authorized to work lawfully in the United States. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.


1. Oversee implementation and coordination of a three-year Lilly Endowment-funded grant initiative related to building Disaster Emotional and Spiritual Care programmatic infrastructure for Lutheran Disaster Response.


2. Serve as the primary liaison and program lead for LDR’s Disaster Emotional and Spiritual Care (DESC) programming, coordinating across LDR staff, synods, congregations, partners, trainers, and volunteers to implement the grant-funded initiative.

3. In partnership with LDR’s Training and Networks team, lead the coordination, delivery, and ongoing development of DESC training across the ELCA’s domestic footprint. This includes advancing trauma-informed, skill-based curricula and expanding accessible learning formats (facilitated, asynchronous, and blended). Ensure the DESC education portfolio is theologically grounded in ELCA accompaniment and aligned with the Service & Justice MERGE (Migrant, Economic, Racial, Gender, Environmental) justice framework.

4. Lead the design, development, and ongoing support of synod-based DESC teams, including recruitment, onboarding, and long-term sustainability. Establish and operationalize standardized practices for activation, debriefing, and follow-up, and develop protocols, role descriptions, and codes of conduct. Advance a Training of Trainers (ToT) model to build and scale a network of locally based facilitators.

5. Develop and sustain strong partnerships with synod leaders, disaster coordinators, clergy, and lay leaders, while leading communication, collaboration, and peer learning across DESC teams through regular virtual and in-person convenings.

6. Lead and support evaluation and reporting efforts by tracking DESC team formation, training outcomes, and activations; documenting best practices to inform a scalable expansion model; and preparing written reports to meet grant reporting requirements.

7. Other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Rust Software Engineer
description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ) is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

About Vector Atomic:

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you’re excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Location:

This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA.

Travel:

Up to 5%, domestic or international.

Job ID:

1687

The Role:

Vector Atomic is building next-generation quantum devices designed for real-world applications, including GPS-free navigation, high-precision timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. As a Senior Rust Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader within a rapidly growing, collaborative team of over 50 professionals delivering practical, transformational quantum technologies. In this high-impact role, you will architect and write production-quality Rust code, driving the software strategy for our advanced quantum instruments. You will collaborate deeply across disciplines with physicists, electronics engineers, and firmware engineers, taking ownership of system controllers, data acquisition pipelines, and critical control algorithms on ARM SoCs from concept to deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the design and development of reliable, high-performance, production-quality software architectures in Rust.
  • System Control & Drivers: Architect and verify system controllers on ARM SoCs, designing robust user-space drivers for complex peripherals (including mixed-signal devices) and low-latency data acquisition pipelines.
  • Advanced Algorithm Implementation: Implement and optimize critical control loops and precision algorithms essential to the stability and operation of quantum sensing instruments.
  • Hardware Integration & Bring-up: Partner closely with hardware teams to lead board testing, hardware bring-up, and the implementation of fault-tolerant error-handling systems.
  • Quantum Software Infrastructure: Oversee the development and scaling of core software libraries used for the control and automation of next-generation quantum systems.
  • Mentorship & Process Improvement: Champion continuous improvement within the development process—leading technical code reviews, project retrospectives, and mentoring junior engineers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 6+ years of professional software engineering experience (with a proven track record in embedded or hardware-adjacent environments).
  • To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.
  • Must be fully comfortable working hands-on in a laboratory environment alongside physical hardware and complex test setups.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical gaps between hardware engineers, software teams, and physicists.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive background coding in C/C++ or utilizing Python and its scientific libraries for data analysis and modeling.
  • Deep expertise in designing, modeling, and coding advanced control algorithms (such as PID loops) and fixed-point digital filters.
  • Advanced experience interfacing with external hardware devices through protocols like TCP/UDP, UART, SPI, and I2C.
  • Comprehensive background working with SoC/FPGA architectures and developing specialized Linux device drivers.
  • Highly proficient in using standard test and measurement equipment—including oscilloscopes, function generators, and voltmeters—to benchmark, validate, and debug software performance.

Benefits will be provided by Vector Atomic, an IonQ Company, and will differ from the benefits listed on the IonQ website.

Benefits

Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including:

  • Platinum-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
  • Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employer 401(k) contributions
  • 20 days of paid time off & 11 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Fully stocked kitchen

The approximate base salary range for this position is $142,113 - $186,063 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Full-stack
description:
What are we looking for?

Hercules is looking for a senior analytics and full-stack engineer to help us build the future of AI software development

What will you do?

You will own our full data-stack:

  • ETL: Get all of our data from 3rd party providers (like Stripe, Meta ads, our operational database etc) into our Data warehouse (BigQuery)

  • Data modeling: Clean and model our data for. We currently use DBT and the medallion architecture

  • Semantic layer modeling: Define and model our key business metrics, make sure they are modeled 100% accurately

  • Business intelligence: Create dashboards and visualizations that our company will use every day. We use Omni for Business Intelligence. Your goal is to make Omni as self serve as possible for our entire company

What skills do we expect you to have?

We expect candidates to be incredibly strong across all of the following areas:

  • Software fundamentals: system design, architecture, data modeling, and API design

  • Code and codebase quality: write clean, maintainable code. Work effectively in monorepos

  • Data modeling: Strong experience modeling data with DBT or another declarative data modeling framework

  • Semantic layers: Strong experience with at least one semantic layer modeling framework like Omni, Looker, etc

  • Business intelligence: Strong understanding of the different ways to display data for easy consumption

  • AI: able to truly 10x your workflow by being on frontier of AI coding

What’s Hercules’ data stack?

  • ETL: Airbyte, Google Cloud Datastream

  • Data warehouse: BigQuery, Clickhouse

  • Data modeling: DBT

  • Semantic layer and Business Intelligence: Omni

(We are not tied to any of these)

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process:

  1. We ship. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers.

  2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

  3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules’ benefits?

  • Unlimited AI token budget

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?

$100k-$250k + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

title: "Aktiviteten" Kastanie Allé 5 søger én ny kollega
description:
Er du engageret og empatisk og brænder du for at skabe gode oplevelser for mennesker med særlige behov?

Vi søger én kollega hvor ansættelsen vil gå på tværs af Kastanie Allé 5 og Botilbuddet Bøge Allé 14, men hvor din primære funktion vil være på Aktiviteten Kastanie allé 5, Ribe.

Beskrivelse af samværs- og aktivitetstilbuddet Kastanie Allé 5

Aktiviteten Kastanie Allé 5 er et samværs- og aktivitetstilbud efter servicelovens §104 for voksne med betydelig og varig nedsat fysisk og psykisk funktionsevne samt kommunikationsvanskeligheder, hvor vi gennem vores aktiviteter med borgerne skaber en tryg og udviklende hverdag med fokus på nærvær, fællesskab og meningsfulde aktiviteter.

Udover levering af samværs- og aktivitetstilbud jf. SEL §104-tilbud, tilbyder vi i perioder også Særligt Tilrettelagt Ungdomsuddannelse (STU).

STU er en treårig individuelt tilrettelagt ungdomsuddannelse for unge med særlige behov, som ikke kan gennemføre en almindelig ungdomsuddannelse. Formålet med STU er at udvikle den unges faglige, personlige og sociale kompetencer, så de bliver rustet til et så selvstændigt og aktivt voksenliv som muligt.

Vores faciliteter inkluderer sanserum, aktivitetsrum, fælles køkken, multimedierum med VR-oplevelser, interaktionsskærme og musikterapi, samt to store udendørs terrasser der bruges til udeliv og andre sociale aktiviteter, som fx madlavning over bål.

Vores aktiviteter spænder fra musik, sang, pædagogisk massage, socialmotorik og sanseoplevelser til kommunikationsstøttende aktiviteter – alt sammen med fokus på trivsel og udvikling.

Beskrivelse af botilbuddet Bøge Alle 14.

Botilbuddet Bøge Allé 14 er opført efter Almenboliglovens §105, stk. 2 med støtte jf. Lov om social service §85. Tilbuddet er opført i 2016 og beliggende i Ribe på Ribelund området.

Huset er i et plan og indrettet med store lyse lokaler, samt flere sansestimulerende aktivitetsrum. Tilbuddet er opdelt i to bo-grupper med 9 borgerlejligheder i hver, der alle har eget badeværelse og tekøkken, samt et gennemgående loftliftsystem.

Beboerne på Bøge Allé 14 har alle væsentlige og varige fysiske- og psykiske funktionsnedsættelser og har behov for hjælp døgnet rundt for til at kunne fungere og trives i alle henseender i eget liv. Herunder alle dele af personlig pleje.

Botilbuddet er døgndækket med faste natmedarbejdere.

Vi kan tilbyde

Som medarbejder hos os bliver du en del af et dedikeret team, der skaber en inkluderende og meningsfuld hverdag for vores borgere.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte at:

  • Planlægge og afholde motiverende og engagerende aktiviteter
  • Støtte borgerne i deres sociale samvær og personlige udvikling
  • Samarbejde med kollegaer, pårørende og eksterne aktører
  • Bidrage til et positivt og omsorgsfuldt miljø

Vi er

  • Et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kollegaer
  • En harmonisk og humoristisk personalegruppe
  • Åbne og tillidsfulde kollegaer, der værdsætter samarbejde
  • En fagligt funderet personalegruppe med fokus på udvikling
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og præge dagligdagen

Om dig

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent.
  • Er mødestabil og engageret i din rolle
  • Har kendskab til borgergruppen og forstår deres behov
  • Gerne er musisk og kan inddrage musik i samværet og aktiviteterne
  • Gerne initiativrig og motiveres af at udvikle nye tiltag. Og har lyst til at byde ind.
  • Gerne har erfaring med sanseintegration og kan bruge det aktivt i dit arbejde
  • Dig som kan se glæden i de små udviklingstrin
  • Gerne har kendskab til autisme

Det er vigtigt at du

  • Har en anerkendende tilgang til borgere og kollegaer
  • Er fagligt velfunderet og kan omsætte teori til praksis
  • Har lyst til og ser perspektiver i arbejdet med målgruppen, hvor små udviklingsmål er en succes
  • Vægter og kan se værdien i det tværprofessionelle samspil i både botilbud og organisation
  • Kan arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt
  • Reflekterer over egen og kollegaers praksis


Udviklingscenter Vest

Aktivitetstilbuddet Kastanie Allé 5 er en del af Udviklingscenter Vest, som leverer støtte gennem 26 botilbud, 9 aktivitets- og beskæftigelsestilbud og i borgers eget hjem.

Vi er ca. 1000 engagerede medarbejdere, der alle kan være stolte af at være med til at yde en vigtig indsats. Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil du blive mødt med tillid til, at du arbejder professionelt og i et tæt samarbejde med både dine nærmeste kolleger og resten af organisationen.

Du kan læse meget mere om vores arbejdsplads her:

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Vi ønsker en ny kollega, med snarest tiltrædelse eller tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026. Ansættelsen vil som udgangspunkt være på 37 timer om ugen, men ønsket timetal kan muligvis imødekommes, og lønnen fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse.

Arbejdstiden ligger primært i hverdage mellem 07.00-15.30, men der skal påregnes arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig efter at høre mere om jobbet, så kontakt endelig tilbudsleder Peter Fænk på mobil 23648859 mellem 8.00-15.00 eller på mail petfa@esbjerg.dk.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst, herunder de gældende bestemmelser om lokal løndannelse. Du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauet i Esbjerg Kommune via dette link: KRL. Her findes også oplysninger om grundløn og pension. Der kan desuden efter en konkret vurdering aftales kvalifikations- og/eller funktionstillæg afhængigt af stillingens indhold samt dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

I Esbjerg Kommune arbejder vi tillidsbaseret og ser menneskelig forskellighed som en styrke. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede uanset køn, alder eller etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Går du videre efter ansættelsessamtale, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra nuværende og/eller tidligere arbejdsgiver, hvis du fortsat er i betragtning til stillingen. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet referencer.

Ved ansættelse i stillingen indhentes straffeattest.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler

Ansøgningsfristen er den 20. oktober 2026, hvorefter ansættelsessamtalen forventes at finde sted i onsdag den 28. oktober 2026.

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk. Klik på ”søg stillingen” nederst og vedhæft din ansøgning, CV og relevant dokumentation.

title: Full Stack Engineer

title: China/IMG/SA Research Director & Strategic Insights Lead
description:
Lead the China/IMG/SA Research & Consumer Insights function, directing Product Research, Brand and Communications research, and Consumer Insights for both passenger and commercial vehicle divisions (Ford Blue, Model e, Lincoln, and Ford Pro). As “voice of thecCustomer” lead across China, IMG, and South America, you will embed actionable insights across the business lifecycle — from upstream planning to post-launch communications strategy — while serving as a principal advisor to senior leadership to drive customer-centric business strategy.

Product Research

  • Serve as the primary authority on market research and voice of the customer for China, IMG, and South America, directing all consumer research and insights across the three markets.
  • Pilot new methods, data sources, and AI-enabled tools against clear success criteria.
  • Execute against Ford's global research playbook — common methods, stimuli standards, segment and metric definitions — so regional results are comparable and trendable. Critically audit research designs, mitigate bias, and ensure the validity of strategic findings.
  • Accelerate research speed and predictive accuracy through AI integration and process optimization.
  • Direct primary research, tracking studies, and advanced conjoint and choice modeling, maintaining rigorous standards throughout the product development process.
  • Direct development and dissemination of insights on strategic topics such as ADAS, infotainment, powertrain trends, and accessories.

Consumer Insights

  • Develop and oversee Customer Insights Briefs at program kick-off and Target Customer Profiles that define the emotional and functional needs of the target customer, establishing the foundational customer understanding for program teams.
  • Partner on the customer problem statement, market context, and key customer insights that underpin a successful product concept and differentiate in segment.
  • Partner with the Product Execution Team (PM, Planning, Product, GMs, Marketing) to embed customer and competitive insight into strategic decisions from cycle plan inclusion through launch and into market.
  • Identify priority learning gaps and direct primary and secondary research to address them, leveraging internal tools and teams.
  • Synthesize multiple data sources into high-impact narratives with clear business implications and actionable recommendations.

Brand & Communications Research

  • Own cadence-driven tracking of Ford, Lincoln, and competitive brand funnel metrics and attributes across key audiences and subgroups in the region.
  • Direct always-on social listening on brand, product, and corporate topics, alongside tracking of purchase and rejection reasons, customer experience, and owned social and ambassador performance.
  • Guide target customer and communications positioning research to shape campaign development and creative for vehicle reveals and launches.
  • Direct copy testing, control-versus-exposed attitudinal lift, and campaign performance measurement to quantify impact across the brand funnel and optimize media strategy.

Team

  • Elevate team capability and foster a culture of excellence across China, IMG, and South America, coaching talent to high performance.

#LI-SS

Role Requirements

The minimum requirements we seek:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Statistics, Engineering, Consumer Behavior, or Data Analysis; MBA highly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in Market Research, Portfolio Planning, Advanced Product Concepting, Consumer Insights, or Strategic Consulting.
  • Mastery of quantitative methodologies, including advanced analytical modeling, with deep proficiency in qualitative research.
  • Direct experience across product research and brand or communications research, including brand tracking and advertising effectiveness measurement.
  • Proven ability to translate granular data into macro-level business objectives and market trends.
  • Exceptional executive presence, distilling complex findings into persuasive recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional projects and coaching talent to high performance.
  • Ability to critically audit research designs, mitigate bias, and ensure the validity of strategic findings.

Our preferred requirements:

  • Experience navigating diverse market dynamics and cultural nuances across China, IMG, and South America.
  • Track record of measurably reducing research cycle times or re-engineering a research function for speed.
  • Demonstrated habit of scouting, piloting, and scaling emerging research methods and AI-enabled tools.
  • Experience managing a research supplier ecosystem across multiple markets, including spend accountability.
  • Background in automotive or another complex, engineering-led product environment.

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

  • Future orientation — anticipates where research is going and positions the function to get there first.
  • Learning agility, with a test-and-learn instinct and the discipline to kill what is not working.
  • Global mindset — upholds one standard, respects local nuance, resists fragmentation.
  • Governance discipline — enforces research standards and decision rights consistently.
  • Bias for speed, with judgment about where rigor is non-negotiable.
  • Managerial courage — makes and stands behind difficult decisions.
  • Emotional calmness when navigating ambiguity and organizational change.
  • Strong performance management, holding teams to high standards.
  • Deep customer empathy for internal partners' business challenges.

title: 22247 - Community Payback Supervisor - St Albans

description:

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Banking Services Officer
description:
The Banking Services Officer (BSO) is responsible for administering and overseeing commercial loan, deposit and treasury management servicing activities. This position serves as a primary point of contact for client servicing matters and exercises independent judgment and discretion in resolving routine and non-routine issues related to banking, operations, regulatory compliance, and client relationship support.


The Banking Services Officer collaborates with Relationship Managers, Lending, Operations and Compliance teams to ensure accurate, timely and compliant delivery of banking services while balancing client experience, risk management and Bank policy requirements.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Loan & Deposit Administration

  • Administers and oversees complex loan and deposit servicing activities, exercising independent judgment in resolving routine and non-routine issues, approving exceptions within delegated authority, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and Bank requirements across the account lifecycle.
  • Independently reviews, prepares and oversees loan, deposit, and cash management documentation for new, renewed, and amended accounts, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Coordinates and evaluates the documentation required for loan renewals and annual reviews, determining necessary financial information and ensuring its accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintains credit files, updates covenant tracking system and servicing ticklers, collects and reviews financials, collateral, insurance, and verification documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Utilizes Bank systems, including SharePoint and other approved platforms, to manage client records, track servicing status, monitor key deadlines, and support appraisal and environmental processes.
  • Coordinates and oversees loan payoff requests, UCC searches, flood certifications, credit reports, and related third-party services, assessing results for accuracy.
  • Maintains and administers approved limits for overdraft approvals and fee waivers, exercising sole and independent judgment within established Bank policies and delegated authority. Independently evaluates client requests based on account history, relationship considerations, risk indicators, and policy guidelines; approves or declines requests within assigned authority; escalates exceptions as required; monitors usage to ensure limits are not exceeded; and documents decisions and rationale as needed to support compliance, audit readiness, and internal controls.

Client Service & Relationship Support

  • Serves as a central point of contact for clients regarding deposit, loans and treasury service matters, independently addressing inquiries and resolving issues in a professional and timely manner.
  • Exercises discretion and sound judgment in responding to client requests, balancing client needs with regulatory requirements, operational risk, and Bank policy.
  • Communicates complete information clearly and effectively to clients, determining appropriate messaging, tone, and level of detail.
  • Participates in client meetings related to onboarding, servicing, and relationship maintenance, contributing operational and compliance expertise. Builds and maintains strong client relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness and effective resolution of servicing matters.
  • Escalates relationship, operational, or risk-related concerns to Relationship Managers or management when appropriate, providing informed recommendations.

Account Opening & Compliance

  • Oversees and supports account onboarding and ongoing servicing activities to ensure full compliance with BSA/AML, OFAC, CIP, and CDD, and all applicable regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Supports and oversees the establishment of new deposit and loan accounts, ensuring full compliance with CIP and documentation requirements for completeness, accuracy and compliance.
  • Reviews account opening documentation, beneficial ownership information, and business entity records for completeness, accuracy, and compliance prior to approval or escalation.
  • Exercises discretion in evaluation documentation exceptions, risk indicators, and client activity, determining appropriate actions or escalation paths.
  • Participates in internal audit, regulatory examinations, and compliance reviews related to account administration and client servicing activities.
  • Maintain confidentiality and ensure accuracy in all recordkeeping and reporting.

Operational Services

  • Serves as a subject matter resource for banking services, loan servicing, deposit operations, and client servicing procedures.
  • Provides operational guidance and clarification to internal partners regarding servicing standards, documentation requirements and regulatory interpretation.
  • Coordinates the distribution and tracking of loan, deposit, and cash management documentation to ensure timely execution, audit readiness, and compliance with operational controls.
  • Coordinates with Lending, Operations, Compliance, and Relationship Management teams to ensure consistent, accurate and compliant client servicing.
  • Maintains documentation, reports, and records in accordance with Bank standards, regulatory expectations, and audit requirements.
  • Supports and, as appropriate, provides guidance on training to Banking Services staff to promote consistent servicing practices.

Client Communication

  • Serves as a primary point of contact for client communications related to deposit and loan servicing matters, ensuring inquiries and requests are addressed professionally, accurately, and in a timely manner.
  • Communicates complex, routine and non-routine information to clients clearly and effectively, exercising judgment in determining appropriate messaging, tone, and level of detail.
  • Proactively engages clients regarding servicing issues, documentation needs, and resolution status, balancing client expectations with regulatory and bank requirements.
  • Coordinates client communications with Relationship Managers, Lending, Operations, and Compliance to ensure consistent and accurate information is provided.
  • Documents client interactions and communications in accordance with Bank standards and regulatory expectations.
  • Identifies recurring communication issues or client concerns and recommends improvements to enhance service quality and client experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Ministry of Social & Family Development
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

AtGovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more aboutGovTechat tech.gov.sg.

About Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF)

The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) is Singapore's lead ministry for social and family policies, working to build a caring and inclusive society where every individual and family can thrive.

We deliver essential services through our network of Family Service Centres, Social Service Offices, and industry partners, supporting vulnerable populations across all life stages. Our work encompasses family services, early childhood, social assistance, disability support, mental health initiatives, and community development programmes.

We are actively expanding our team to drive impact for our key initiatives including but not limited to:

  • Case Central for integrated case management for Social Service Sector
  • ComLink+ for enhanced community support programme
  • Social Service Coordination Centre for Whole-of-Govt insights
  • Early Childhood programmes that give our youngest citizens the best start in life
  • Sectors Futures Technology to look ahead on sectoral digitalisation and transformation efforts
  • These innovative platforms represent our commitment to leveraging technology and coordinated approaches to better serve Singaporeans.
  • Join our dedicated team of professionals and help make a meaningful difference in the lives of Singaporeans as we work together to nurture strong families and build resilient communities.
(What you will be working on)

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to work on technically challenging problems in a modern, product-focused environment, solving important underserved problems in the public sector. The problems we work on include the modernisation of digital services that support Singaporeans on their parenthood journey.

  • Designing and implementing robust, scalable software solutions using modern full-stack web application technologies, with a focus on performance, security, and maintainability
  • Collaborating with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions that align with architectural standards and best practices
  • Writing clean, well-tested code and conducting thorough code reviews to maintain high engineering standards across the team
  • Contributing to technical decision-making processes, including technology selection, architectural design, and implementation approaches for complex systems
  • Participating in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and system design through deployment, monitoring, and maintenance
  • Mentoring junior engineers and sharing knowledge through documentation, technical discussions, and pair programming sessions
  • Working with various teams to ensure smooth deployment pipelines, monitoring, and incident response procedures
  • Contributing to the MSF Engineering Landscape by implementing Infrastructure-as-Code practices, CI/CD pipelines, and compliance requirements across multiple systems and vendor partnerships
  • Staying current with emerging technologies and industry best practices and advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve engineering effectiveness and system reliability
  • Participating in on-call rotations and incident response to ensure high availability of critical government services
(What we are looking for)
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with a track record of delivering impactful solutions
  • Extensive experience building and maintaining large-scale, high-availability software systems that serve significant user bases
  • Strong proficiency in modern full-stack web application technologies, particularly Next.js/React.js for frontend development and Java/Python/TypeScript for backend services
  • Deep understanding of software engineering principles including design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture
  • Experience with cloud platforms, containerisation, and modern deployment practices including CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Commitment to engineering excellence with a focus on code quality, testing, documentation, and maintainable software design
  • Experience working in agile development environments with rapid iteration and continuous delivery practices
  • Familiarity with security best practices and compliance requirements, particularly in government or regulated environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with database design and optimisation, API development, and integration with third-party systems
  • Passion for public service and interest in using technology to improve government services and citizen experiences

This role will start off on a 2 year contract.

What we offer you:

GovTechis an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite ofperks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life insideGovTechat. Stay connected with us on social /ConnectWithGovTech

title: Principal Engineer (Payments)
description:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// We’re looking for a Principal Engineer - Payments to join Masabi’s Architecture team, with a primary focus on our payments domain.

This is a senior role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with deep payments experience. You’ll shape the technical direction of our payments platform while staying close enough to the detail to design, review and support meaningful technical work.

Working across the engineering organisation, you’ll act as a senior technical leader within the payments domain: contributing to architecture, guiding complex decisions and helping teams build scalable, resilient systems that support millions of journeys worldwide.

The role suits someone who can move between system-level thinking and implementation, who understands trade-offs, can navigate ambiguity and helps turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, practical technical approaches.

Location_

// This role is available in a fully remote model for candidates based in Colombia


Responsibilities_

  • Shape the technical direction of Masabi’s payments platform, contributing to architecture, standards and engineering best practices

  • Design and deliver scalable, secure, resilient and cost-effective payment solutions aligned with Masabi’s platform direction

  • Support teams in building towards a modern, microservices-based architecture while balancing delivery priorities and long-term platform health

  • Stay close to technical delivery through architecture reviews, design discussions and targeted hands-on contribution where needed

  • Identify and work through complex technical challenges related to scalability, resilience, operational performance and system evolution

  • Act as a senior technical advisor across engineering teams, supporting and influencing technical decisions, particularly within the payments domain

  • Work with external providers and payment partners on integrations, technical alignment and problem-solving

  • Contribute to technical roadmap planning, prioritisation, technical scoping and architecture discussions for complex initiatives

  • Produce clear technical documentation and contribute to engineering standards, technical forums and good practices across the organisation

About You_

// You bring a mix of strong technical expertise, sound judgement and real-world payments experience.

  • Strong experience working on payment systems, including integrations with PSPs, gateways, EMV, contactless EMV, acquirers, etc.

  • Good understanding of payment flows, transaction lifecycles and system design considerations

  • Experience designing and evolving distributed systems and microservices architectures

  • You’ve operated at Principal or Staff level, shaping technical direction across multiple teams or domains

  • Strong judgement and the ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural outcomes

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning complex problems into clear, practical technical approaches

  • Clear and thoughtful communicator, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Comfortable being hands-on where needed, while maintaining a focus on system-level impact

  • You have strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and modern infrastructure practices

  • You’ve worked on systems where scale, reliability, performance and cost trade-offs matter, and can navigate those decisions thoughtfully

  • You’ve contributed to engineering standards, architecture patterns or platform direction

  • Interest in or exposure to AI-enabled systems, particularly understanding architectural implications in production

Nice To Have_

  • Experience with transit systems or fare payment systems (e.g. tap-to-ride systems)

  • Familiarity with card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard, Interac)

  • Experience working in complex, multi-service or event-driven architectures

  • Familiarity with a range of tools and technologies including:

    • Development: Kotlin, Java

    • Data storage: DynamoDB, MySQL

    • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform, GitLab CI/CD

// You don’t need to have experience in every area listed above. If you bring strong fundamentals, good judgement and a willingness to learn, we’d still love to hear from you.

Some of Our Benefits_

  • 15 days paid vacation in the year plus 18 public holidays

  • Private Healthcare

  • Monthly team bonding allowance

  • Menopause support

  • Choice of a workstation

  • Ability to work for up to 3 months per year from any country in the world

  • Fun and collaborative environment with a focus on making a difference in the world

// In addition to the above, as an employee, you will also have access to a training allowance of up to $750 USD and $250 USD to spend on your home office every year.

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title:** Senior Specialist, Systems Engineer – Satellite Systems Operator (CI Poly)

**Job Code:** 43439

**Job Location:** Palm Bay, Florida

**Job Schedule:** 9/80 (Every Other Friday Off!)

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced Satellite System Operator to support satellite Command and Control (C2), mission operations, ground system configuration, and operator training activities. The successful candidate will perform real-time spacecraft operations while supporting the configuration, validation, execution, and sustainment of satellite and ground system resources.

This position requires hands-on experience with satellite Command and Control operations, preferably involving the Satellite Control Network (SCN), and demonstrated experience configuring ground system resources in support of satellite contacts and mission execution. The Satellite System Operator will work in a dynamic operational environment requiring coordination across engineering, flight dynamics, payload, ground station, and other mission partners.

The operator will conduct and instruct satellite operations across the mission lifecycle, including Launch and Early Operations (LEOPS), routine on-orbit operations, anomaly response, spacecraft recovery, and contingency operations. The position requires the ability to analyze real-time mission data, execute authorized spacecraft commands, identify and troubleshoot anomalous conditions, and maintain accurate operational documentation.

The successful candidate must also be capable of translating operational experience into effective instruction. The operator will support the development, delivery, and refinement of training materials, procedures, and operational documentation as mission capabilities and demonstration events evolve.

This position is in Palm Bay: [https://careers.l3harris.com/en/florida](https://careers.l3harris.com/en/florida)

**Essential Functions:**

•    Demonstrated experience conducting pre-pass, live-pass, and post-pass operations in support of scheduled satellite contacts.

•    Experience issuing spacecraft commands, monitoring command execution, and performing basic telemetry to assess spacecraft health and status.

•    Demonstrated experience identifying, troubleshooting, documenting, and escalating spacecraft or ground-system anomalies, alarms, degradation, and off-nominal conditions.

•    Experience performing real-time data analysis and troubleshooting in a time-sensitive satellite operations environment.

•    Experience with mission planning and scheduling, including coordination of satellite contacts, ground resources, and operational activities.

•    Demonstrated ability to configure, validate, and verify the operational readiness of mission control systems, ground resources, and communications infrastructure.

•    Experience maintaining accurate operational logs, pass reports, mission records, and shift turnover documentation.

•    Demonstrated ability to multitask and maintain situational awareness during real-time operations, including simultaneous monitoring of spacecraft telemetry, ground-system status, mission timelines, and operational communications.

•    Ability to develop, revise, and maintain technical procedures, checklists, training materials, and operational documentation based on mission changes, lessons learned, and demonstration events.

•    Ability to communicate technical and operational information clearly to mission partners, leadership, engineering personnel, and satellite operators.

•    Ability to work independently and as part of an integrated operations team in a multi-agency and mission-partner environment.

**Qualifications:**

•    Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

•    Top Secret/SCI with CI Poly required.

•    Minimum 3 years of experience supporting Launch and Early Operations (LEOPS), space operations, satellite operations, or a related mission environment.

•    Minimum 3 years of experience with spacecraft command authorization, configuration management (spacecraft and ground system), and mission assurance processes.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

•    Direct operational experience with the Satellite Control Network (SCN).

•    Previous experience serving as a satellite operations instructor, evaluator, or trainer.

•    Experience developing or updating operator training materials, mission procedures, checklists, and technical documentation.

•    Experience supporting satellite demonstrations, tests, exercise, or mission rehearsal events.

•    Experience coordinating satellite operations across multiple government agencies, mission partners, ground stations, or operational organizations.

•    Experience supporting spacecraft anomaly resolution, recovery operations, safe-state operations, and other off-nominal mission conditions.

•    Experience integrating changes to spacecraft, mission control, or ground-system configurations into existing operational procedures and training.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Netherlands.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.
    • Strong understanding of sound and rhythm, with the ability to intentionally integrate audio and motion to strengthen the overall creative experience.
    • Comfortable working directly from product UI and collaborating with product designers and other technical or creative stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to advocate for creative decisions, explain the reasoning behind them, and proactively influence projects.
    • Experience experimenting with AI-powered creative and video tools, with genuine curiosity about how emerging technology can improve creative workflows and production.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and taking initiative without requiring fully defined briefs or processes.
    • Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external creative partners.
    • Education is not required; practical experience, creative ability, and demonstrated expertise through your portfolio are valued.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment within the eligible EMEA region.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility motion projects spanning product, brand, web, social, campaigns, and events.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy within a small, collaborative creative team.
      • Opportunity to shape and establish a distinctive motion design system and influence how motion is produced across the broader organization.
      • Exposure to emerging AI and creative technologies as part of everyday design and production workflows.
      • Opportunities to build scalable systems, templates, and tooling that expand your impact beyond individual projects.
      • Inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives, empathy, and authentic contributions.
      • Strong focus on professional growth, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous creative development.

title: Electrical Technician
description:
The Electrical Technician is responsible for the assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and verification of electro-mechanical systems and electrical assemblies. This role supports both manufacturing and engineering activities by performing electrical and mechanical assembly, conducting functional and acceptance testing, documenting results, and ensuring products meet quality, safety, and customer requirements. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret engineering documentation and test procedures.

Job Responsibilities:


Assembly and Manufacturing

  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly of electrical equipment, control panels, cable harnesses, and related systems.
  • Assemble components using engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, work instructions, and bills of materials.
  • Install, wire, route, and terminate electrical components, connectors, relays, switches, sensors, and circuit boards.
  • Perform mechanical assembly operations including mounting hardware, enclosures, brackets, and subassemblies.
  • Identify and report discrepancies in drawings, procedures, or documentation.
  • Support build-to-print quoting activities by evaluating materials, labor requirements, manufacturing process, and production feasibility.
  • Assist in developing accurate cost estimates that support competitive pricing and profitable manufacturing operations.
  • Review product requirements and recommend process improvements to optimize cost and efficiency.

Testing and Verification

  • Conduct functional, performance, and acceptance testing of electrical and electro-mechanical assemblies.
  • Execute test procedures and document results in accordance with quality standards and customer requirements.
  • Utilize test equipment including:
  • Digital multimeters
  • Oscilloscopes
  • Power supplies
  • Signal generators
  • Continuity testers
  • Insulation resistance testers
  • Verify proper operation of electrical systems, assemblies, and completed products.
  • Analyze test data and identify failures, anomalies, or non-conformances.

Troubleshooting and Problem Solving

  • Troubleshoot electrical, wiring, and electro-mechanical issues during assembly and testing.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions on failed assemblies.
  • Collaborate with engineering and quality teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Recommend process improvements to increase quality, efficiency, and reliability.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Accurately complete production, inspection, and test documentation.
  • Maintain records of test results, repairs, and engineering changes.
  • Support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and process updates.
  • Ensure compliance with company quality standards and safety procedures.
