title: Crewing Specialist
description:
Responsibilities

As a Crew Scheduling Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing the allocation of human resources within an organization. Your primary objective will be to ensure that the right number of employees, with the right skills, are available at the right times to meet operational needs and achieve business goals.

You will utilize data analysis, forecasting techniques, and workforce management tools to develop efficient staffing plans and strategies for all seagoing Hotel, Deck and/or Engine personnel. This position works constantly with shipboard workforce planners to ensure short term and long-term planning are aligned. You will closely collaborate with shipboard and shoreside leadership teams to ensure the vessel is always manned with the appropriate talent required to run the onboard Hotel, Deck and/or Engine operation. You will also collaborate with department management on core team schedules.

This position is also responsible for maintaining employee records, working closely with onboarding and travel team. You must be diligent and proactive, ensuring that manning shortage does not occur and if it does it is quickly resolved. You should be able to learn and utilize systems as well as stay current with system enhancements while actively contributing to develop new tools to optimize efficiency of workforce planning.

Essential Functions:

  • Workforce planning: Develop comprehensive workforce plans that align with organizational goals and objectives. Maintain required manning levels fleet wide. Closely liaise with the Hotel, Deck and/or Engine department managers to review core team schedules. Review crew rotations each day and adjust as needed, taking into consideration requests submitted by team members on board and off board.

  • Crew Travel: Responsible for coordinating all crew travel logistics, including booking flights, hotels, and transportation for crew members joining or repatriating. This role ensures timely distribution of tickets and travel arrangements, prepares and sends travel letters to crew, and issues ship notifications regarding crew joining vessels. Additionally, the position performs other job-related duties as assigned by HR management.

  • Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce data including historical trends, turnover rates, productivity metrics, and future projections. Utilize statistical models and forecasting techniques to predict staffing needs and identify potential gaps or surpluses. Ensure that all data related to crew assignments is kept up to date and accurate.

  • Resource Allocation: Determine optimal staffing levels for different departments and job roles based on budget constraints and business priorities. Make recommendation for reallocating resources as needed.

  • Special projects/Dry Docks/Start-Ups: Collaborate with departments and schedule additional crew members based on project needs. Communicate with crew and onboarding team to ensure any additional required documentation is up to date.

  • Compliance: Stay informed about relevant regulations, legal requirements and industry standards related to workforce management. Work closely with onboarding team/recruiters to ensure all newly hired and returning team members are in possession of the required documentation to join their assigned vessels, such as travel documentation, visas, medicals, trainings, licenses etc. Liaise with the travel department in Miami/offshore to arrange for joining flights in accordance with company policies.

  • Communication: Maintain effective communication with shipboard and shoreside teams, onboarding team and team members, responding to emails in timely manner.

  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor workforce performance metrics and evaluate the effectiveness of staffing plans and scheduling strategies. Identify areas for improvement and implement process enhancements to optimize workforce utilization and productivity.

title: Wastewater Supervisor
description:
SUMMARY: The Wastewater Supervisor is responsible for providing management and oversight of wastewater/residuals treatment and disposal operations at the Seaboard Energy renewable diesel production plant in Hugoton, KS to ensure reliable operation and compliance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and permits.

· Participate in regulatory inspections of the wastewater treatment system and support EHS compliance personnel in regulatory reporting and recordkeeping responsibilities.

· Develop, implement, and maintain a formal wastewater operating system program that documents policies and procedures for the wastewater and residuals system.

· Develop objectives and management plans for the wastewater/residual treatment system that align with Seaboard Energy’s strategic goals.

· Develop, train, and coach other plant staff supporting wastewater/residuals operations to grow knowledge and expertise in wastewater/residuals operations and assure compliant 24/7/365 operations.

· Communicate regularly with operations, maintenance, and EHS compliance teams regarding wastewater/residual treatment system performance.

· Maintain complete and compliant recordkeeping practices.

· Drive company goals and initiatives through proven leadership skills and regular communication with plant employees.

· Maintain a safe, clean work environment.

· Participate as a member in the facility response team planning and operations.

· Other duties may be assigned at management’s discretion.

REQUIREMENTS: A successful candidate must possess the ability to perform each essential duty to a satisfactory level. The requirements listed below are representative of the work environment, knowledge, skill, and/or ability required or preferred. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions listed below.

· High school diploma or GED required.

· Wastewater Level II (or higher) Certification required.

· At least 5 years of related experience required.

· Some travel required for training, conferences, to other Seaboard Energy plants, or other purposes.

· Ability to work with hand tools to perform minor maintenance activities required.

· Ability to read, write, and present clear, accurate, and concise reports and business correspondence using standard Microsoft Office programs.

· Must possess the ability to solve problems and evaluate process logistics.

· Ability to effectively communicate with plant management and provide analysis as needed.

Must be able to wear all required safety equipment. Must be able to withstand hot or cold temperatures when working outdoors occasionally.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment varies from an office, plant production, and outside climate conditions, based on the situation. The noise level varies depending on which area of production the employee is working in.

NORMAL WORK SCHEDULE: Days/M-F. The hours and days of work are established by departmental needs and at the discretion of management. Occasional schedule changes may be required as special circumstances arise.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer - Intermediate
description:
Salary: NZD 110000 - 115000 per annum

Quality Assurance Engineer – Intermediate
Permanent | Auckland | Software, Automation & Embedded Systems

If you’re a QA Engineer who enjoys getting beyond the screen and understanding how a product actually works end-to-end, this could be a really interesting next step.
We’re working with an Auckland-based technology company developing sophisticated software and connected hardware products used by large global organisations. Their technology spans application software, touchscreen interfaces, embedded systems and physical hardware, and they’re looking for an Intermediate QA Engineer to join their growing Quality Engineering team.

This is a genuinely hands-on role. You’ll work across manual and automated testing, build and maintain automation, test APIs and user interfaces, and get exposure to embedded systems and hardware-in-the-loop testing. You’ll work closely with software, firmware and hardware engineers to identify issues, improve test coverage and help build products designed for long-term reliability.

What you’ll be doing:
  • Designing and executing manual and automated tests across software, firmware and hardware
  • Building and maintaining automated test suites using tools such as Selenium and Postman
  • Testing APIs, web applications and user interfaces
  • Contributing to regression, functional, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Working with embedded devices and supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing
  • Investigating defects alongside Software, Firmware and Hardware Engineers
  • Contributing automation and test cases into CI/CD environments
  • Using AI-assisted tools to support test-case creation, automation and defect/log analysis
  • Helping improve test coverage, quality practices and the wider QA capability
The role is broad by design — you might be writing automation one day and working with physical test equipment or an embedded device the next.

What we’re looking for:

You’ll already have a few years of commercial QA experience and be comfortable working across both manual and automated testing. You don’t need to arrive as a hardware expert, but you do need to be curious about what sits underneath the software and willing to build that knowledge.

Ideally, you’ll bring:
  • Solid commercial experience across manual and automated software testing
  • Commercial experience with Selenium and Postman
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments
  • Testing experience across at least two of web, Android, iOS or embedded software
  • Scripting capability, ideally Python or similar
  • Strong defect investigation and troubleshooting skills
  • An interest in using AI tools within modern QA and automation practices
  • The ability to manage your own workload and work with a good level of autonomy
Experience with PCBs/components, IoT, embedded C/C++ testing, Jenkins or other CI/CD tooling, hardware-in-the-loop testing or ISTQB would be a bonus rather than an expectation.

Why consider it?

This is a great opportunity if you’ve built a strong foundation in software QA but want to broaden your engineering capability.

You’ll get exposure to the intersection of software, embedded technology and hardware, while working in an environment where automation and AI-assisted testing are becoming an increasingly important part of the quality strategy.

You’ll be joining a technically strong team where you can continue learning from senior QA engineers while having enough autonomy to own your work and contribute ideas.

title: Orthopaedic Surgical Fellow (521985)
description:
Launceston Arthroplasty and Trauma Fellowship

Fellowship Overview - The Role & Team

The Launceston Arthroplasty and Trauma Fellowship is a 12-month post-FRACS fellowship based primarily at Launceston General Hospital (LGH), with additional clinical experience within the private hospital system in Launceston.

The Fellowship provides advanced clinical and operative training in primary and revision hip and knee arthroplasty, complex knee surgery (soft tissue and osteotomy) and orthopaedic trauma, together with opportunities in clinical research, teaching and professional development.

The Fellow will work within the LGH Orthopaedic Unit alongside nine Australian Orthopaedic Association-accredited orthopaedic surgeons. The consultant group has broad lower-limb, upper-limb and trauma expertise, providing exposure to a diverse range of elective and emergency orthopaedic practice.

Clinical and Operative Training

The Fellowship provides substantial operative exposure across both elective and trauma surgery.

Clinical experience will include:

  • Primary hip and knee arthroplasty
  • Complex and revision arthroplasty
  • Knee reconstruction and complex knee pathology
  • Orthopaedic trauma
  • Periprosthetic fractures and complications of arthroplasty
  • Periprosthetic joint infection
  • Pre-operative assessment, surgical decision-making and postoperative management
  • Outpatient assessment and longitudinal follow-up of elective and trauma patients

Education and Teaching

The Fellow will participate in the academic activities of the LGH Orthopaedic Department, including:

  • Weekly orthopaedic radiology/X-ray and clinical meetings
  • Case discussions and operative planning
  • Teaching of orthopaedic trainees, junior medical staff and medical students
  • Departmental educational activities
  • Opportunities to participate in University of Tasmania undergraduate and postgraduate teaching

The Fellowship is intended not only to develop technical surgical expertise, but also clinical judgement, decision-making, leadership, teaching and the skills required for independent consultant practice.

Research

Clinical research is an important component of the Fellowship.

The Fellow will be encouraged to participate in existing research programs and to develop a research project aligned with their own clinical interests. The Launceston Orthopaedic unit has an active research program encompassing arthroplasty, trauma, periprosthetic joint infection, patient-reported outcomes, surgical technology and orthopaedic education.

Research opportunities are supported through collaboration with the University of Tasmania and the Clifford Craig Foundation, as well as participation in multicentre and registry-based research.

The expectation is that the Fellow will contribute meaningfully to at least one research project during the Fellowship, with the aim of presentation at a scientific meeting and, where appropriate, peer-reviewed publication.

Fellowship Objective

The overall objective of the Launceston Arthroplasty and Trauma Fellowship is to provide a broad but individually tailored transition from specialist orthopaedic training to independent consultant practice, with particular expertise in hip and knee arthroplasty, complex knee surgery and orthopaedic trauma.

By completion of the Fellowship, the Fellow should have developed increased operative independence, sound clinical judgement in complex elective and trauma cases, experience in teaching and research, and the skills required to establish and contribute to a high-quality contemporary orthopaedic practice.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. description:

Department: Service

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Reports To: Field Service Supervisor / Shop Manager / Service Manager

General Purpose of the Position:

Repair, recondition, service and assemble equipment for the company and its customers. Perform all work as quickly, efficiently, accurately and completely as possible to ensure customer satisfaction and company profitability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Service/Repair Work
  • Repair, service, recondition, and assemble equipment as assigned by the Service Manager or Shop Manager.

  • Reporting/Record Keeping

Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and the general public.
    Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.

  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Other Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to use reference books, materials, and microfiche.
  • Certification and ability to operate material handling equipment.

The employee frequently is required to walk and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and taste, or smell.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a PL/SR Desenvolvimento Fullstack (Java e React) based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to design, build, and evolve robust, scalable, and highly available solutions impacting millions of users.
You will work across backend and frontend technologies while contributing to the continuous evolution of a complex microservices ecosystem.
The position combines hands-on development with a strong focus on architecture, code quality, observability, and technical sustainability.
You will help maintain a healthy codebase by applying Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and modularization principles while addressing technical debt.
The environment emphasizes high technical complexity, engineering excellence, automated testing, and reliable API-driven solutions.
You will collaborate within agile teams, solve challenging technical problems, and contribute to solutions designed for scale and long-term maintainability.
This is a strong opportunity for a mid-to-senior engineer who wants to make a direct impact on large-scale digital products.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and evolve robust, scalable, and highly available full stack solutions capable of supporting high-volume user environments.
  • Develop backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Node.js with NestJS, while contributing to the evolution of microservices architectures and REST APIs.
  • Contribute to frontend development and integration initiatives, ensuring consistency between application interfaces, APIs, and backend services.
  • Maintain code quality through Clean Code, Clean Architecture, modularization, and effective management of technical debt.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests, including unit tests with JUnit 5 and contract tests using Pact.
  • Work with asynchronous communication and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ and AWS SQS to support reliable distributed architectures.
  • Monitor system health and contribute to observability initiatives using tools such as Dynatrace, identifying issues and supporting continuous improvements in reliability and performance.
  • Participate in agile development practices using Scrum or Kanban, collaborating with other engineers and stakeholders to deliver high-value solutions.
  • Contribute to code versioning and collaborative development practices using Git, while documenting solutions and supporting continuous technical improvement.

    • Requirements

    • Proven professional experience working on technically complex projects and processes, preferably in environments requiring scalability, availability, and strong engineering practices.
    • Solid experience with Java 17+, Spring Boot, and Hibernate in production environments, combined with experience maintaining legacy Java applications from Java 8 onward.
    • Professional experience with Node.js and NestJS, with the ability to contribute effectively to backend development across multiple technologies.
    • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and REST API design, including the ability to build and evolve distributed services.
    • Practical experience with messaging and asynchronous communication technologies such as RabbitMQ and/or AWS SQS.
    • Experience with Axway API Gateway and familiarity with API management in enterprise environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and maintaining automated tests, particularly unit tests with JUnit 5 and contract tests with Pact.
    • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, together with a strong understanding of application health and operational reliability.

    • Familiarity with Next.js, React Hooks, Styled Components, Axios, Microfrontend Architecture (MFE), and the development of reusable screens and components is considered a plus.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on raising the standard for how software is built, tested, delivered, and operated.
You will shape the platform foundations that product teams and AI coding agents rely on to move quickly and reliably.
The role spans developer experience, CI/CD, infrastructure, automated testing, observability, security, and secure software delivery.
You will establish engineering standards, build reusable tooling and golden paths, and help teams adopt workflows that create measurable leverage.
A key focus will be AI harness engineering: designing development environments and engineering systems where AI agents can work effectively and safely.
You will operate as a builder and technical leader, staying close to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and the evolving needs of engineering teams.
This is an opportunity to have organization-wide impact while helping define how modern software teams collaborate with increasingly capable AI agents.

Accountabilities:

  • Shape the platform and infrastructure foundations that product teams build and operate their services on, balancing standardization with team autonomy.
  • Improve the complete engineering development loop, including local development, CI/CD, deployment processes, production feedback, and developer workflows.
  • Define and drive engineering standards for automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and secure software delivery, while helping product teams adopt them effectively.
  • Build shared tooling, templates, reusable components, and golden paths that reduce friction and provide practical leverage across the engineering organization.
  • Own secure delivery practices end to end by integrating security scanning, secrets management, dependency controls, software supply-chain protections, and penetration-testing workflows into core development and delivery pipelines.
  • Monitor and respond to the evolving security landscape, particularly as AI coding agents change how vulnerabilities are introduced, discovered, and potentially exploited.
  • Improve repositories, development conventions, tooling, documentation, test coverage, and feedback loops so AI coding agents can navigate codebases efficiently and produce reliable results.
  • Measure the effectiveness of platform initiatives through DORA metrics and qualitative feedback from engineering teams, using those insights to continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by setting direction while remaining deeply involved in code, infrastructure, automation, and pipeline implementation.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and operating production-grade systems.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and developing internal platforms, with strong judgment around what should be abstracted, exposed, standardized, or left flexible.
    • Deep expertise in CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, developer tooling, and modern software delivery practices.
    • Strong understanding of software security and secure delivery approaches, including shift-left security and SecDevOps principles.
    • Product-oriented mindset toward internal platforms, treating engineers and AI agents as users and measuring whether tooling genuinely improves their productivity.
    • Practical fluency with AI coding agents, including an understanding of how they operate, where they encounter friction, and how engineering environments can be designed to make them more effective.
    • Ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can define strategy while personally contributing to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.
    • Strong systems thinking and the ability to identify organization-wide opportunities for standardization, automation, reliability, and developer productivity.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence product teams and drive adoption of shared engineering practices.
    • Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright and knowledge of how to scale automated testing environments is a strong plus.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment where established processes and playbooks may still be evolving.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to shape the future of software development and AI-assisted engineering.
      • High level of ownership with direct visibility into the impact of your technical decisions.
      • Individual-contributor-focused culture that values engineers who lead through execution and create momentum by building.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with highly experienced AI and software engineering professionals.
      • Global and flexible remote work environment, with an emphasis on results rather than location.
      • Equity participation designed to align individual success with the long-term growth of the organization.
      • Significant opportunity to influence platform strategy, engineering standards, security practices, and AI-enabled development workflows.
      • Inclusive environment committed to diversity and equal opportunity.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
the company is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join the company and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

What we need

We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build and maintain the data models that power analytics and data science across the business. You'll develop robust, scalable dbt pipelines and help evolve our data platform — ensuring data is accessible, trusted, and well-structured.

Our core platform (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow) is established and isn't changing. What is changing is the layer on top: we're rethinking our semantic and BI layer for AI/MCP-driven self-service, so analysts, stakeholders, and AI agents can query trusted metrics directly. You'll help design the models and metric definitions that make that possible.

This is also a role built around AI-assisted development. We expect you to use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as a normal part of writing dbt models, tests, and docs — while still understanding what's happening underneath, so you can catch when the tooling gets it wrong and work effectively without it.

You'll report to the Director of Data Engineering within the Data & Insight team. We're looking for someone detail-oriented, pragmatic, and hands‑on — who takes ownership, moves quickly without cutting corners, and is responsive to user needs.

What you'll work on

Data Modelling & Transformation

  • Build and maintain dbt models, using AI coding assistants to accelerate development while retaining full understanding of the resulting logic
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Design warehouse schemas using dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, SCDs, etc.)
  • Participate in design and code reviews — including reviewing AI-generated code with the same rigour as hand-written code
  • Define and expose models and metrics through our semantic layer, with an eye to how AI agents will consume them via MCP

Testing, Documentation, and CI/CD

  • Implement dbt tests for data quality and accuracy
  • Document models and metric definitions clearly, for both human and AI consumption
  • Use GitHub and CI/CD pipelines, incorporating AI-assisted workflows where they add value

Performance & Architecture

  • Optimise dbt models and SQL queries for performance and maintainability
  • Work with Snowflake on top of a data lake architecture
  • Contribute to evolving our semantic/BI layer toward AI/MCP-driven self‑service

What we're looking for

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience building and optimising complex SQL (joins, window functions, optimisation)
  • Strong grasp of data modelling and warehouse design (Kimball-style)
  • Production dbt experience, including testing and documentation
  • Hands‑on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as a real part of your workflow, not occasional use
  • Strong-enough fundamentals to work confidently without AI assistance and to critically assess AI-generated output
  • Familiarity with version control (GitHub)
  • Able to independently translate business logic into technical implementation
  • Comfortable giving and receiving code review

Desirable - but not required

  • Snowflake experience
  • Semantic layer experience (e.g. Omni, Cube, dbt Semantic Layer)
  • BI tools (e.g. Omni, Tableau, Metabase)
  • Exposure to AI agent tooling / MCP
  • CI/CD for data workflows
  • Python/Airflow familiarity
  • Terraform / IaC

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company‑wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year
  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support
  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month
  • Work‑from‑anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year
  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch‑ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

You will translate business knowledge into reliable contexts, instructions, conversations, and resources that AI agents can effectively use.

Working closely with Commercial, Support, Marketing, Education, BI, Technology, and Product teams, you will help shape the AI roadmap.

You will play a key role in making AI solutions more accurate, scalable, and valuable to the business.

Accountabilities:

title: Director of Finance & Revenue Cycle
description:
Lead Finance. Optimize Revenue. Drive Organizational Performance.

BlueWater Health is seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Finance & Revenue Cycle to serve as the organization's senior financial leader and oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, payroll, benefits administration, financial planning, and revenue integrity.


This is a highly visible leadership role that combines traditional healthcare finance leadership with operational performance improvement and revenue cycle optimization. Reporting directly to executive leadership, the Director will play a critical role in ensuring financial stability, supporting growth initiatives, maximizing reimbursement, and providing the actionable business insights needed to guide organizational decision-making.


The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing financial performance, improving operational workflows, collaborating with physicians and healthcare leaders, and leading teams through change in a dynamic and growing healthcare environment.


About BlueWater Health

BlueWater Health is a physician-owned healthcare organization providing emergency medicine, hospital medicine, critical care, and specialty physician services throughout New England.

We are committed to delivering exceptional clinical care while maintaining a culture of accountability, innovation, and operational excellence. As we continue to grow, we are investing in financial leadership that can help strengthen our infrastructure, improve performance, and support long-term organizational success.


Position Summary

The Director of Finance & Revenue Cycle serves as the organization's senior leader for all financial operations and revenue performance activities.

This position is responsible for ensuring:

  • Financial operations are accurate, compliant, and efficient.
  • Leadership receives timely and actionable financial information.
  • Revenue is properly captured, billed, collected, and reported.
  • Financial risks are identified and managed.
  • Operational leaders are supported with data-driven decision-making tools.
  • BlueWater Health maintains strong financial performance while supporting continued growth.


The Director partners closely with physician leaders, operations teams, external auditors, banking partners, benefits providers, revenue cycle vendors, and partner healthcare facilities to ensure organizational success.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Serve as the organization's senior financial leader and trusted advisor to executive leadership.
  • Lead financial strategy, planning, forecasting, and organizational performance improvement initiatives.
  • Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support growth opportunities, new service lines, and operational decision-making.
  • Develop and monitor key organizational performance indicators.


Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Oversee all accounting operations, financial reporting, and general ledger activities.
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
  • Ensure strong internal controls, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.
  • Maintain multi-entity financial reporting and organizational accounting integrity.


Revenue Cycle & Revenue Integrity

Serve as BlueWater Health's operational leader for revenue integrity and revenue cycle performance. This is done in collaboration with our outsourced Revenue Cycle Vendor.

Responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing revenue cycle performance from registration through final payment collection.
  • Monitoring revenue capture, coding accuracy, documentation integrity, denials, and reimbursement performance.
  • Identifying and eliminating revenue leakage opportunities.
  • Leading revenue cycle performance improvement initiatives across the organization.
  • Providing oversight of Charts Not Received (CNR) and Requests for Additional Information (RAI) processes.
  • Monitoring and ensuring provider enrollment with payors through our third-party RCM vendor.
  • Developing reporting and accountability systems focused on:
    • Days in Accounts Receivable
    • Net Collection Rates
    • Denial Rates
    • Charge Lag
    • Coding Turnaround Time
    • Revenue Recovery Opportunities
  • Partnering with physicians, facilities, and revenue cycle vendors to optimize financial performance.


Payroll, Benefits & Compensation Administration

  • Provide organizational oversight of payroll operations for physicians, APPs, and staff.
  • Ensure accurate administration of physician compensation and productivity-based compensation models.
  • Oversee benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  • Monitor payroll and benefits costs, trends, and compliance requirements.


Contract & Operational Performance

  • Monitor financial performance across facilities, contracts, and service lines.
  • Analyze margins, staffing expenses, provider productivity, and reimbursement trends.
  • Support contract negotiations, financial modeling, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Develop executive dashboards and performance reporting tools.


Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop finance, accounting, payroll, and revenue cycle personnel.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Utilize automation, analytics, and emerging AI technologies to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that strengthen organizational performance.


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Seven or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare finance, accounting, revenue cycle management, or related disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, physician practice finance, and revenue cycle operations.
  • Experience leading budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and operational analysis functions.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional teams and organizational initiatives.
  • Advanced analytical, communication, and leadership skills.


Preferred

  • CPA, MBA, MHA, HFMA certification, or comparable advanced credential.
  • Experience in physician-owned healthcare organizations, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, or multi-site healthcare enterprises.
  • Experience overseeing outsourced billing and coding relationships.
  • Knowledge of provider compensation methodologies
  • Experience leveraging data analytics, automation, and AI tools in financial operations.


Why BlueWater Health?

This is an opportunity to serve as the senior financial leader of a growing healthcare organization and make a direct impact on operational performance, financial strategy, and organizational growth.


BlueWater Health offers:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Hybrid work flexibility
  • Best in class employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • Retirement plan with employer contribution
  • Generous paid time off
  • Professional development support
  • A collaborative and physician-led culture focused on innovation and excellence


Join Our Team

If you are a healthcare finance leader who thrives on solving complex challenges, improving organizational performance, and building financially strong healthcare organizations, we encourage you to apply.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer - India
description:
About the Role

As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in NinjaOne's global Platform Engineering organization, partnering closely with our US-based Platform Engineering team to support production software deployments and drive the evolution of our deployment platform.

This role has two primary areas of responsibility:

  • Production Deployment Engineering – sharing ownership of production deployments and release operations across our SaaS platform to ensure reliable, predictable, and high-quality software releases.
  • Deployment Automation & Platform Engineering – designing and implementing automated deployment solutions that eliminate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and enable engineering teams to deliver software faster and more safely.

As part of our growing Singapore engineering team, you'll help provide expanded operational coverage for global production deployments while creating additional capacity for the broader Platform Engineering organization to focus on strategic initiatives and platform modernization.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll collaborate closely with Software Engineering, SRE, QA, Product Management, Release Management, and Security teams to build scalable, secure, and highly automated software delivery platforms.

Location – Hybrid, Singapore

What You’ll be Doing

Production Deployment & Release Engineering

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of software deployments into production environments, ensuring high availability, minimal downtime, and predictable releases.
  • Share ownership of production deployment operations with the US Platform Engineering team, providing global coverage and operational continuity across production environments.
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, QA, Release Managers, and Product teams to plan, coordinate, and execute production software releases, maintenance windows, and emergency deployments while ensuring deployment readiness, operational stability, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Develop and maintain deployment standards, release readiness processes, rollback procedures, and operational playbooks.
  • Lead post-release reviews and drive continuous improvements that increase deployment reliability and reduce operational risk.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point during complex production deployments and critical release activities.

Deployment Engineering & Automation

  • Design and implement automated deployment solutions that improve software delivery speed, consistency, and reliability.
  • Build reusable deployment frameworks, standardized deployment workflows, and self-service deployment capabilities.
  • Lead CI/CD modernization initiatives using CircleCI and related technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational work through automation and engineering solutions.
  • Improve deployment frequency, release quality, and engineering efficiency through continuous process improvements.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to DevOps engineers and software engineering teams.
  • Drive engineering best practices, deployment standards, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with Architecture, Engineering, and Platform leadership on strategic platform initiatives.
  • Communicate project status, technical risks, and delivery milestones to stakeholders and leadership.

About You

  • 7–10+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Build & Release Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers.
  • Strong experience supporting and automating production software deployments in cloud environments.
  • Deep expertise building enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
  • Experience managing artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory.
  • Experience designing deployment automation, release orchestration, and software delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, pull request processes, and release management.
  • Strong scripting or programming experience using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-have:

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  • Experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience integrating DevSecOps capabilities including SAST, SCA, DAST, SBOM generation, secrets management, and policy enforcement.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity and DORA metrics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (preferred).

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

  • We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community
  • We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week
  • We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement
  • Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation
  • Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

Additional Information

Applicants must hold valid working rights in India at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with the Constitution of India (Articles 14, 15, and 16) and applicable labor legislation, including the Code on Wages, 2019 and the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act). All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer - Sell Side Engine
description:

This is a highly hands-on Staff Engineer role focused on solving complex technical problems within a rapidly scaling energy technology environment.
You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth.
The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed.
You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms.

title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT Basic)
description:
Allegiance Mobile Health of Corpus Christi, TX is looking to hire Emergency Medical Technicians (EMT-B).

SUMMARY: Allegiance Mobile Health is looking for a compassionate and reliable EMT-Basic to provide essential pre-hospital care and emergency medical assistance. The EMT-B will respond to 911 calls, assess patient conditions, perform basic life support procedures, and assist in patient transport and transfer. This role requires strong communication, a calm demeanor under pressure, and a commitment to patient care.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Responsibilities include, but not limited to)

  • Responds to emergency and non-emergency calls 24 hours per day, drives a variety of emergency vehicles in all road conditions including inclement weather, dense traffic and rural off-road settings.
  • Reads map books and follows written and verbal directions in order to respond in an efficient and safe manner.
  • Follows all departmental, local and state driving laws, policies and procedures.
  • Uses a variety of communication equipment and appropriately communicates verbally to dispatchers, EMS crews, first responders and other organizations according to departmental policies and procedures.
  • Maintains vehicles and equipment in a constant state of readiness and cleanliness.
  • Completes daily vehicle and supply checklists and assists with vehicle re-supply, vehicle and equipment decontamination and general readiness-related tasks.
  • Immediately reports, in writing, any discrepancies with vehicles, supplies or equipment and their state of readiness.
  • Provides direct patient care per Medical Director's authorization and protocols.
  • Demonstrates clinical competency in all patient care related instances.
  • Demonstrates physical competencies sufficient to allow him/her to lift, carry, transport and extricate patients in all settings, in some cases without assistance.
  • Interacts with multiple outside agencies such as Police Departments, Fire Departments and First Responder Organizations. Provides satisfactory customer service and projects professionalism in all contacts.
  • Successfully and accurately completes patient care reports, billing information and all other associated documentation in a timely manner.
  • Works under physically and psychologically taxing conditions to include inclement weather, temperature extremes, hazardous environments, loud noises and high-stress situations. High potential for exposure to blood-borne pathogens, dangerous chemicals, sharp objects and fall/trip hazards.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to include general housekeeping chores and special projects.
  • Must successfully pass departmental skills evaluation and fully complete NEOP process before staffing a truck.
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Lift, carry, balance and push up to 125 pounds (250 pounds with assistance).
  • Demonstrate flexibility and physical coordination by bending from the waist and touching toes, squat with legs parallel to the ground and kneeling with both knees firmly on the ground.
  • Climb 20 sets of stairs without rest within 60 seconds.
  • Demonstrate fine manual dexterity by performing job related clinical skills (starting IV's, intubating, etc.).
  • Have correctable vision adequate to read street signs, see in low light and read small print.

PSYCHOLOGICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Use good judgment and remain calm in high-stress situations.
  • Maintain a positive attitude in the face of adversity.
  • Have good interpersonal and conflict resolution skills.
  • Function under situations of extreme fatigue due to little or no rest, extreme temperatures and inclement weather conditions.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

•     High school graduate or GED.
•     Certified as an EMT in the State of Texas
•     CPR certification
•     911 Areas – Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support (PHTLS) or International Trauma Life Support (ITLS).
•     Communicate effectively
•     Read, write, and interpret instructions in the English language
•     Previous experience preferred in emergency care
•     Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and an insurable driver record.

Allegiance is an EEO employer as defined by the EEOC.

title: Clinical Informatics Integrator
description:

2026-4699

You will manage informatics projects from planning through delivery, tracking cost, schedule, and performance and keeping risks visible so OCI can make timely decisions. The role supports both the Interoperability and Clinical Informatics Solutions specialty areas, including health information exchange, Electronic Health Record (EHR) issue management, clinical content standardization, and the Federal EHR transition.   • Risk and Issue Management. Identify, document, and mitigate project risks and issues, and maintain risk registers using the ROAM method.
  • SAFe Delivery. Apply SAFe Lean-Agile principles; support Planning Interval (PI) Planning, program boards, ART Sync, system demos, and Inspect and Adapt.
  • Dependency Management. Track dependencies across teams, Agile Release Trains, and the Interoperability, Clinical Informatics Solutions, and Integration contractor teams.
  • Staffing and Onboarding. Coordinate staffing, onboarding, and system access for project teams, including staff roster updates after each PI Planning.
  • Status Reporting. Prepare biweekly sprint reports in Jira and Jira Align covering completed stories, PI objective progress, risks, impediments, and dependencies.
  • Level-of-Effort Estimation. Support estimates of the level of effort and labor categories needed for Features selected in PI Planning.
  • Stakeholder Coordination. Coordinate with OCI Product Management, VA Business Owners, and technical teams to keep priorities and delivery aligned.
  • Quality and Compliance. Confirm project work meets acceptance criteria, VA privacy and security requirements, and artifact management standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience with health information exchange or interoperability projects.
  • Experience supporting VA or another federal health care program.
  • Experience with Jira, Jira Align, or Microsoft Project.
  • Master’s degree.

title: NX Developer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains internal systems, applications, and infrastructure across the enterprise. We are looking for an NX Developer to join our team and develop customizations, automation, and administrative tooling for our Siemens NX CAD environment.

About the Role

Anduril's engineers design and build autonomous systems that protect those who serve. Behind every model, drawing, and assembly is the Siemens NX environment that makes rapid iteration possible. As an NX Developer on the Engineering Systems and Tools team, you'll be the person who makes that environment faster, smarter, and more reliable — building custom automation, tooling, and integrations that let our mechanical and electrical engineers focus on the work that matters instead of fighting their tools. You'll write real code (NXOpen API, Python, C++), own the full lifecycle of internal developer tools, and work directly with the engineers who depend on them. This isn't IT support - it's product development for an internal user base that's building things that actually matter.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain NX Open API customizations (NX Open C/C++, NX Open Python, NX Open .NET) to automate repetitive design tasks and enforce engineering standards
  • Build and manage NX CAD administrative tools including templates, part families, reuse libraries, and check-mate rules to ensure consistency across the engineering organization
  • Create custom NX dialogs, menus, and toolbars that streamline workflows for mechanical and electrical design teams
  • Develop journal-based automation scripts and NX Open applications to accelerate modeling, drafting, and BOM generation processes
  • Collaborate with PLM engineers to ensure seamless NX–Teamcenter integration in managed mode, including classification, naming rules, and revision workflows
  • Work with a high-functioning team of solution engineers and cross-functional teams with an emphasis on finishing business-critical projects
  • Help troubleshoot NX technical issues including those related to deployment, site configuration, custom toolkit distribution, and ongoing end-user support

Who You Are:
Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology startup that is rapidly scaling itself. Our culture is one of ambition, hard work, relentless pursuit of excellence, and deliberate disruption. The successful candidate will be one who demonstrates the follow core characteristics:

  • Outcome-Oriented - they determine what benefits the business needs and work backwards from those outcomes. The antiquated IT concept of “system availability” is abhorrent to the ideal candidate, they care about if the business actually got value from their product, not if it was just made to specification
  • Customer Focused - they display user empathy to boost engagement and build experiences that delight
  • Strong Product Sense - they know when in the product’s lifecycle to focus on optimizing the end user experience and when to focus on enterprise-level functionality
  • Dive Deep - they sweat the details and roll up their sleeves to uncover the root causes for systemic issues, be it technical shortfalls or lack of user comprehension of a product
  • Ownership - they care deeply not just about their products, but for all the business outcomes that their systems supports as well, holding themselves accountable for everything it both does and fails to do
  • Agility - they change directions easily and without regret, quickly adapting to shifting business priorities
  • First Principles Thinking - they approach problems and develop solutions not based on what a vendor recommends or because it’s how they did things at their last job, but from a deep appreciation of what is best for the enterprise
  • Exceptional strategic problem-solving capabilities - adept at navigating complex technical trade-offs

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a CAD development role, ideally in a fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environment
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical degree
  • Proficiency in NX Open API development using one or more of: C/C++, Python, Java, or .NET (C#/VB.NET)
  • Hands-on experience with NX CAD administration including templates, drafting standards, part families, reuse libraries, and role-based configurations
  • Experience creating and maintaining NX journaling scripts and custom automation toolkits
  • Strong understanding of CAD data management concepts including naming conventions, revision control, and BOM structures
  • Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints

Preferred QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Siemens Teamcenter integration in NX managed mode, including classification, workflows, and naming rules
  • Familiarity with NX Check-Mate for automated design validation and quality checks
  • Experience with NX deployment and site-level configuration (ugii_env, custom directories, toolkit distribution)
  • Knowledge of GRIP or KF (Knowledge Fusion) programming within NX
  • Experience integrating CAD tools with downstream systems (PLM, ERP, MES, etc.)
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve user issues, and work autonomously to solve problems
US Salary Range
$140,000—$186,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. title: People Lead - eShepherd
description:
Why Gallagher?

Gallagher is a global technology business with more than 85 years behind it, but eShepherd is building something very different from a traditional corporate environment and we’re growing quickly.

You'll be joining a high-growth part of the business that's scaling across markets, teams and functions. Things move quickly, priorities evolve and not everything is figured out yet. That's part of the excitement of this opportunity.

We need people who are comfortable with that pace - people who can look around corners, challenge the status quo and get stuck in when there's work to do.

Alongside a competitive salary and annual performance bonus, you'll enjoy:

  • Office-first working with flexibility where it works (minimum 3 days in the office a week, with additional onsite days required depending on work demands)

  • Free onsite parking, a subsidised café and great local eateries

  • KiwiSaver on-top and Life and Disability insurance

  • Mentorship and professional development opportunities

  • A supportive team culture with team-building events, creative inspiration trips and a fun environment

About Gallagher

At Gallagher, we're building technology that protects what matters most. Our products are used in more than 160 countries, and our Animal Management business is taking that global reach into the future of agriculture.

eShepherd is a fast-growing, globally distributed technology business within Gallagher. Its teams span countries, functions and time zones, with ambitious plans for further growth.

That growth brings some meaty People challenges - how and where to build teams, what capability we need next, how to scale talent, how to navigate change and how to make good decisions when there isn't an obvious answer.

That's where you come in.

The Opportunity – A senior People role in the middle of the action

As People Lead – eShepherd, you'll report to our Global People Lead – Animal Management and partner directly with the eShepherd leadership team on the people decisions that will shape the next stage of the business.

You'll lead workforce planning, organisational design, talent and capability discussions, while providing senior-level advice on change and complex people matters.

But this isn't a role for someone who wants to sit back and advise from the sidelines.

You'll also get involved - whether that's working through an organisational change, helping solve a difficult people issue, figuring out where a team should grow, building a talent pipeline or personally getting into a critical hire.

You'll be working across New Zealand, Australia and other international teams, so you'll need to be comfortable navigating different markets, cultures and time zones. We're looking for someone with the experience and confidence to influence senior leaders, the judgement to operate in ambiguity, and the willingness to roll up their sleeves and get things done.

If you've worked in a global, technology, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment, and you enjoy solving problems that don't come with a ready-made playbook, we'd like to hear from you.

You'll be responsible for

  • Leading strategic workforce planning and talent scaling

  • Partnering with senior leaders on organisational design, capability and team development

  • Supporting organisational change and complex employment relations matters

  • Shaping critical hiring, talent pipelines and recruitment strategy when required

  • Using people, talent and market insights to inform business decisions

  • Building scalable, practical people processes as the organisation grows

  • Working across regions, cultures and time zones to deliver globally aligned solutions

The Fit

You're an experienced senior People professional who has operated in a complex, changing environment before. You can hold your own with senior leaders, think commercially and strategically, and still get into the weeds when the situation calls for it.

You'll bring:

  • Significant senior People, HRBP, People Lead or broad generalist experience

  • Strong workforce planning and talent scaling experience

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders in a high-growth, changing or complex environment

  • Experience across organisational design, change and employment relations

  • Strong talent acquisition and hands-on recruitment capability

  • Experience working across global teams, markets and time zones

  • A practical, commercially minded and collaborative approach

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a genuine progress over perfection mindset

Agritech experience isn't essential. Experience in a global, technology, scale-up or similarly complex environment is more important.

If you're looking for a senior People role where you can genuinely influence the direction of a growing global business - and you're not afraid to get your hands dirty - we'd like to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

title: DCS System Engineer
description:
Your impact begins here

As a DCS System Engineer, you will help ensure the stability, security, and future readiness of critical automation systems supporting large-scale API manufacturing. Working with ABB 800xA Distributed Control Systems (DCS), you will play an important role in maintaining reliable operations while contributing to a major investment project with significant business impact. Your expertise will help strengthen industrial IT infrastructure, enable efficient production processes, and support the delivery of high-quality solutions in a regulated environment. This is an opportunity to combine technical depth with cross-functional collaboration while helping shape the future of manufacturing technology.

What you'll bring

You have hands-on experience with ABB 800xA systems and enjoy solving complex technical challenges in industrial environments. You combine a structured mindset with strong collaboration skills and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We expect you to bring:

  • A BSc or MSc degree in IT, Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience working with ABB 800xA platform configuration, operation, support, or application development.
  • Strong knowledge of DCS and Operational Technology (OT) architectures, including servers, clients, connectivity, user administration, backup solutions, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting integrations between automation systems and surrounding IT/OT platforms, including data flows, interfaces, signal handling, and system connectivity.
  • An understanding of change control, testing, documentation, and compliance requirements within regulated industries.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

It would be advantageous if you have experience working in pharmaceutical manufacturing or another highly regulated production environment.

What you'll do

In this role, you will help maintain and develop critical DCS solutions that support production operations and business objectives.

You will:

  • Support the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of ABB 800xA systems.
  • Configure and maintain platform components, applications, user access, system settings, and related interfaces.
  • Support integrations between ABB 800xA and surrounding systems, including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), SAP/EWM, Process Analytical Technology (PAT), and PI solutions.
  • Troubleshoot incidents, performance issues, system errors, and interface-related challenges to ensure stable operations.
  • Participate in upgrades, patches, system releases, backup and restore activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure documentation, testing, validation, and change management activities are completed in compliance with cGMP, GAMP, data integrity requirements, and relevant industry standards.

Who you'll work with

You will join the IT & Automation and Robotics department in Kalundborg, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are central to how we work. The team supports major investment projects and critical production systems, helping ensure reliable and scalable automation solutions across manufacturing operations.

You will work closely with automation specialists, infrastructure engineers, project teams, production stakeholders, and external vendors. Success in this role depends on building strong relationships across functions and contributing to a culture where expertise, curiosity, and teamwork drive results.

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Project Director, Tinne Heggelund Bonde at THEB@novonordisk.com.

What you can expect here

At Novo Nordisk, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technologies in an environment where your expertise directly contributes to reliable manufacturing and long-term business success. You will be encouraged to develop your technical capabilities, share knowledge with colleagues, and take ownership of meaningful challenges.

You can expect a collaborative working environment where diverse perspectives are valued and where continuous learning is supported. We believe that great results are created through strong partnerships, mutual respect, and a shared ambition to improve how we work and deliver value.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use your ABB 800xA expertise to strengthen critical automation systems and support the future of manufacturing technology, apply for the DCS System Engineer role in Kalundborg by the 11th of October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer based in Germany.

This role sits within a high-ownership creative team shaping how a global technology brand moves across digital experiences and campaigns.
You will create motion across product, web, social, events, and marketing while helping establish a distinctive visual motion language.
The position combines hands-on craft with systems thinking, giving you the opportunity to make future motion work faster and more scalable.
You will collaborate closely with brand designers, product teams, marketing, social, web, and external creative partners.
A key part of the role is translating UI frames and creative briefs into polished stories, animations, and engaging product experiences.
You will also explore emerging tools, including AI-powered workflows, to expand creative possibilities and enable others to produce high-quality motion independently.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior designer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and brings both creative vision and strong execution.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce high-quality motion work across product explainers, website animations, paid social content, keynote and event experiences, campaign assets, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Transform UI frames and product concepts into polished product demonstrations and feature explainers, ensuring that animation clearly communicates functionality, value, and user experience.
  • Develop straightforward storyboards independently when appropriate, enabling projects to move efficiently from concept to production without unnecessary handoffs.
  • Help define and evolve a distinctive motion design language by creating branded patterns, timing principles, transitions, and visual behaviors that establish consistency across digital surfaces.
  • Build reusable motion systems, including guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files, enabling designers, social teams, and other partners to create high-quality work independently.
  • Explore and implement tools such as Jitter, Figma Motion, and emerging AI-powered video technologies to improve creative workflows and expand the team's capabilities.
  • Produce short-form video variations for paid social testing, adapting concepts across different formats, messages, and creative angles.
  • Develop recurring product video formats into scalable templates that can be reused efficiently across future product launches.
  • Collaborate closely with brand design, design operations, product marketing, product design, web, social, and external agencies to deliver cohesive creative work.
  • Bring motion expertise proactively into creative and stakeholder discussions, clearly explaining the strategic reasoning behind creative choices and helping partners understand the role of motion.
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing by testing new creative technologies and sharing effective workflows and learnings with the wider team.

    • Requirements

    • Significant professional experience in motion design, ideally within brand, product, digital, marketing, or technology-focused creative environments, with a portfolio demonstrating strong motion craft and storytelling.
    • Strong ability to transform brand briefs, UI frames, and product concepts into compelling visual stories that communicate clearly and engage audiences.
    • Deep understanding of motion principles, including timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, transitions, and visual personality, with the ability to create work that feels distinctive rather than generic.
    • Strong understanding of brand and UI design, with the ability to balance expressive creative direction with functional product communication.
    • Excellent storytelling and narrative instincts, including the ability to structure motion through setup, tension, resolution, pacing, and intentional moments of emphasis.
    • Strong systems-thinking mindset and experience creating reusable motion guidelines, component libraries, templates, or other tools that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.
    • Strong understanding of sound and rhythm, with the ability to intentionally integrate audio and motion to strengthen the overall creative experience.
    • Comfortable working directly from product UI and collaborating with product designers and other technical or creative stakeholders.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to advocate for creative decisions, explain the reasoning behind them, and proactively influence projects.
    • Experience experimenting with AI-powered creative and video tools, with genuine curiosity about how emerging technology can improve creative workflows and production.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and taking initiative without requiring fully defined briefs or processes.
    • Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external creative partners.
    • Education is not required; practical experience, creative ability, and demonstrated expertise through your portfolio are valued.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment within the eligible EMEA region.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility motion projects spanning product, brand, web, social, campaigns, and events.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy within a small, collaborative creative team.
      • Opportunity to shape and establish a distinctive motion design system and influence how motion is produced across the broader organization.
      • Exposure to emerging AI and creative technologies as part of everyday design and production workflows.
      • Opportunities to build scalable systems, templates, and tooling that expand your impact beyond individual projects.
