title: NCPR EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGIST
description:
Introduce Soitec and context of the position

How does something you do not see improve your daily life? This is what our products do and they are in your smartphones, cars, and connected objects. They make them more efficient and less energy intensive. We are passionate about innovation in technology and proud of the value we create for our customers. At Soitec, we are also in a state of transformation: cultural, managerial and digital. We want to make our company an organization where freedom of action and accountability guide our actions. Do you want to change things or test a new idea? If so, what are you waiting for? It is time to come to Soitec!

What does the job consist?

  • Maintenance
  • Routine inspections: Technicians conduct regular checks to ensure equipment is running efficiently and to identify potential issues before they become major problems.
  • Preventive maintenance: Performing tasks to prevent breakdowns, such as lubricating parts, replacing worn-out components, and updating software.
  • Cleaning equipment: Ensuring that machinery or devices are clean to avoid malfunctions or inefficiency.
  • Repairs and Troubleshooting
  • Diagnose issues: When equipment or systems malfunction, technicians diagnose the cause of the problem, using tools like diagnostic software, sensors, or manual inspection.
  • Repair or replace parts: Fix faulty components or replace broken parts to restore functionality.
  • Test repairs: After making repairs, technicians test the equipment to ensure it is working properly.
  • Documentation
  • Record keeping: Technicians maintain detailed records of inspections, repairs, maintenance, and upgrades.
  • Reports: They may generate reports on the status of equipment or any issues encountered, providing recommendations for further action or replacement.
  • Testing and Quality Assurance
  • Performing tests: Technicians test systems and devices after installation or repair to ensure they meet the required standards.
  • Monitoring system performance: In FDC to ensure optimal performance and troubleshoot issues when performance dips.
  • Health & Safety Compliance
  • Adherence to safety regulations: Technicians must follow safety standards and guidelines to ensure they and others are safe while working on equipment or in potentially hazardous environments.
  • Use of protective equipment: Technicians might need to wear safety gear such as gloves, goggles, or ear protection, depending on the nature of their work.

Senior Technician typically holds a more experienced and specialised role compared to a general technician. While they perform many of the same tasks, their responsibilities often include leadership, advanced problem-solving, and more complex tasks that require a higher level of expertise.

1 plats(er).

Tjänsten har följande krav:

• tre-årig gymnasieutbildning, helst med datateknisk inriktning
• tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom IT området

• tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i kommun
• tidigare erfarenhet av support av mobila enheter såsom iPads och mobiltelefoner.
• B-körkort

Som person söker vi dig som har förmågan att arbeta med andra människor; att lyssna, visa empati och respekt. Du är prestigelös och uppmärksammar och belönar andras bidrag. Vi ser att du kan analysera och bedöma olika typer av data för att dra väl genomtänkta slutsatser samt för att skapa fungerande lösningar.

Du har en hög förmåga att leverera resultat, både vad gäller kvalitet och produktivitet. Du arbetar på ett systematiskt, metodiskt och pålitligt sätt och du har lätt för att fokusera på kundens behov och uppnå god kundtillfredsställelse. Avslutningsvis ser vi även att du har förmågan att följa instruktioner, procedurer, lagstadgade krav och policy samt förhålla dig till uppsatta tidsplaner.

Varför ska du jobba i Mjölby Kommun?

Vi är stora nog att erbjuda medarbetare goda arbetsvillkor och spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter. Liten nog för nära samarbeten, delaktighet och inflytande. Alldeles lagom, helt enkelt.

Vår kommun är expansiv med cirka 28 900 invånare. Vi har nära till varandra och nära till resten av världen, kommunikationerna är utmärkta.

Mjölby kommuns vision sammanfattas i en slogan: Världsvan och hemkär. Världsvan står för öppenhet, nytänkande, vilja att växa och tro på framtiden. Hemkär står för stolthet och glädje över hembygden. Hos oss är det enkelt att leva ett gott liv.

title: Default Template
description:

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Intern, you'll help drive our growth in Singapore: building, shipping, and delivering results from day one. You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. If you thrive in a fast-moving, build-from-scratch environment, this role is for you.

What you’ll own:

  • Support the operational onboarding process for new F&B merchants onto the qlub platform

  • Assist in organizing and coordinating training sessions for merchants to ensure they can fully utilize Qlub’s services

  • Help build and maintain strong relationships with our merchants, assisting them with their queries and optimizing their usage of our platform

  • Work closely with the operations and product teams to provide feedback and support improvements to our services

  • Assist with monitoring platform integrations and reporting on merchant usage

Who you are:

  • You've done this before in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

  • You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information

  • You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator

  • You're energized by hard problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience


What you’ll need:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in Business, Operations, Hospitality, or a related field

  • Passionate about technology, startups, and the F&B industry

  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills

  • Great communicator with the ability to work with both internal teams and external partners

  • Eager to learn, hands-on, and willing to take on new challenges

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment


Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, fintech, hospitality tech, or a high-growth marketplace

What we offer

• Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally

• The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience

• A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality

• Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts

• A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: Cybersecurity/RMF Lead
description:
Summary

Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a Cybersecurity / RMF Lead to lead security authorization for a cloud-hosted maintenance management platform, including IL4/IL5 control implementation, RMF/ATO evidence, CUI protection and NIST SP 800-171 compliance, continuous monitoring and incident reporting. This is an immediate opening.

Essential Functions

  • Prepare and manage the security authorization package (SSP, POA&M and control evidence) in coordination with the Mission Owner and Authorizing Official.
  • Implement identity, access and data controls (CAC/PIV federation, role separation, audit records and secrets management).
  • Define operational technology (OT) segmentation for sensors, gateways and building controllers.
  • Run vulnerability management, continuous monitoring and required incident reporting.
  • Maintain NIST SP 800-171 evidence and support CMMC assessments.
  • Deliver security awareness content for technicians and administrators.
  • Run vulnerability scans on a regular, defined schedule and track remediation to closure.
  • Review audit logs and security alerts and investigate suspicious activity.
  • Perform security impact analysis on proposed system changes.

Competencies

  • RMF/ATO package development
  • DoD cybersecurity controls
  • Risk assessment and continuous monitoring
  • Clear security communication and training
  • Audit log review and threat analysis

Supervisory Responsibility

None required for this position

Work Environment

Remote or office-based, computer-focused work, with periodic on-site travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lb.
  • Occasional walking of buildings and mechanical spaces during on-site security walkdowns.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

Full-time and part-time positions available. Typical hours are Monday through Friday, daytime.

Travel

Periodic travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky, for authorization meetings and operational technology walkdowns.

Experience

  • 7+ years of DoD cybersecurity experience.
  • 3+ years leading RMF/ATO packages (eMASS) through authorization.
  • Authored ATO packages that were granted.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Government or equivalent cloud security tooling.

Preferred:

  • NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC assessments.
  • Army authorization processes.
  • OT/IoT security (NIST SP 800-82).
  • Experience with ACAS/Nessus vulnerability scanning and DISA STIGs.
  • Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk).
  • Experience working on Department of Defense (DoD) installations, contracts or programs is a plus.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems or a related field.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • CISSP or CISM (DoD 8140 IAM Level II/III) required.
  • CompTIA Security+ required at minimum.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and obtain installation access.

Drug Free Workplace

All Native Group is a Drug Free Workplace. It is our policy that all new hires must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screen as a condition of employment. In addition, all employees are subject to random drug screens throughout the term of their employment with All Native Group.

Security Clearance

None

AAP/EEO Statement

All Native Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. However, preference may be extended to persons of Indian descent in accordance with applicable laws.

About Ho-Chunk, Inc. & All Native Group

Ho-Chunk, Inc. is an award-winning economic development corporation of the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska. Our mission is to provide long-term economic development for the Winnebago Tribe and job opportunities for Tribal members.

All Native Group is a network of small businesses that support the critical missions of various U.S. Government customers. Our capabilities include telecommunications, health, logistics, specialized training, professional services, and IT solutions. Since earning our first federal contract in 2004, we have continued to grow and diversify our services while maintaining a strong commitment to excellence. As a tribally owned organization, All Native Group operates multiple subsidiary businesses, providing clients with the advantages of working with a small business while leveraging the resources and expertise of a larger, established company. Our work is guided by our core NATIVE values:

  • Accountable – To always do what’s right.
  • Team-Focused – For inclusive progress.
  • Innovative – In creating solutions.
  • Visionary – In our purpose and direction.

Other Duties

title: Tech Lead - Payments and Billing
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Lead – Payments and Billing based in Germany.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building the next generation of payments infrastructure for a rapidly scaling energy platform. You’ll lead a newly established Payments squad responsible for a critical billing and payments service, with direct influence over reliability, scalability, accuracy, and processing costs. You’ll set the technical direction while remaining deeply involved in design, code reviews, architecture, and solving complex engineering problems alongside the team. The role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, architecture, coaching, and operational problem-solving. You’ll work with a team of experienced and developing engineers, establishing ways of working that balance speed, quality, and resilience. It’s an opportunity to shape a core financial system from an early stage and grow it into infrastructure capable of supporting significant transaction volumes.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the overall delivery outcomes of the Payments squad, ensuring the team consistently delivers reliable, high-quality software and maintains strong engineering standards.

  • Set the technical and architectural direction for the payments domain, transforming an existing functional service into infrastructure designed for significant future scale.

  • Lead from the front by writing technical specifications and design documents, reviewing architecture decision records and pull requests, and contributing directly to implementation.

  • Solve the most complex technical problems alongside the engineering team while maintaining a clear long-term technical vision.

  • Establish the squad’s operating model, defining effective ways of working and balancing delivery speed with quality, resilience, and maintainability.

  • Drive improvements in payment accuracy and processing efficiency, with a direct focus on reducing the cost of processing transactions as volumes increase.

  • Identify and resolve technical blockers that could prevent the squad from delivering effectively, rather than simply escalating or reporting them.

  • Manage technical sequencing, cross-team dependencies, and delivery priorities while ensuring the squad’s progress and challenges remain visible to relevant stakeholders.

  • Diagnose throughput and delivery issues, identify their underlying causes, and implement structural improvements.

  • Coach junior engineers and work closely with senior engineers to raise technical quality, development speed, and engineering consistency across the squad.

  • Define and communicate what good engineering looks like through hands-on collaboration, design reviews, code reviews, and continuous feedback.

  • Partner with management on hiring and promotion decisions by identifying capability gaps and providing technical input, while formal people management remains with the designated manager.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven experience as a Tech Lead or equivalent technical leader, with ownership of a team’s delivery outcomes and engineering standards.

    • Strong track record of leading from the front line, including writing design documents, reviewing pull requests and architecture decisions, and solving complex technical challenges hands-on.

    • Ability to balance direct contribution to major technical problems with coaching and developing less experienced engineers.

    • Experience establishing a team’s engineering practices and ways of working from the ground up, with a pragmatic approach to balancing speed, quality, reliability, and resilience.

    • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-team sequencing and dependencies and diagnose the underlying causes of delivery or throughput problems.

    • Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, with the ability to establish technical direction without waiting for complete requirements or predefined solutions.

    • Proven ability to drive technical blockers through to resolution and maintain momentum toward delivery.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product stakeholders, and leadership.

    • Experience with payments systems is highly desirable.

    • Experience improving processing efficiency or cost-to-process within a high-volume service is an advantage.

    • Experience taking an early-stage or basic service and evolving it into a robust, scalable production system is a strong plus.

    • Comfortable working in a remote-first, fast-moving environment where autonomy, ownership, and pragmatic decision-making are highly valued.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive salary: Attractive compensation aligned with the seniority and technical leadership scope of the role.

      • Stock options: Receive equity and share in the long-term value created by the organization.

      • Generous time off: 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays.

      • Flexible public holidays: Swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.

      • Birthday off: Enjoy an additional day away from work on your birthday.

      • Remote-first working: Work remotely with flexibility around where and how you work.

      • Clear core hours: Benefit from defined collaboration windows while maintaining flexibility outside those hours.

      • Meeting-free Friday afternoons: Dedicated time for deep work, focus, and personal priorities.

      • Remote-work allowance: Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year toward your home-office setup.

      • Wellbeing allowance: Up to £150 or €150 per month to support your health and wellbeing.

      • High-impact ownership: Shape the architecture, operating model, and engineering standards of a new payments squad.

      • Hands-on leadership: Combine technical leadership with meaningful hands-on engineering work rather than moving entirely into management.

      • Inclusive environment: Applications are welcomed from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those traditionally underrepresented in technology and energy.

title: Publicity Intern (Film)
description:
Programme Eligibility

To join one of our 12-month Internships you must meet one of the following criteria:

  1. You’re currently an undergraduate studying at University and returning to full time education in Autumn 2028
  2. You’re looking to gain work experience after completing your A-Levels, an equivalent course or an Apprenticeship

Additionally, you must also:

  • Be eligible to work in the UK without restriction for the duration of the internship from Monday 5th July 2027 – Friday 21st July 2028
  • Be able to work in NBCUniversal's Central London office on-site four days per week

We recommend applying to just one internship role, this helps ensure your application is considered for the opportunity that best matches your interests and skills. Choosing one allows us to focus on what excites you most and where you’ll shine brightest.

What will I be doing?

Universal Pictures International are responsible for the strategic release of all studio, Blumhouse, Illumination, DreamWorks, Focus and Working Title films.

As a Publicity Intern you will be supporting a fast-paced team to facilitate and deliver innovative film campaigns, whilst also developing your own skills and knowledge to help you progress within the industry.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Providing day-to-day support across all publicity activity for theatrical film releases, including coordinating with publicity leads, agencies, distributors, and industry partners to deliver campaigns, talent tours, press events, screenings, and special projects.
  • Supporting the planning and execution of junkets, media events, talent visits, experiential activations, premieres, and press screenings, including logistics such as travel, accommodation, visas, couriers, venue coordination, guest management, screening check-ins, embargo forms, and on-the-ground event support.
  • Acting as a central coordination point for the publicity team by managing calendars, scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and minutes, booking meeting rooms and AV, maintaining distribution lists, and ensuring key internal documents, trackers, databases, and reporting tools are kept accurate and up to date.
  • Managing screening processes, including liaising with industry partners to schedule screenings, coordinating invitations and screening links, tracking reactions, maintaining guest and press databases, and documenting campaign outcomes.
  • Supporting budget management and financial administration by raising purchase orders, setting up vendors, tracking costs, processing expenses, resolving billing queries, and maintaining publicity budget trackers.
  • Assisting with the creation and distribution of publicity materials, presentations, campaign reports, reviews round-ups, reaction memos, and publicity assets.
  • Conducting research, monitoring industry trends and digital innovations, tracking media coverage and social conversation, and contributing insights and ideas during campaign brainstorms and strategic planning sessions.
  • Providing general administrative and operational support to the publicity team, including coordinating team inputs on key projects, ordering equipment and supplies, and assisting with ad hoc departmental initiatives as required.

What will I learn from this opportunity?

  • Gain first-hand experience of how a high-performing global entertainment company operates, while developing a comprehensive understanding of the theatrical film industry, the media landscape, and the role publicity plays within a film’s overall marketing strategy.
  • Develop a practical understanding of how integrated 360° film marketing campaigns are planned and executed, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Learn how strategic theatrical publicity campaigns are delivered from concept to execution, including title launches, trailer debuts, set visits, content days, junkets, publicity tours, influencer activations, premieres and other key campaign moments.
  • Build knowledge of how publicity teams collaborate within the wider marketing function, gaining insight into the responsibilities, objectives and workflows of different departments involved in a film release.
  • Develop an understanding of the similarities, differences and nuances across EMEA markets, learning how publicity strategies and media approaches are tailored to meet the needs of individual territories (EMEA role specific).
  • Acquire valuable skills and hands-on experience in publicity, marketing, project coordination and campaign delivery, providing a strong foundation for a future career in entertainment marketing and communications.

What do I need to bring to the role?

  • A highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented team player with strong administrative, interpersonal and communication skills, capable of building effective relationships and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-profile environment.
  • A confident self-starter who demonstrates initiative, learns quickly, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and is willing to take a hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint, with excellent IT and organisational skills.
  • A strong interest in film, entertainment and media, with a broad awareness of the UK media landscape, social media platforms and influencer culture, and the ability to provide informed feedback on content creators and digital opportunities.
  • Resilient, enthusiastic and positive, with the ability to remain calm under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and contribute creatively to team discussions and brainstorming sessions.

Internship Programme Benefits & Perks

In addition to valuable hands-on experience, UK interns receive a competitive benefits package that supports their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Additional perks include exclusive employee discounts, access to ‘myPerks’ NBCU’s employee programme with opportunities to win tickets to attend movie premieres, swag bundles and more. Plus, you’ll get free streaming access to your favourite platforms like Hayu and NOW TV.

The responsibilities associated with this position are not limited to the above description and may be modified at any time by the Company.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
Responsibilities

Highly skilled and experienced Automation Test Engineer with a strong background in both functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications built using OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components (LWC). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise with automation tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Playwright, and AI-based testing tools. The position will play a critical role in ensuring quality across the development lifecycle. This role places a strong emphasis on in-sprint automation, enabling rapid feedback and continuous delivery within Agile teams. Additionally, the position involves API testing for complex insurance applications, using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate integrations and ensure seamless data flow across systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts for Salesforce applications using tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, and Playwright
  • Utilize AI capabilities for self-healing locators, test data generation, and root cause analysis
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools to improve manual and functional testing efficiency by enabling automated test case generation based on business requirements and user workflows, capturing test evidence without manual intervention, auto-generating automation scripts wherever feasible, and intelligently identifying scenarios that require manual execution
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and QA team members to implement in-sprint automation, ensuring test coverage is aligned with sprint goals and delivered within sprint timelines
  • Perform manual and functional testing to validate new features, identify edge cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage where automation is not feasible
  • Lead the planning and execution of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and API testing across multiple platforms and environments
  • Develop and execute API test cases using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate service integrations and data accuracy
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback loops
  • Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to resolve issues efficiently
  • Maintain and manage test environments, test data, and automation frameworks to support ongoing testing needs
  • Maintain the automation regression suites based on continuous enhancements or new features implemented
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to best practices in test automation and quality assurance
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: salesforce)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a strong focus on automation
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce testing (Salesforce Sales/Service/Experience Cloud/FSC)
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing platforms and generative AI tools used for test design, script generation, test maintenance, and defect analysis
  • Proficiency in automation tools and frameworks: Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Provar, Playwright
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: Salesforce)
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing types, and software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Page Object Model (POM), data-driven, and hybrid framework approaches
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, JSON/XML payloads, OAuth authentication, and integration workflows
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps)
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and in-sprint automation practices
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Property and Casualty Insurance knowledge is a plus
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr
  • Experience with automating applications which are developed using Salesforce OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components would be a plus
  • Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Salesforce platform components including Flows, Validation Rules, Apex integrations, Profiles, Permission Sets, and security models is a plus

About Our Company

H.W. Kaufman Group is a powerful global network of companies dedicated to shaping the future of insurance. With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. We are privately owned and thus free from the influence of Wall Street. This allows us the ability to adapt to constantly fluctuating market conditions. From brokerage, underwriting, and real estate to claims, loss control and risk management services, our depth of services is unrivaled.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The H.W. Kaufman Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other status or condition protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

In addition, Kaufman will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

title: Senior Power Systems Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Power Systems Engineer based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape the next generation of a modern, secure, and resilient power grid.
You will lead advanced power system modeling and dynamic studies for inverter-based resources across complex energy projects.
The position combines deep electrical engineering expertise with sophisticated simulation, compliance assessment, and technical reporting.
You will work with industry-standard tools to evaluate system performance, stability, protection, and grid interconnection requirements.
Your work will directly support the reliable integration of renewable and emerging energy technologies into the bulk power system.
The role provides exposure to evolving ISO and NERC requirements within an innovative, technically driven engineering environment.
You will also have opportunities to leverage Python, AI, and automation to improve engineering quality, productivity, and innovation.

Accountabilities:

  • Perform detailed bulk power system dynamic studies using specialized power system software, including PSCAD and PSS®E, to evaluate system behavior and performance.
  • Conduct inverter-based resource modeling across steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamic applications, supporting both initial design and as-built model validation.
  • Perform technical compliance assessments covering IBR facility ratings, protection coordination, ride-through capabilities, and other applicable grid requirements.
  • Conduct modeling and compliance studies in accordance with ISO-specific requirements and applicable NERC reliability standards, including requirements such as IEEE 2800 and NERC MOD-026-2.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive technical reports documenting study methodologies, findings, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects from planning through completion, ensuring deliverables meet established quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
  • Identify technical or training needs and communicate them to engineering leadership to support continued team development and technical excellence.
  • Responsibly leverage AI and automation tools to streamline engineering workflows, improve productivity, strengthen quality, and support innovative approaches to power system analysis.
  • Contribute to additional engineering initiatives and responsibilities as needed within a collaborative technical environment.

    • Requirements

    • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, with a specialization or strong academic emphasis in power systems.
    • 5+ years of professional experience working as a power systems engineer, with substantial experience in bulk power system analysis and modeling.
    • Demonstrated experience with ERCOT Model Quality Test or an equivalent modeling validation process, as well as familiarity with IEEE 2800 and NERC MOD-026-2.
    • Strong experience performing power system impact studies, including steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamic stability analysis.
    • Hands-on proficiency with power system simulation software such as PSCAD and PSS®E.
    • Experience programming or automating engineering workflows using Python, with the ability to develop practical tools that improve analytical efficiency.
    • Experience using AI and automation tools responsibly to enhance engineering quality, productivity, and innovation.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical results and translate them into actionable engineering conclusions.
    • Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports and collaborate effectively with engineering stakeholders.
    • Strong ownership, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage project priorities while meeting quality, schedule, and budget expectations.

      • Benefits

      • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% premium coverage for employees.
      • Generous paid time off and paid holidays.
      • Employee ownership opportunities through a MyShare Employee Ownership Program.
      • 401(k) retirement plan with a contribution match of up to 4%, with employees fully vested from day one.
      • Fully remote work opportunity within Canada or the United States.
      • Occasional travel, expected to be 10% or less.
      • Opportunities to work alongside experienced industry leaders on complex power and energy projects.
      • Exposure to advanced grid modeling, renewable energy integration, and emerging energy technologies.
      • An innovative engineering environment focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient energy system.
      • Opportunities to apply AI, automation, and advanced analytical techniques to real-world engineering challenges.

title: Backstage Captain, Southland Mall - FL - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Selling and Support Captain, you are an advocate for the customer and a role model for your colleagues. As an elevated hourly colleague, you are an expert in customer satisfaction , merchandising, and building brand loyalty. You will drive results through promotional and Omni selling initiatives. Under the supervision of a People Leader, you will play a key role in communicating expectations and priorities to our colleagues. Advancement opportunities include Personal Stylist or Sales and Customer Experience Manager.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

What You Will Do

  • Based upon your Captain assignment you could be fulfilling customer orders, merchandising, processing new products, or supervising the selling floor in delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Lead colleagues in the execution and completion of assigned tasks.
  • As an advocate for the customer, you will role model and provide fast feedback on how to make every customer experience outstanding.
  • Ensure high-level of customer service through problem-solving and customer-focused resolutions.
  • Enhance the in-store customer experience by promoting our Macy's mobile app.
  • Meet with People Leaders throughout the day to plan and monitor total store activities.
  • Provide People Leaders continuous feedback that drives a positive customer experience and improves our processes.
  • Perform store opening and closing procedures, including accessing alarm system and settling the registers.
  • Lead and participate in the adherence to our best in class merchandise standards.
  • Educate colleagues on point of sale technology, radio frequency equipment, and applications to assist in selling and fulfillment of customer orders.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Proficient in communicating effectively with customers and providing clear direction to colleagues
  • Self-starter in adapting quickly to changing customer expectations and needs
  • Resourceful and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and deadlines
  • 1-2 years of direct retail experience preferred
  • High school diploma or equivalent

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Involves standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 50lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders.
  • Reaching, including above eye level, crouching, kneeling, stooping and color vision.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

description:

About the role

Shield Recruitment is seeking an experienced Cyber Security GRC Consultant / Assessment & Authorisation Specialist to join our growing team in Canberra, ACT. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in helping Defence and Government organisations establish and maintain robust governance, risk and compliance frameworks across their cyber security environments. Previous Defence experience is essential.


In this strategic position, you will be responsible for conducting comprehensive security assessments, developing authorisation strategies, and guiding clients through complex compliance requirements. Your expertise will directly impact how organisations protect their critical information assets and meet regulatory obligations. This role offers the opportunity to work with diverse clients across various sectors whilst contributing to the advancement of cybersecurity practices in Australia.


Please note: Due to the nature of the role, you must hold an active NV2 or TSPV security clearance.


Key responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed cybersecurity risk assessments and vulnerability evaluations to identify gaps in security posture and compliance

  • Develop and implement security authorisation frameworks aligned with industry standards and regulatory requirements

  • Prepare comprehensive assessment reports documenting findings, recommendations, and remediation strategies

  • Advise clients on governance structures, policies, and procedures to strengthen their cybersecurity maturity

  • Lead security control assessments and provide evidence-based recommendations for improvement

  • Support clients through the authorisation and accreditation process, ensuring compliance with relevant standards

  • Maintain knowledge of evolving cybersecurity threats, regulatory changes, and industry best practices

  • Liaise with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior management, to communicate risk and compliance findings

  • Develop security compliance roadmaps and implementation plans tailored to client requirements

  • Contribute to the development of templates, frameworks, and tools to enhance service delivery

What we're looking for

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

  • Experience in cybersecurity governance, risk management, or compliance roles

  • Demonstrated expertise in security assessment methodologies and frameworks such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, or equivalent standards

  • Strong understanding of Australian regulatory requirements and compliance obligations relevant to cybersecurity

  • Proven experience conducting security audits and vulnerability assessments

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business-focused recommendations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information to diverse audiences

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSK, CISM, or GIAC certifications are highly desirable

  • Experience with authorisation and accreditation processes, particularly within the Australian Government context, is advantageous


What we offer

Shield Recruitment is committed to providing a supportive and engaging workplace where professionals can thrive and develop their careers. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience, alongside a comprehensive range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing and professional growth.

  • Professional development opportunities and support for ongoing certifications and training

  • Flexible working arrangements that promote work-life balance

  • Access to modern tools and technologies that enable effective service delivery

  • A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diverse perspectives

  • Opportunities to work on varied and challenging projects across multiple industries


About us

Shield Recruitment is currently partnering with multiple clients to deliver large-scale technology programs across national security, defense and critical infrastructure.

Our mission is to connect exceptional cybersecurity professionals with organisations that value their expertise, whilst helping our clients build resilient security practices. We are committed to fostering a culture of excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement. Our team comprises experienced professionals who understand the nuances of the cybersecurity landscape and are passionate about supporting both candidates and clients in achieving their objectives.

Apply now

title: Senior Monitoring & Evaluation Associate (G6) Monrovia, Liberia
description:
The Global Assisted Voluntary Return (AVR) program aims to provide assisted voluntary return (AVR) to migrants in the United States, receiving countries, and the Western Hemisphere, ensuring that returns are safe, dignified, and based on the migrants’ free , prior, and informed consent. Additionally, the program offers independent, needs-based post-arrival assistance at the request of countries of origin or receiving countries, always with the explicit consent of the migrants.
Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) and in close coordination with the
Migration Health Officer and other units, the incumbent will be based in Monrovia, Liberia and will be responsible and accountable for the monitoring and evaluation of activities implemented by IOM Liberia Country Office (CO).

1. Coordinate the monthly planning of the office’s programmatic activities to produce a structured calendar for the Coutry Office (CO).
2. Assist in the monitoring of project activities, in accordance with the overall Monitoring and
Evaluation (M&E) framework for the Global Assisted Voluntary Return (AVR) Programme.
3. Collect, summarise, analyse, and present M&E information/data, including from Migration
Management Operational Software Application (MiMOSA), on specific project topics in
accordance with IOM and donor standards and requirements to generate evidence-based
findings that inform programme and donor decision-making.
4. Monitor performance indicators against project implementation plans and disseminate M&E findings to IOM teams to strengthen data-driven programme adjustments.
5. Compile and prepare information and data for donor reports and strategic programme
documents in coordination with the CoM w/Coord Functions and other relevant units within
Liberia CO, enabling accurate and timely reporting internally and externally.
6. Conduct field monitoring visits based on needs identified by the CoM w/Coord Functions and provide information that guides corrective action.
7. Assist the CoM w/Coord Functions in developing new M&E tools, as appropriate, in close
coordination with the Monitoring and Evaluation and Information Management Units in Dakar
to enhance the CO’s M&E methodology.
8. Act as focal point for the administrative coordination and implementation of M&E project
activities, involving liaison with diverse organisational units to initiate requests, obtain necessary clearances, process and follow-up on administrative actions, etc.
9. Prepare interim and final Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) reports, systematically incorporating disaggregated data by age, gender, and vulnerability and identify delivery gaps, bringing them to the attention of the supervisor, and recommend corrective actions.
10. Organise surveys and assessments measuring satisfaction and impact among migrants and host communities to obtain data that informs programme responsiveness.
11. Draft correspondence on project issues; prepare and update reports, briefing notes, graphics, statistical tables, presentation and other forms of documentation.
12. Contribute to the drafting and consolidation of periodic narrative reports (quarterly and annual) and donor reports to translate programme data into coherent progress narratives.
13. Respond to complex information requests and inquiries; set up and maintain files/records; organise meetings, workshops and training sessions.
14. Participate in meetings and conferences; coordinate implementation activities with local
authorities, partners, United Nation (UN) agencies, intergovernmental and non-governmental organisations, donors and other stakeholders relevant to the project to sustain the external
relationships that facilitate programme delivery.
15. Provides guidance/training to new/junior staff.
16. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

EDUCATION


• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Monitoring and Evaluation Sciences, Statistics, Administration, Political Science, Social Science, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or a related field from an accredited academic institution with four years of relevant professional experience; or,
• High School diploma with six years of relevant professional experience.


EXPERIENCE


• Experience in project development, monitoring, reporting and evaluation;
• Experience in applying monitoring and evaluation methodologies and tools;
• Experience in supporting the organisation of consultations, workshops and seminars with
stakeholders; and,
• Experience with assisted voluntary return and reintegration programs is preferred.


SKILLS


• Strong reporting, writing and research skills, preferably related to M&E;
• Good computer skills: excellent knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Kobo Toolbox,
MiMOSA, and email/internet software, statistical analysis packages;
• Knowledge of UN cooperation frameworks and bilateral donor programming requirements;
• Knowledge in quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis;
• Ability to consolidate information from multiple sources;
• Good degree of judgment and initiative, ability to work with a high degree of independence within assigned areas;
• Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills; and,
• Proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with people of diverse cultural and national backgrounds.

Languages

IOM’s official languages are English, French, and Spanish.


REQUIRED
For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).


DES IRABLE
Working knowledge of of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish).

title: Backend Engineer (Multiple Positions)
description:
Backend Engineer

About LaunchDarkly Engineering

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.
  • Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.
  • Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.
  • Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.
  • Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.
  • Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go)
  • Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.
  • Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare “big-bang” technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

title: Pædagoger til Børnehuset på Center Avnstrup (GENOPSLAG)
description:
Brænder du for børn og unge – og vil du gøre en forskel for en særlig gruppe børn i en udsat livsposition? Er du pædagog med hjerte og faglighed på rette sted, og har du lyst til at være en del af en hverdag, hvor relationer, trivsel og tryghed er i centrum? Så læs med.

Røde Kors asylafdeling søger en pædagog til klubben på Udrejsecenter Avnstrup. Klubben er et fritidstilbud for børn og unge mellem 6 og 16 år. Her bliver du en del af et stærkt pædagogisk team, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe en tryg, værdig og meningsfuld hverdag for børn i en sårbar livssituation - med blik for fremtiden.

Læs mere om Udrejsecenter Avnstrup her.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?
Som pædagog i klubben får du ansvar for at skabe rammerne for et trygt og udviklende fritidstilbud med aktiviteter, som giver børnene glæde, ro og plads til at være børn – selv i en svær livssituation. Det kan være alt fra krea og gaming til musik, bevægelse og ture i naturen.

Du bliver også en vigtig voksen i samarbejdet med forældre og kolleger på tværs – og du vil bidrage med faglige observationer, sparring og støtte til børn, der har brug for ekstra opmærksomhed.

Der er høj grad af samarbejde imellem børneskolelærere og klubpædagoger. To dage om ugen er en pædagog fra klubben med i skoledagen.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet pædagog og kan genkende dig selv noget af dette:

  • Du har erfaring med udsatte børn og familier – måske fra asylområdet, socialpædagogisk arbejde eller lignende
  • Du er god til at skabe trygge relationer – og har blik for børns behov
  • Du trives i en omskiftelig hverdag og er ikke bange for at tænke nyt
  • Du er struktureret, samarbejdsstærk og kommunikerer tydeligt – både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Du taler engelsk på brugerniveau og har respekt for kulturelle forskelle

Hvorfor skal du søge?

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Platform Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on raising the standard for how software is built, tested, delivered, and operated.
You will shape the platform foundations that product teams and AI coding agents rely on to move quickly and reliably.
The role spans developer experience, CI/CD, infrastructure, automated testing, observability, security, and secure software delivery.
You will establish engineering standards, build reusable tooling and golden paths, and help teams adopt workflows that create measurable leverage.
A key focus will be AI harness engineering: designing development environments and engineering systems where AI agents can work effectively and safely.
You will operate as a builder and technical leader, staying close to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and the evolving needs of engineering teams.
This is an opportunity to have organization-wide impact while helping define how modern software teams collaborate with increasingly capable AI agents.

Accountabilities:

  • Shape the platform and infrastructure foundations that product teams build and operate their services on, balancing standardization with team autonomy.
  • Improve the complete engineering development loop, including local development, CI/CD, deployment processes, production feedback, and developer workflows.
  • Define and drive engineering standards for automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and secure software delivery, while helping product teams adopt them effectively.
  • Build shared tooling, templates, reusable components, and golden paths that reduce friction and provide practical leverage across the engineering organization.
  • Own secure delivery practices end to end by integrating security scanning, secrets management, dependency controls, software supply-chain protections, and penetration-testing workflows into core development and delivery pipelines.
  • Monitor and respond to the evolving security landscape, particularly as AI coding agents change how vulnerabilities are introduced, discovered, and potentially exploited.
  • Improve repositories, development conventions, tooling, documentation, test coverage, and feedback loops so AI coding agents can navigate codebases efficiently and produce reliable results.
  • Measure the effectiveness of platform initiatives through DORA metrics and qualitative feedback from engineering teams, using those insights to continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by setting direction while remaining deeply involved in code, infrastructure, automation, and pipeline implementation.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and operating production-grade systems.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and developing internal platforms, with strong judgment around what should be abstracted, exposed, standardized, or left flexible.
    • Deep expertise in CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, developer tooling, and modern software delivery practices.
    • Strong understanding of software security and secure delivery approaches, including shift-left security and SecDevOps principles.
    • Product-oriented mindset toward internal platforms, treating engineers and AI agents as users and measuring whether tooling genuinely improves their productivity.
    • Practical fluency with AI coding agents, including an understanding of how they operate, where they encounter friction, and how engineering environments can be designed to make them more effective.
    • Ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can define strategy while personally contributing to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.
    • Strong systems thinking and the ability to identify organization-wide opportunities for standardization, automation, reliability, and developer productivity.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence product teams and drive adoption of shared engineering practices.
    • Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright and knowledge of how to scale automated testing environments is a strong plus.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment where established processes and playbooks may still be evolving.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to shape the future of software development and AI-assisted engineering.
      • High level of ownership with direct visibility into the impact of your technical decisions.
      • Individual-contributor-focused culture that values engineers who lead through execution and create momentum by building.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with highly experienced AI and software engineering professionals.
      • Global and flexible remote work environment, with an emphasis on results rather than location.
      • Equity participation designed to align individual success with the long-term growth of the organization.
      • Significant opportunity to influence platform strategy, engineering standards, security practices, and AI-enabled development workflows.
      • Inclusive environment committed to diversity and equal opportunity.

title: Senior Flight Software Engineer (Rust) Umbra · United States $155k - $185k USD
description:
Bookmark it and share with a Rust friend

Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra’s ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms).Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

About the Team

Space Systems – The Components

Space Systems is where Umbra turns hardware and software designs into on-orbit realities; developing, implementing and iterating mission-ready core technology, while simultaneously advancing the next generation of our own satellite constellation. Space Systems is vertically integrated across the satellite architecture, thus the team designs, builds, and tests an array of critical components and subsystems, including power systems, communications, control systems, deployment hardware, avionics, and payloads, as well as the flight software, firmware and digital design solutions to support the entire hardware stack. Our focus is on first principles engineering, and our mandate is simple: it has to work when it counts. Every bolt, board, and binary is proven on our own SAR constellation, ensuring flight-proven reliability where failure is not an option.If you want to work on cutting edge space technology while maintaining the highest standard for innovation and mission ready performance, you belong here at Umbra.

We are seeking a Senior Flight Software Engineer, with expertise in the Rust programming language, to take an active role in the development and delivery of embedded flight software specifically tailored for Umbra missions. In this pivotal role, you will be tasked with a range of critical responsibilities, including but not limited to the formulation and specification of software requirements, the comprehensive design of robust software architecture, and the actual writing and implementation of code. You will take lead responsibility for the essential processes of system integration and testing, ensuring that all components function seamlessly together.In addition to your core development responsibilities, you will also be expected to provide expert guidance and mentorship in various aspects of software design, code development, and peer code reviews. Your role will include oversight of thorough documentation practices and the meticulous integration of the flight software with flight hardware, which encompasses conducting tests to ensure reliability and performance. The ideal candidate shows ownership, is a solution-driven problem solver, an exceptional communicator, and possesses a strong systems-thinking mindset. Your contributions will be vital to the success of our missions, driving innovation and excellence in software engineering within our team.

This position is based on-site in either our Santa Barbara/Goleta, CA office, Arlington, VA office, or Reston, VA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive yourself and all of your team to become better software engineers.
  • Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary engineering team to design, develop, and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant flight and payload software.
  • Architect and implement software to meet high-level system requirements, while managing interfaces with multiple spacecraft subsystems, ground systems and hardware.
  • Develop command and control software for spacecraft flight operations, payloads, and peripheral electronics.
  • Contribute to and lead test campaigns, from unit-level testing to automated system and subsystem-level testing.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation for software operation and interfaces with other system components.
  • Present high level technical concepts simply and clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Take on additional professional duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of proven experience in architecting and developing high-reliability software with Rust or Modern C/C++.
  • 4+ years of systems and/or embedded software development with Rust or Modern C/C++.
  • 2+ years developing concurrent code with asynchronous Rust.
  • Proficient working within Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal environments.
  • Experience leading software design and development processes, including version control, bug tracking, and documentation.
  • Experience building and maintaining Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines, automated testing and build/release management, and static/dynamic analysis tools.
  • Able to travel up to 15% (between Umbra’s Virginia & Santa Barbara offices).

Desired Qualifications

  • 8+ years of proven experience in architecting and developing high-reliability software with Rust or C/C++.
  • 3+ years developing concurrent code with asynchronous Rust.
  • 3+ years with space systems development, including space and ground segments.
  • 3+ years with software used in autonomous, fault-critical systems.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic development environment.
  • Hands-on experience with kernel development using Yocto or similar.
  • Background in developing, deploying, and maintaining software product lines.
  • Familiarity with Python programming.
  • Strong understanding of processor architecture, with the ability to optimize code for performance and memory usage.
  • Knowledge of hardware interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe.
  • Knowledge of dynamics and control systems.
  • Flexible Time Off, Sick, Family & Medical Leave
  • Vol Life, Critical Illness, Accidental, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance (employee funded)
  • 401k with 3% non-elective company contribution
  • Stock Options
  • Free Parking
  • Free lunch daily in office

You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth.
The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed.
You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms.
A major focus will be turning manual and error-prone commercial processes into scalable, automated products that can support new business categories.

Both teams work primarily in C++ and Unreal Engine, combining client engineering with the tools and systems that power TFT’s cosmetics ecosystem.

Based in Singapore, you’ll partner closely with colleagues in Los Angeles across Engineering, Product, Art, Design and Production.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Store & Content Distribution and Cosmetics Engineering, setting clear goals, ownership and delivery expectations aligned with TFT’s priorities.
  • Coach and develop engineers, and emerging managers, upholding a high performance bar through direct feedback, growth planning and proactive performance management.
  • Shape team structure, hiring and staffing to meet current and future needs, developing leadership capacity and making resource trade-offs across the group.
  • Own the group’s technical vision, strategy and roadmap, partnering with senior engineers to balance delivery with architecture, quality and Riot’s technology standards.
  • Align priorities with Product, Art, Design and Production across Singapore and Los Angeles, resolving competing demands and managing dependencies with central technology teams.
  • Guide reliable Store experiences and integrations with shared services.
  • Guide the Unreal systems, tools and pipelines that support cosmetics production and enable new content types.
  • Monitor delivery and operational health, act early on risks, and drive improvements in testing, CI/CD, developer experience and creator workflows.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial games industry experience building game client systems, UI, gameplay or tools.
  • 4+ years of engineering management experience, including leading engineering groups of more than 10 people.
  • Strong C++ development experience, plus experience working with Unreal Engine (preferred), Unity or proprietary game engines.
  • Experience shipping game UI integrated with backend services, building tools and systems for content creation, or both, such as asset pipelines, cosmetic authoring tools, or systems that integrate animation and VFX into the game.
  • Ability to review technical designs and guide implementation decisions, including performance, reliability and maintainability trade-offs.
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps and aligning delivery priorities with Product, Art, Design and engineering partners across locations.
  • Proven experience developing senior engineers, managing performance and making hiring and staffing decisions.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with live service or free-to-play games, particularly player-facing Store, commerce, monetization, virtual goods, purchasing or entitlement systems.
  • Experience building game UI using patterns such as MVVM, including integration with server-authoritative services
  • Experience with animation, cinematics and VFX workflows, including crafting systems that can be extended by artists and technical artists.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine’s tools/systems for UI development, such as UMG, UI Materials, and MVVM.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine’s tools and systems for content authoring and editor tooling, such as Niagara, Sequencer, Blueprints, and Slate.

Our Perks:

  • Full relocation support
  • Full health insurance for you, your spouse and children
  • Open paid time off
  • Retirement benefits with company matching
  • Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability
  • Play Fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of our players and community through games
  • We will double down on your donations of time and money to non-profits

Don’t forget to include a resume and cover letter. We receive a lot of applications, but we’ll notice a fun, well-written intro that shows us you take play seriously.
