title: Collision Parts/CSR
description:
Beck Collision Center

Collision Parts/Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Location: Palatka, Florida (On-Site)

Compensation Range: $18-20/HR

Great Benefits + Positive Team Environment

Beck Collision Center, part of the growing Beck Automotive Group, is seeking a highly organized and dependable Collision Parts / Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our team. This is a key position within our collision center, working closely with estimators, technicians, vendors, and customers to help keep repairs moving efficiently through the shop.


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and understands the importance of accurate and timely parts management. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced automotive environment and want to play an important role in the day-to-day flow of a busy collision center, we want to hear from you!


What We Offer

At Beck Automotive Group, we prioritize the development and well-being of our team members:

  • Opportunity for Growth: Build your career with a company that values personal and professional development.
  • Low-Cost Health Insurance: Starting as low as $82.08 per pay period.
  • Comprehensive Dental & Vision Insurance: Keep yourself covered with competitive plan options.
  • Scholarship Program: Receive 100% paid college tuition for you, your spouse, or your children.
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance: $25,000 in coverage at no cost to you.
  • Daycare Assistance: We cover 50% of daycare premium costs with eligible providers.
  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy your Sundays—we are closed every Sunday!
  • Retirement 401(k) Plan: Build your future.
  • Company-Provided Training: Gain the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in your position.
  • Paid Vacation & Holidays: Recharge with paid time off and six paid holidays.
  • Employee Purchase Discounts: Receive special discounts on vehicles, parts, and services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate Collision Parts: Work directly with estimators to identify, order, track, and receive parts needed for collision repairs.
  • Monitor Parts Status: Follow up with vendors and suppliers to ensure parts are received accurately and within expected timeframes.
  • Provide Parts Updates: Keep estimators and management informed of backorders, delays, incorrect parts, damaged parts, and updated estimated arrival dates.
  • Support Shop Flow: Help ensure technicians have the correct parts available when needed to prevent unnecessary repair delays and maintain efficient shop production.
  • Receive & Verify Parts: Inspect incoming parts and deliveries for accuracy, damage, and completeness.
  • Manage Returns: Coordinate the return of incorrect, damaged, unused, or duplicate parts and ensure proper documentation and credits.
  • Maintain Accurate Records: Enter and update parts, invoices, customer information, and repair-related information within electronic systems.
  • Assist Customers: Answer incoming calls, provide professional customer service, confirm appointments, and direct customers to the appropriate team member.
  • Answer Multi-Line Phones: Handle incoming calls professionally and efficiently while supporting the front office as needed.
  • Assist Estimators & Management: Provide administrative and operational support to help maintain an organized and productive collision center.
  • Communicate Across Departments: Work closely with estimators, technicians, parts vendors, and management to identify and resolve issues that could impact repair timelines.
  • Stay Proactive: Remain engaged during downtime by identifying tasks that support the department and improve overall shop efficiency.
  • Manage Multiple Priorities: Balance parts coordination, customer service, administrative responsibilities, and changing shop needs in a fast-paced environment.


Requirements

  • Previous automotive, collision, parts, or customer service experience required.
  • Collision or automotive parts experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with customers, vendors, technicians, estimators, and management.
  • Ability to follow up consistently and proactively on outstanding parts and repair needs.
  • Strong computer skills with the ability to learn automotive and collision management software.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Reliable, punctual, self-motivated, and team-oriented.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.
  • Resume Submission: Applicants must upload a resume during the application process.
  • Must successfully complete pre-employment testing, including background check, motor vehicle record (MVR), and drug screening.


Why This Role Matters

The Collision Parts / CSR position is an important part of keeping our collision center running efficiently. Timely and accurate parts coordination directly impacts technician productivity, repair timelines, and the customer experience. This position serves as a critical communication link between our estimators, technicians, vendors, and customers to help ensure repairs continue moving through the shop with minimal delays.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, veteran or disability status, religion, age, gender orientation, or other protected status.


Join us at Beck Collision Center and be part of a dynamic team where your contributions matter!

Apply Today!

title: Powertrain Calibration & Automation Engineering Ford Champ
description:
As an OBD & Emissions Core Ford Champ, you will play a key role in the Powertrain Calibration and Validation (VPSE) organization, focusing on the development of digital tools, connector databases, and the automation of sensor diagrams for Design Verification (DV) and OBD & Emissions calibration workflows. Working closely with Product Development, Calibration, and Test engineers, you will gain hands-on exposure to engine management, exhaust after-treatment diagnostics, and validation methodologies while driving process efficiency through automation and standardized technical data.

What you´ll do:

  • Automate sensor diagram generation in Microsoft Visio using custom VBA scripts, macros, and API integrations to streamline Design Verification (DV) workflows.

  • Develop and maintain MATLAB® and Python tools to automatically parse data, generate schematics, and validate sensor wiring and connector pinouts.

  • Architect and populate a centralized relational database serving as the single source of truth for sensor connector pinouts, families, electrical specifications, and ECU interface pin assignments.

  • Support Powertrain Calibration & OBD Engineers in organizing, reviewing, and tracking Design Verification (DV) test plans and sensor monitoring strategies across vehicle programs.

  • Assist in vehicle and lab test data processing, utilizing scripting (Python/MATLAB) to perform automated data reduction, monitor behavior analysis, and summary reporting for diagnostic validations.

  • Collaborate with calibration teams to understand OBD-II monitors and exhaust sensor functionality (e.g., UEGO/HEGO, EGT, pressure, particulate sensors) to ensure automated diagrams reflect accurate electrical and functional requirements.

  • Analyze engineering workflows and identify bottlenecks, applying LEAN / Kaizen continuous improvement principles to improve data handoffs between Validation, Calibration, and Systems Engineering.

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, engineering guidelines, and standardized diagram templates used for validation, testing setups, and agency compliance support.

What you´ll need:

  • Active student from any of the last 2 semesters of Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronics, Automotive, Mechanical, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related engineering degree.

  • 90% English skills (Oral, reading, writing, and listening – comfortable communicating in international technical environments).

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with high initiative, self-learning capability, and enthusiasm for powertrain systems and vehicle diagnostics.

Technical Skills (Mandatory):

  • Proficiency in MATLAB® programming: Experience with scripting, data handling, file I/O, and tool/GUI development.

  • Microsoft Visio skills or Visio API: Experience with VBA macros, stencil automation, or automated diagram drawing.

  • Python programming: Proficiency in scripting, data manipulation (e.g., pandas), and automation scripts.

  • Foundational understanding of electrical circuits and sensors: Ability to interpret wiring schematics, connector pinouts, and basic sensor signals.

Technical Skills (Desirable):

  • Database Management & SQL: Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite) and query construction.

  • Powertrain & OBD Fundamentals: Basic exposure or interest in internal combustion engines, emissions control systems, and On-Board Diagnostics (OBD-II).

  • Automotive Calibration & Diagnostic Tools: Familiarity or exposure to calibration and acquisition environments (such as ETAS INCA, CANape, ATI Vision) and vehicle network protocols (CAN / LIN).

  • Automotive Harness & Connectivity: Basic understanding of automotive electrical wiring harness architecture and physical connectors.

  • Version Control: Familiarity with Git / GitHub for code and documentation versioning.

De mennesker du kommer til at møde i dit arbejde, er borgere i alle aldre som har brug for professionel pleje og omsorg.
Du bliver del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og tage ansvar i hverdagen sammen med dygtige kollegaer. Vi er optagede af, at skabe forløb med borgerne, der er karakteriseret ved at være sammenhængende, helhedsorienterede og som giver mening for borgerne.

Den første oplæringspraktik vil altid være på et af vore 4 plejehjem, hvor du har en tæt kontakt til en oplæringsvejleder og faglærte kollegaer.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • Udviser interesse og initiativ til at lære og har lyst til at udvikle dig som fagperson
  • Er god til at samarbejde og tager ansvar
  • Er god til at kommunikere og bidrager positivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er mødestabil
  • Kan møde kl. 7.00 på kommunens arbejdspladser.
  • Er indstillet på at arbejde 37 timer ugentligt med skiftende mødetider
Adgangskrav:
  • Inden uddannelsen afslutning skal du have bestået dansk på C-niveau
  • Godkendt som kandidat til ”På vej til faglært SSA” af SOSU Fyn

Ansættelse og opstart
Du ansættes pr. 27. oktober 2026 i stillingen som ufaglært.

Du skal indledningsvis arbejde på et af kommunens plejehjem, frem til AMU-kursets start den 9. november 2026.

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse, at du løbende vurderes egnet til en elevansættelse som SSA-elev. Du vil efter endt kursusforløb overgå direkte til SSA-elev den 22. februar 2027.

Du kan læse meget mere om ”På vej til faglært SSA” på

  • Opholds/arbejdstilladelse
  • Bekræftelse på kandidatur til SOSU Fyn ”På vej til faglært SSA”

I Kerteminde Kommune ansættes ansøgere på baggrund af en samlet vurdering af ansøgning, CV og den medsendte dokumentation.

Straffeattest:
I forbindelse med ansættelse indhentes offentlig straffeattest.

Samtaler finder sted den 15. oktober 2026

Uddannelsesansvarlig Kristina Børsholt via mail: krbo@kerteminde.dk / telefon 21149954

Oplysningerne registreres på Praktikpladsen.dk og overføres til Datavarehuset i Styrelsen for It og Læring. Oplysningerne indsamles udelukkende til statistiske formål. De registrerede oplysninger er ikke synlige for dig eller offentligheden. Indsamlingen af disse data sker med hjemmel i §58 i Bekendtgørelse om Erhvervsuddannelser.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.
Månedslønnen for en ufaglært på SOSU-området er pr. 1. oktober 2026 kr. 25.509 ekskl. pension.

Kerteminde Kommune ligger i det nordøstlige Fyn med smuk natur, engagerede landsbyer og et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv og gode fritidsmuligheder. Vi er cirka 25.000 borgere og 1.800 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe gode løsninger sammen med borgerne.

Hvis dit job indebærer brug af kommunens IT-systemer, kan der i forbindelse med ansættelsen være krav om identifikation via MitID. Du vil i så fald blive kontaktet herom.

Hvis du tilbydes ansættelse, kan dine kontaktoplysninger, herunder navn, adresse, telefonnummer og eventuelt CV, efter forespørgsel videregives til den lokale tillidsrepræsentant eller den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation med henblik på korrekt indplacering og lønforhandling. title: Technical Program Manager, Robotics Solution Delivery
description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), you’ll manage the delivery of cutting edge automation technology and robotic solutions to our customers and partners. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some amazing and talented people, who also happen to be working on highly creative and ambitious efforts.

You will manage and coordinate engagements with industry leading companies and partners of Intrinsic. While each engagement differs to some extent, they generally share the aim to deliver our cutting edge technology and products to make robots usable by more people and businesses at scale in a radically simplified way. To achieve that, you will facilitate alignment on scope & feasibility and manage execution of internal development and external delivery. All while collaborating closely with a wide range of external and internal stakeholders - Product Managers, Program Managers, Software Engineers, Roboticists, Machine-Learning experts, and leadership.

As part of the overall TPM team, you will collaborate closely with your peers to evolve our shared standards and processes, enabling successful deliveries to our customers and partners at scale.

This role will require domestic and regular international travel to visit partners and customers.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver novel, cutting edge automation technology and robotic solutions to customers and partners.
  • Facilitate alignment on scope and timelines that capture needs while balancing feasibility, quality and acceptable risk.
  • Motivate by creating clarity. For example, manage change by creating clarity on: Why is the change needed? How did we decide on the change? What is changing?
  • Own an up-to-date delivery status overview and manage related risks .
  • Manage delivery budget (cost and resource allocation).
  • Guide the team to follow Intrinsic’s established standards and processes - collect feedback to evolve our operations to successfully deliver at scale.
  • Represent your delivery in regular leadership updates and proactively raise flags where leadership guidance is needed for a successful delivery.

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Experienced in applying best practice technical program/project management approaches and comfortable adapting and leveraging these in ambiguous settings with shifting priorities (project scoping/planning, risk analysis, timeline estimation, status tracking).
  • Strength in facilitating alignment of competing needs and constraints by leveraging critical thinking, e.g. when delivering novel technologies to established industries.
  • Experienced in managing collaborative external projects from start to end (incl. scope negotiation, stakeholder management, priority alignment).
  • Concise and clear communicator, especially when working with external partners and customers.
  • Expertise in navigating cultural nuances and building relationships internationally.
  • Master of Science in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience to confidently engage in technical discussions and articulate technical concepts, both in familiar and unfamiliar areas.

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

  • Experienced in robotic-automation specialized technical program/project management, e.g. understanding of typical phases and challenges in deploying a robotic solution.
  • Systems understanding of conventional robotics and automation systems, incl. mechatronic systems engineering and functional safety.
  • Familiarity with robotics technologies such as machine learning, computer vision, automated motion planning, reactive sensor control, their potential, limitations and resulting project risks.
  • Prior work in the machine tending automation space.
  • Confident in German language (writing and speaking).

The base salary for this full-time position is between $163,200 - $223,040 (USD) + 15% bonus + equity + benefits. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: candidate-support@intrinsic.ai.

title: Enhetschef Access och Dataflöde
description:
1 plats(er).

Enhetschef Access och Dataflöde

Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? Vi söker nu en engagerad och erfaren ledare som vill bidra med sin kunskap i rollen som enhetschef inom kontoret för Access och Dataflöde. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.

Ditt uppdrag

Som enhetschef hör du till avdelningen för signalunderrättelser och kontoret för Access och Dataflöde. Kontoret bedriver och utvecklar avdelningens kabel- och satellitinhämtning samt råmaterialförsörjning.

I rollen leder och samordnar du enhetens verksamhet och personal. Du säkerställer att detta sker i enlighet med avdelningens fastställda processer och uppsatta mål.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Leda enhetens verksamhet, personal, arbetsmiljö och budget i enlighet med avdelningens processer och mål.
  • Ansvara för medarbetaruppföljning, lönesättning samt coachande medarbetar- och utvecklingssamtal.
  • Säkerställa en effektiv kompetensförsörjning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling.
  • Driva verksamhetsutveckling genom samarbete inom och över organisationsgränser.
  • Optimera leveransförmågan genom att etablera rutiner och röja operativa hinder.
  • Bygga och utveckla en robust organisation som möter verksamhetens krav och behov.
  • Säkerställa att all verksamhet sker i enlighet med gällande tillstånd, föreskrifter och lagstiftning.

Tjänstens karaktär medför förtroendearbetstid samt tjänsteresor inrikes och utrikes.

Du kan

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT och telekommunikation, alternativt förvärvat likvärdiga kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Gedigen erfarenhet av IT- och/eller telekommunikationsbranschen.
  • Erfarenhet av chefsroll med personalansvar vid underrättelsemyndighet.
  • Erfarenhet av internationellt samarbete.
  • Mycket goda datorkunskaper.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

  • Utbildning i utvecklande ledarskap.
  • God kännedom om och erfarenhet av IT- och informationssäkerhet.

Du är

Vi söker dig med följande egenskaper:

  • Personlig mognad – Du är trygg och har självinsikt. Du har förmåga till självanalys, tar in feedback och gör anpassningar vid behov. Du kan se situationer ur flera perspektiv. Du skiljer på det personliga och det professionella samt förhåller dig på ett sätt som är anpassat till situationen.
  • Relationsskapande – Du är utåtriktad och socialt aktiv i yrkesmässiga sammanhang. Du skapar kontakter och underhåller relationer.
  • Ledarskap – Du leder, motiverar och förser andra med befogenheter som krävs för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål. Du samordnar grupper och du är en referenspunkt för andra. Du skapar engagemang och delaktighet.
  • Beslutsam – Du fattar beslut och agerar utifrån dessa, även vid begränsad information eller svåra omständigheter. Under tidspress har du förmåga att fatta snabbare beslut med fortsatt gott omdöme.

Om FRA

FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.

Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.

FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.

Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se (http://www.fra.se/). För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se (http://www.ncsc.se/) För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.

Mer information

Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på telefon 010-557 32 47. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.

Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se senast 2026-10-25. Referensnummer 2026FRA557-2.

Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

title: Chemical Operator (Loader) (60329)
description:
About LSB Industries, Inc.

LSB is committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low- and no-carbon products that build, feed, and power the world. The LSB team is dedicated to building a culture of excellence in customer experiences as we deliver essential products across the agricultural and industrial end markets and, in the future, the energy markets. Join our team and help us develop innovative solutions that will improve the quality of life for current and future generations. Learn more about LSB at .

Why Pryor, OK?

Set against the backdrop of a welcoming small-town atmosphere, Pryor offers an exceptional quality of life with its tight-knit community, excellent schools, and abundance of outdoor activities. Plus, its proximity to the vibrant city of Tulsa adds an extra layer of excitement, making Pryor the ideal place to both advance your career and enjoy a fulfilling lifestyle. Join us in this dynamic city and be part of a community that values progress, resilience, and collective success. If you're ready to embark on an exciting career journey filled with purpose, growth, and fulfillment, LSB Industries welcomes you! Come to Pryor, OK, and let's transform chemistry into opportunity together.

The Chemical Operator (Loader) role involves loading and unloading trucks and railcars safely and efficiently. Key tasks include verifying loading schedules, inspecting vehicles for mechanical issues, wearing required PPE, and following proper procedures to connect hoses and transfer products. The worker ensures accurate weight measurements and compliance with safety regulations, communicates issues to supervisors, and completes necessary paperwork. Additional duties include operating equipment such as a trac-mobile and forklift, performing safety checks, maintaining cleanliness, completing required training, and submitting daily reports. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Matches loading schedule to bill of lading.
  • Weighs railcar/truck prior to product transfer.
  • Fills out loading record.
  • Ensures that truck/railcar is positioned and secured at proper loading rack.
  • Visually inspects the railcar or truck to be involved in the upcoming transfer in order to ensure that it is mechanically sound and there is no defective equipment before loading or unloading.
  • Wears all protective clothing and equipment, including respirator and fresh air equipment that may be required to transfer the product in a manner that ensures maximum personal safety.
  • Connects loading hoses.
  • Loads railcar/truck according to loading instructions using gauges, loading meters, or weight.
  • Checks weight of railcar/truck after loading to ensure that gross weight does not exceed regulations.
  • Communicates with facility supervisor on any problems as they occur.
  • Disconnects loading arm/hose, inspects for any leaks, and completes required paperwork prior to releasing the railcar/truck.
  • Operates trac-mobile to move and position railcars for loading and shipment.
  • Regularly cleans and maintains work areas.
  • Operates forklift and other equipment as required if qualified.
  • Completes regular safety checks on machinery and equipment.
  • Completes all required LMS training modules.
  • Collects and submits all daily reports and paperwork and turns it in to the Board Operator.
  • Completes any other duties that may be assigned in order to complete the job.

Schedule Information:

Operators work two shifts in a rotation pattern:

6:00 AM to 6:00 PM (day shift) OR 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM (night shift).

Example 4-week Shift Pattern:

  • 3 days on Day shift
  • 1 day off
  • 3 days on Night shift
  • 3 days off
  • 4 days on Day shift
  • 7 days off
  • 4 days on Night shift
  • 3 days off

In addition to this schedule, there may be instances where mandatory overtime is required that may disrupt the usual shift rotation. Overtime averages 10-15% (approximately 2 shifts per 4-week rotation).

title: Psychologist - WarriorVets Medical Services, PLLC - 100% Domestic Travel
description:
Psychologists: Serve Veterans, Travel, and Make Thousands Per Month


Efficient, High-Pay Contractor Opportunity

Contract with our leading clinician-owned and led health company today! The Warrior Vets Medical Services team provides exemplary general medical services. We provide in-person care to current and former US Military veterans. Our team is seeking a licensed psychologist to conduct assessments for our veteran population on a traveling basis.

We pay a highly competitive flat daily rate. We remit payment within 45 with documentation in our user-friendly records system.


100% Travel

Our psychologist will travel to different clinics to complete psychological examinations. Applicants can be based anywhere in the United States.


Typical Appointments

In-person appointments consist of general psychological evaluations. Evaluations are performed once per veteran and typically take 60 to 90 minutes. There are no ongoing treatment needs for these veterans; it is a one-time encounter.


We Schedule Around Your Availability.

Make your own schedule! Our current need is 2-3 days per week. We efficiently schedule a series of evaluation appointments that last no more than a total of eight hours each day.


No Administrative Tasks Required

Our back-office support team handles all administrative work, including contracting with the Veterans Administration, liaising with contractors, and payment. This approach allows you to spend your time where it should be: with your patients.


Training and Experience

These evaluations make a difference in the lives of veterans and directly impact their access to the ongoing care they need. Our clinical psychology team is available to train you on working with the veteran population. They provide excellent ongoing clinical support for any questions or concerns.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Trading Platform Longbridge · United States posted 1 month ago
description:
About Longbridge

title: Clinical Practice Specialist Education
description:
SUMMARY: The Clinical Practice Specialist – Education is responsible for the design, delivery, and
continuous improvement of continuing education (CE) and clinical development programming for
Allegiance Mobile Health field clinicians. This role builds and maintains the accredited education
curriculum, coordinates CAPCE/state CE offerings, and ensures that EMTs, Advanced EMTs, and
Paramedics have the knowledge and evidence-based foundation required to deliver safe, high-quality
patient care consistent with medical direction and current clinical guidelines.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Responsibilities include, but are not limited to)


• Develop, maintain, and update the organization's continuing education curriculum, including
didactic content, lesson plans, and competency objectives aligned to the National EMS Education
Standards and Medical Director-approved clinical guidelines.

scheduling, rostering, documentation, and reporting of completion records.
• Serve as a lead instructor for classroom, virtual, and simulation-based education across EMT,
AEMT, and Paramedic scopes of practice.
• Track individual and organizational CE compliance and produce reports to support recertification,
credentialing, and accreditation requirements.
• Partner with the Medical Director and clinical leadership to translate protocol updates, QA/QI
findings, and clinical trends into targeted educational offerings.

audit-ready documentation.
• Evaluate program effectiveness using assessments, skills verification, and outcome data, and
recommend improvements.
• Support the maintenance of institutional accreditations and represent the organization in continuing
education matters with regulatory and accrediting bodies.

practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Current certification/licensure as a TDSHS or Compact State Paramedic in good standing.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of full-time field EMS experience at the Paramedic level.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and delivering EMS or healthcare education to adult learners.
  • Working knowledge of CAPCE and state continuing education requirements and recordkeeping.
  • Proficiency with learning management systems and standard office/productivity software.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite.
  • Instructor-level credentials or obtain within 12 months:

o BLS

o PALS

o CPR

o PHTLS

o State EMS Instructor or higher

o NAEMSE Instructor Level I & Level II

o NAEMSP Safety and Quality Course Completion

o BLS
o PALS
o CPR
o PHTLS

title: BI Engineer
description:
Salary: 150000

A growing financial services business is looking for an experienced BI Engineer to join its data and analytics team. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys owning the end-to-end data journey — from extracting data from source systems, through to building robust data pipelines and models, and ultimately delivering insightful reporting and dashboards.
You’ll work closely with business stakeholders, data and technology teams to ensure high-quality, reliable data is available to support better business decisions.

About the role
As a BI Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, building and maintaining the organisation’s data and reporting environment. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing the end-to-end data process, from source systems through to reporting and analytics.
  • Extracting and integrating data from a range of internal and external source systems.
  • Designing and building ETL/ELT data pipelines, using tools such as Azure Data Factory (ADF) or WhereScape RED.
  • Loading and transforming data into a PostgreSQL data warehouse.
  • Designing and developing robust data models to support business intelligence and reporting requirements.
  • Working with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.
  • Developing and maintaining Power BI or Tableau reports, dashboards and visualisations.
  • Ensuring data quality, integrity, accuracy and consistency across the data platform.
  • Monitoring and troubleshooting data pipelines and resolving data issues.
  • Optimising data processes, models and reporting solutions for performance and scalability.
  • Contributing to data governance, documentation and best-practice data engineering standards.
About you
We’re looking for a BI Engineer who combines strong technical capability with a practical understanding of how data needs to support a business.
You must have:
  • Strong experience working across the full BI/data lifecycle, from source systems through to reporting.
  • Proven experience building and managing data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or WhereScape RED.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
  • Experience designing data warehouses and dimensional/data models for reporting and analytics.
  • Strong experience with Power BI and/or Tableau.
  • An understanding of data quality, data integration and data transformation principles.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data and reporting solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data issues and identify root causes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across both technical and business teams.
Why join? This is an opportunity to join a financial services organisation where you’ll have genuine ownership of the data journey and be able to see your work directly contribute to business outcomes.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across data engineering, data warehousing, BI and visualisation, rather than being limited to one part of the data lifecycle.
If you’re a hands-on BI Engineer who enjoys building reliable data solutions from the ground up and turning complex data into meaningful insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst based in Germany.

This is a senior cybersecurity role focused on determining the real-world risk posed by newly discovered vulnerabilities. You’ll provide the technical depth needed to validate exploitability, understand active exploitation, and translate complex findings into actionable intelligence for customers. The role combines vulnerability research, exploit validation, detection engineering, automation, and threat intelligence in a highly technical environment. You’ll design and maintain honeypots, isolated analysis environments, and tooling that help a specialized team assess vulnerabilities at scale. As a technical lead, you’ll establish standards for vulnerability assessment while mentoring junior analysts and expanding intelligence capabilities. The position is remote-friendly and offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals dedicated to staying ahead of evolving threats.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the technical direction of the vulnerability intelligence practice, establishing rigorous standards for vulnerability validation, assessment, and communication.

  • Research newly disclosed vulnerabilities and determine whether reported exploitation claims are technically valid and relevant to real-world environments.

  • Acquire, modify, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in controlled virtual environments to confirm or refute exploitability claims.

  • Design, build, and operate honeypots and sensor systems capable of monitoring real-world exploitation activity.

  • Develop practical mitigation strategies for situations where patching is delayed, unavailable, or insufficient, including configuration hardening, network segmentation, access controls, feature disabling, and other defensive measures.

  • Develop techniques for identifying both attempted and successful exploitation, including the artifacts and indicators defenders should monitor and hunt for.

  • Produce detailed vulnerability intelligence reports explaining how exploits work, who is using them, who is being targeted, and what actions defenders should take.

  • Build and maintain automation that streamlines vulnerability assessment, PoC testing, triage, intelligence collection, and analysis workflows.

  • Identify and evaluate new sources of vulnerability intelligence and integrate valuable sources into the intelligence lifecycle from ingestion through enrichment and delivery.

  • Train, mentor, and support junior team members, raising the technical capabilities and analytical standards of the wider team.

  • Contribute to continuous improvements in vulnerability research methodologies, tooling, detection approaches, and intelligence coverage.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level knowledge of vulnerability research and intelligence, with substantial experience analyzing and validating vulnerabilities in production or research environments.

    • Proven ability to validate and test proof-of-concept exploits and independently assess whether exploitation claims are technically credible.

    • Strong programming ability in at least one language such as Python, Go, C, C++, or a similar language, sufficient to understand exploit code, modify PoCs, and develop custom tooling.

    • Hands-on experience working with virtual machines, containers, and reusable laboratory environments for safe exploitation testing and technical analysis.

    • Strong computer science fundamentals and a thorough understanding of core computing and internet technologies, including TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication, authorization, and real-world system deployment.

    • Ability to develop mitigations beyond simply recommending patches and understand how defensive controls affect exploitation risk.

    • Experience developing methods to detect attempted and successful exploitation and translating technical findings into actionable defensive guidance.

    • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to produce clear and detailed vulnerability intelligence reports for security professionals.

    • A strong bias toward automation and demonstrated ability to build systems that make vulnerability assessment, triage, and analysis more efficient.

    • Experience mentoring or training less experienced security professionals and raising technical standards across a team.

    • Ability to identify new vulnerability intelligence sources and evaluate their reliability, relevance, and potential value.

    • Experience building honeypots or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity is highly desirable.

    • Experience automating proof-of-concept testing and validation is a strong advantage.

    • Experience integrating intelligence sources end-to-end, including evaluation, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and delivery.

    • Additional valuable experience includes original vulnerability research or CVE credits, reverse engineering, detection engineering with Sigma, Snort/Suricata, or YARA, SOC operations, and familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog.

    • Public speaking, conference participation, or published technical security writing is also advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation: Market-competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

      • Remote-friendly culture: Work remotely while collaborating with an experienced international cybersecurity team.

      • Wellness programs: Access programs designed to support employee health and wellbeing.

      • Professional development: A variety of opportunities to expand your technical knowledge, cybersecurity expertise, and career development.

      • Technical impact: Work directly on high-priority vulnerability intelligence challenges and help organizations better understand and defend against emerging threats.

      • Experienced environment: Collaborate with professionals with backgrounds spanning intelligence services, military, law enforcement, cybersecurity, and private-sector threat intelligence.

      • Collaborative culture: Join a supportive, fast-paced environment built around openness, inclusion, integrity, customer focus, and continuous learning.

      • Mission-driven work: Contribute to protecting organizations from evolving cyber threats through timely, technically rigorous intelligence.

      • International scope: Work on vulnerability and exploitation trends affecting organizations and threat actors across global markets.

title: Senior QA AI Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA AI Engineer based in India.

This role leads quality engineering and AI testing initiatives for reliable, scalable, and secure cloud-based software solutions.
You will design advanced testing strategies for backend services, APIs, AI-powered features, and microservices architectures.
A key focus will be validating large language model behavior, agentic AI workflows, security risks, and non-deterministic outputs.
You will build automated evaluation frameworks that integrate quality controls directly into modern CI/CD pipelines.
Working closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams, you will influence requirements, release quality, and technical standards.
The role also provides an opportunity to mentor engineers and drive continuous improvements in quality engineering practices.
You will contribute to responsible AI adoption while helping deliver resilient technology for complex risk and decision-making environments.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead quality engineering and AI testing initiatives to ensure software solutions are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready across cloud-based platforms.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for Java-based backend services and REST APIs, supporting consistent quality across development and release cycles.
  • Own testing strategies for AI-powered features, including large language model output validation, regression baselines, tool-call accuracy, context management, and end-to-end integration testing.
  • Develop continuous integration evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI outputs using rubric-based scoring, automated prompt regression suites, and behavioral drift detection.
  • Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and machine learning engineers to establish testable requirements, review acceptance criteria, and maintain quality throughout agile delivery cycles.
  • Perform database validation against PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server to verify data integrity, transformation logic, and backend workflow accuracy.
  • Conduct AI-focused security testing, including prompt injection assessments, adversarial input validation, jailbreak testing, and sensitive data leakage checks.
  • Define and enforce synthetic or masked test-data standards for AI testing, ensuring confidential and regulated information is handled appropriately.
  • Monitor and report quality, performance, and AI observability metrics, including token consumption, streaming latency, tool-call success rates, model error rates, and reliability indicators.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish effective quality gates and deployment controls.
  • Conduct test-code reviews, mentor quality engineering team members, perform exploratory testing, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies.
  • Support performance and load testing for cloud-native SaaS platforms hosted on AWS and Microsoft Azure, validating scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Maintain comprehensive test documentation, traceability matrices, defect analysis reports, and quality metrics to provide transparency and alignment across stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • 5–7 years of experience in software quality engineering, with strong hands-on experience testing Java-based backend services and REST APIs.
    • Proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, RestAssured, or Cucumber for UI and API testing.
    • Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server, with experience performing data validation and integrity testing.
    • Hands-on experience testing AI features integrated with large language models, including output validation, semantic evaluation, hallucination detection, regression testing, and streaming API behavior.
    • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI testing patterns, including tool-use accuracy, context management, and validation of deterministic versus non-deterministic outputs.
    • Experience conducting AI security testing, including prompt injection, jailbreak validation, adversarial testing, sensitive data leakage assessments, and reliability or performance testing.
    • Strong understanding of software design principles, microservices architectures, and system-level test strategy development.
    • Demonstrated ability to identify complex edge cases and translate technical requirements into comprehensive quality strategies.
    • Strong understanding of AI technologies and experience applying AI tools to support innovation, operational efficiency, and responsible AI adoption.
    • Knowledge of AI risk management, governance, and responsible AI practices.
    • Experience working with cloud-based platforms, preferably AWS and Microsoft Azure.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, machine learning, and quality teams.
    • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to continuous improvement in testing standards and processes.
    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote opportunity based in India.
      • Opportunity to work on advanced AI, software quality, cloud, and automation initiatives.
      • Exposure to large language models, agentic AI, AI security, and responsible AI practices.
      • Opportunity to influence quality engineering strategy and establish modern testing standards.
      • Collaboration with product, software engineering, machine learning, and other technical teams.
      • Opportunity to mentor team members and contribute to the development of high-performing engineering practices.
      • Experience working with cloud-native SaaS platforms across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
      • Opportunity to contribute to technology that supports complex risk assessment, resilience, and informed decision-making.

title: CAD Administrator
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
  • Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
  • Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
  • Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
  • Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
  • Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
  • Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
  • Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
  • Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
  • Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Associate degree or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
  • CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
  • Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
  • Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
  • Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
  • Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
  • Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
  • Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance
US Salary Range
$140,000—$186,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

The successful incumbent will work with students and relevant University staff to translate these recommendations into an AccessAbility Plan that is appropriate for the student’s educational needs and operationally feasible within our campus context. Where the documentation is unclear or insufficient, the officer may seek further information from the student or the relevant practitioner, with the student’s consent. This is not a clinical, diagnostic or therapeutic role, and the Advisor does not make independent medical or clinical determinations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review documentation and recommendations provided by appropriately qualified practitioners and work with the student and relevant University staff to develop, implement and review an AccessAbility Plan.
  • Identify reasonable educational adjustments that respond to the documented impact on the student’s studies and are consistent with University policies, academic requirements and available resources.
  • Seek clarification or additional documentation where the information provided is unclear or insufficient to support a proposed adjustment.
  • Enhancing staff and student knowledge and capability to support students with a disability, injury, or health condition by increasing awareness of equity considerations and facilitating training, workshops, and educational initiatives on reasonable adjustments.
  • Continually improve service delivery through strategic policy development, service enhancement initiatives, and ongoing review of processes to ensure alignment with University policies and student needs.
  • Developing and maintaining consultative and collaborative working relationships with educators and those supporting student success across the University

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in occupational therapy, Psychology, Social Work, Education, Disability Studies, Counselling, or another closely related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of experience in accessibility services, education, student support or a comparable environment.
  • Experience supporting people with physical disabilities, chronic health conditions, mental health conditions, neurodiversity, sensory impairments, and learning difficulties.
  • Professional registration is not required as this is not a clinical, diagnostic or therapeutic role.
  • A postgraduate qualification in disability, rehabilitation, psychology, counselling, special/inclusive education or a related field would be advantageous.
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced work environment using high-level organisational, problem-solving, communication and administrative skills.
  • The internal title of the role would be AccessAbility Advisor
  • This role is Part Time fixed term contract position (Approximately 20 hours per week)

Storage and Quality Control

title: Police Officer
description:
JOB TITLE: Police Officer

DEPARTMENT: Meskwaki Nation Police Department (MNPD)

CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt

SUMMARY:

Responsible for law enforcement of all tribal laws and regulations including land and marine areas, which are under tribal jurisdiction. Collects evidence, interviews witnesses and testifies in court. Assists in all MNPD activities, ensuring that public order and safety is maintained throughout the Meskwaki community by enforcing laws and ordinances, taking all necessary measures to prevent crime and protect lives and property.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide law enforcement services to the tribal community, co-workers and public in a tactical, ethical, pleasant and courteous manner.
  • Patrol settlement community to control traffic, prevent crime and disturbances of the peace, and to arrest violators and wanted persons.
  • Respond to emergency and non-emergency calls and complaints involving fires, traffic situations, robberies, disturbances, public safety and other law enforcement issues, and provide appropriate law enforcement action(s).
  • Collect, secure, examine, process and analyze evidence.
  • Photograph and/or record video footage of crime scenes and evidence.
  • Collect and protect data, evidence and specimens.
  • Interview informants, suspects, and witnesses to ascertain alibis, clues, time frames and possible suspects, and follows-up on leads.
  • Ensure legal compliance by obtaining subpoenas, search warrants, arrest warrants, and obtaining signed statements and affidavits.
  • Record detailed progress of investigations and prepare investigative reports.
  • File paperwork, record detailed data and prepare investigative reports.
  • Prepare and serve search and arrest warrants.
  • Provide testimony as a witness in court.
  • Cooperate with tribal, local, state, and federal law enforcement officials in the investigation, apprehension and detention of wanted persons, and with other agencies where activities of the MNPD are involved, as directed or approved by the Narcotics and Taskforce Coordinator or the Chief of Police.
  • Attend conferences, conventions, seminars, meetings and trainings, as directed or approved by the Chief of Police.
  • Provide assistance to MNPD Police Officers, Investigators, Detectives and Dispatchers in crime scene situations, as needed or directed by the Chief of Police.
  • Participate on special task forces assigned by supervisory staff, which may include school resource officer duties, such as student, staff and community education and training.
  • Perform related duties and responsibilities, as outlined in the Meskwaki Nation Police Department Policies and Procedures Operations Manual.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Must have a High School Diploma or equivalent (GED).
  • Must have 20/20 vision or corrected 20/20 vision.
  • Must be currently Iowa Law Enforcement Academy (ILEA) certified as a Police Officer with no breaks in employment; OR must meet the Iowa Law Enforcement Academy requirements and be able to successfully complete the pre and post Iowa Law Enforcement Academy requirements and become a Certified Police Officer in the State of Iowa within one year of hire.
  • Must possess a thorough knowledge of police administration and management principles and practices, including optimum use of human and material resources.
  • Must possess a thorough knowledge and understanding of the MNPD Policies and Procedures.
  • Must possess a thorough knowledge and understanding of Tribal Sovereignty, and applicable local, state and federal laws, statutes and ordinances.
  • Must possess a thorough knowledge and understanding of the codes, laws, statutes and ordinances of the Sac & Fox Tribe of the Mississippi in Iowa.
  • Must have the ability to establish and maintain effective, respectful and professional working relationships with subordinates, co-workers, supervisor(s), officials, community members and the general public.
  • Must have the ability to analyze complex problems and determine valid, effective and efficient resolutions.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid Iowa State Driver's License, and be eligible for the Tribe's vehicle insurance. All license infractions/moving violations incurred during employment must be reported to the Human Resources Department immediately.
  • Must submit to and successfully pass an extensive criminal background investigation and receive Adjudication Certification. Mandated Regulations:
    1. Public Law 101-630-Indian Child protection and Family Violence Prevention Act-Character Investigations, as amended
    2. Public Law 101-647-Crime Control Act of 1990, Employee Background Checks
    3. Public Law 90-6148-Gun Control Act, as amended
    4. Code of Federal Regulations 25 part 12-Indian Country Law Enforcement
    5. Code of Federal Regulations 25 Part 63-Indian Child Protection and Family Violence Prevention
    6. Executive Order 12968 Adjudication Standards
  • Must maintain suitability for the position, as background checks and adjudication will be performed periodically. All civil judgements and criminal charges incurred during employment must be reported to the Human Resources Department immediately.
  • Must be bondable under the Tribe's Fidelity Bonding Policy during the course of employment with the Tribe.
  • Must be able and willing to talk, listen, sit, stand, walk, run, drive, kneel, crawl and reach with hands or arms.
  • Must be able to physically lift or move up to 50lbs.
  • Must be able and willing to work in indoor and outdoor conditions, including occasional exposure to wet & humid conditions, toxic & caustic chemicals and extreme heat & cold temperatures.
  • Must be able to perform duties in stressful, volatile situations.
  • Must be available for emergency law enforcement duties at any time.
  • Must establish residency within a thirty-minute emergency response time radius, within six months of hire date.
  • Must successfully complete a one-year probationary period.

SUPERVISION:

Supervised by the Chief of Police

SALARY:

  • Non-Certified Police Officer starting at $26.54 per hour
  • Iowa Certified Police Officer starting at $29.93 - $34.65per hour (depending on years of service)

title: Full Stack AI and Data Engineer - AWS
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack AI and Data Engineer - AWS based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build production-grade solutions across data engineering, artificial intelligence, and backend development on AWS. You will design scalable data pipelines, develop AI agents, and create robust APIs and microservices using a modern pro-code engineering approach. The position spans the full engineering lifecycle, from solution design and development through deployment and productionization. You will work extensively with Python, AWS data services, PySpark, and generative AI technologies. The role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex problems across multiple technical domains. You will also contribute to reusable enterprise AI capabilities, secure cloud architectures, and reliable production systems.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines that ingest information from REST APIs, databases, files, and other enterprise data sources, using Python, PySpark, AWS Glue, and appropriate AWS services for transformation and processing.
  • Build and orchestrate data workflows using AWS Step Functions and establish S3-based data layers for raw, processed, and curated datasets, while maintaining Athena and Glue Catalog layers for efficient querying and downstream consumption.
  • Design and develop Python-based backend services and REST APIs, creating modular microservices that can support AI agents, front-end applications, enterprise integrations, and third-party systems.
  • Implement robust backend capabilities including authentication, input validation, error handling, logging, monitoring, and reliable deployment using suitable AWS or cloud technologies.
  • Design and build AI agents using Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands, and related technologies, enabling agents to interact with enterprise data, APIs, backend services, and business applications.
  • Implement agent tools and function calling, workflows, context management, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation where appropriate, while integrating LLMs with enterprise applications and data sources.
  • Apply effective practices for prompt management, AI evaluation, security, observability, and cost optimization, while developing reusable agent frameworks and components that can support multiple enterprise AI use cases.
  • Develop clean, modular, reusable, and testable code while following Git, code review, CI/CD, configuration-driven development, security, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and access-control standards.
  • Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and cloud deployment practices, with Terraform experience particularly valued for provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of overall software or data engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on expertise across AWS, Python, modern data engineering, and AI or GenAI technologies.
    • Strong hands-on Python development skills and substantial AWS development experience, combined with practical experience building data pipelines and ETL processes.
    • Experience with PySpark and preferably AWS Glue, along with strong knowledge of S3 and Athena or equivalent cloud data-lake technologies.
    • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as AWS Step Functions and the ability to design reliable, scalable data-processing architectures.
    • Proven experience developing REST APIs and backend services, including integrations with enterprise systems and third-party APIs.
    • Hands-on experience developing LLM/GenAI applications or AI agents, with practical experience using Amazon Bedrock; exposure to AgentCore and/or Strands is highly desirable.
    • Strong understanding of software engineering practices, Git, CI/CD, clean-code principles, testing, deployment, security, and production operations.
    • Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, Docker and containerized deployments, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, AI evaluation, and observability is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, DynamoDB, React/Next.js, or front-end integration is a plus, as is experience integrating platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, or ServiceNow.
    • Knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent frameworks is beneficial, particularly for building enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions.
    • Strong candidates will demonstrate breadth across AWS, Python, Data Engineering, and GenAI/Agentic AI rather than deep expertise limited to only one technical area.
    • Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively across technical domains, and operate comfortably in a hands-on, fast-moving engineering environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Six-month contract opportunity focused on modern AI, data engineering, backend development, and AWS cloud technologies.
      • Fully remote position for candidates based in India.
      • Opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle, from architecture and development through deployment and productionization.
      • Hands-on exposure to AWS services including Glue, Step Functions, S3, Athena, Bedrock, and related cloud technologies.
      • Opportunity to build enterprise AI agents and reusable GenAI capabilities using modern agentic AI frameworks.
      • Cross-functional technical scope spanning Data Engineering, AI/LLM applications, backend APIs, microservices, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure.
      • Opportunity to work with modern engineering practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containerization, observability, and secure cloud deployment.

title: NX Developer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Engineering Systems and Tools team designs, builds, and maintains internal systems, applications, and infrastructure across the enterprise. We are looking for an NX Developer to join our team and develop customizations, automation, and administrative tooling for our Siemens NX CAD environment.

About the Role

Anduril's engineers design and build autonomous systems that protect those who serve. Behind every model, drawing, and assembly is the Siemens NX environment that makes rapid iteration possible. As an NX Developer on the Engineering Systems and Tools team, you'll be the person who makes that environment faster, smarter, and more reliable — building custom automation, tooling, and integrations that let our mechanical and electrical engineers focus on the work that matters instead of fighting their tools. You'll write real code (NXOpen API, Python, C++), own the full lifecycle of internal developer tools, and work directly with the engineers who depend on them. This isn't IT support - it's product development for an internal user base that's building things that actually matter.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain NX Open API customizations (NX Open C/C++, NX Open Python, NX Open .NET) to automate repetitive design tasks and enforce engineering standards
  • Build and manage NX CAD administrative tools including templates, part families, reuse libraries, and check-mate rules to ensure consistency across the engineering organization
  • Create custom NX dialogs, menus, and toolbars that streamline workflows for mechanical and electrical design teams
  • Develop journal-based automation scripts and NX Open applications to accelerate modeling, drafting, and BOM generation processes
  • Collaborate with PLM engineers to ensure seamless NX–Teamcenter integration in managed mode, including classification, naming rules, and revision workflows
  • Work with a high-functioning team of solution engineers and cross-functional teams with an emphasis on finishing business-critical projects
  • Help troubleshoot NX technical issues including those related to deployment, site configuration, custom toolkit distribution, and ongoing end-user support

Who You Are:
Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology startup that is rapidly scaling itself. Our culture is one of ambition, hard work, relentless pursuit of excellence, and deliberate disruption. The successful candidate will be one who demonstrates the follow core characteristics:

  • Outcome-Oriented - they determine what benefits the business needs and work backwards from those outcomes. The antiquated IT concept of “system availability” is abhorrent to the ideal candidate, they care about if the business actually got value from their product, not if it was just made to specification
  • Customer Focused - they display user empathy to boost engagement and build experiences that delight
  • Strong Product Sense - they know when in the product’s lifecycle to focus on optimizing the end user experience and when to focus on enterprise-level functionality
  • Dive Deep - they sweat the details and roll up their sleeves to uncover the root causes for systemic issues, be it technical shortfalls or lack of user comprehension of a product
  • Ownership - they care deeply not just about their products, but for all the business outcomes that their systems supports as well, holding themselves accountable for everything it both does and fails to do
  • Agility - they change directions easily and without regret, quickly adapting to shifting business priorities
  • First Principles Thinking - they approach problems and develop solutions not based on what a vendor recommends or because it’s how they did things at their last job, but from a deep appreciation of what is best for the enterprise
  • Exceptional strategic problem-solving capabilities - adept at navigating complex technical trade-offs

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a CAD development role, ideally in a fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environment
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical degree
  • Proficiency in NX Open API development using one or more of: C/C++, Python, Java, or .NET (C#/VB.NET)
  • Hands-on experience with NX CAD administration including templates, drafting standards, part families, reuse libraries, and role-based configurations
  • Experience creating and maintaining NX journaling scripts and custom automation toolkits
  • Strong understanding of CAD data management concepts including naming conventions, revision control, and BOM structures
  • Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints

Preferred QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Siemens Teamcenter integration in NX managed mode, including classification, workflows, and naming rules
  • Familiarity with NX Check-Mate for automated design validation and quality checks
  • Experience with NX deployment and site-level configuration (ugii_env, custom directories, toolkit distribution)
  • Knowledge of GRIP or KF (Knowledge Fusion) programming within NX
  • Experience integrating CAD tools with downstream systems (PLM, ERP, MES, etc.)
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve user issues, and work autonomously to solve problems
US Salary Range
$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.     • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com.
