description:
Raba Kistner, Inc. is a premier Engineering Consulting and Program Management firm. Our purpose is to build a better and more sustainable world for our employees, their families, our clients, and the communities we serve. Our Core Values are:

  • Community “We care for our communities”
  • Integrity “We act with integrity”
  • Passion “We infuse passion into everything we do”
  • Quality “We believe quality comes from a culture of innovation and continuous improvement”
  • Growth “We dedicate ourselves to personal and business growth”

Raba Kistner is seeking a detailed-oriented, dependable Technical Project Manager II - CoMET to join our team in Houston, TX. The Project Manager’s primary responsibility is to manage construction materials testing (CoMET) projects and solve construction related issues in a timely and accurate manner within the specified budget. This will include coordinating and participating in field observations; classification and characterization of construction materials’ physical properties; assignment of laboratory and field tests; interpretation of engineering data; performing engineering calculations, preparation of engineering reports, and peer review of field and test reports. Additional important responsibilities include the efficient and economical use of company resources in the analyses and solution of engineering problems; preparation of forensic, engineering and test reports; managing assigned personnel; and training and monitoring of construction materials technicians in the laboratory and field.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Serve as Project Manager, Construction Materials Engineering on CoMET projects including project management from the beginning to the end of the project.
  • Complete projects and reports in a timely and accurate manner within the specified budget.
  • Provide mentorship and professional development to other professional, technical, clerical and support staff members.
  • Perform CoMET consulting activities as required on company projects and working in unison with staff members in the designated office and other offices.
  • Coordinate materials testing activities with subcontractors and Raba Kistner’s field staff.
  • Prepare laboratory-testing assignments on projects in accordance with the testing program.
  • Analyze field data, laboratory test results, perform engineering calculations and provide required opinions/recommendations for completion of client reports.
  • Submit draft materials testing and engineering reports for review and final reports for co-signature of assigned staff members.
  • Perform field observation services in support of the CoMET activities, as well as for construction engineering investigations.
  • Assist the designated office in expanding the scope and technological level of excellence currently provided in our engineering, environmental and construction materials services.
  • Adhere to and support the Raba Kistner Safety program implementation and maintenance.
  • Participate in growth efforts by establishing and managing key client relationships and involving other technical staff in the division's growth.
  • Serve as “sales engineer/company representative” while working with clients and professional organizations.
  • Prepare proposals as assigned.
  • Actively participate in specific technical and/or professional organizations as directed.
  • Review and approve pre-bill invoices on CoMET projects and others as required.
  • Contact and follow up with Clients on invoicing and status of payment.
  • Within the first six-month period, achieve an average chargeability goal of not less than 65 percent.
  • Immediately notify Supervisor and Chief Operating Officer of all potential disputes that may lead to legal claims or litigation.
  • As requested, support Chief Operating Officer to settle disputes or defend against litigation.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year university required.
  • Must possess Professional Engineer’s (PE) license in the State of Texas. If the P.E. licenses is obtained from a different state, P.E. license should be obtained in the State of Texas within six months of hiring.
  • Must have three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in the CoMET industry with a range of experience in geotechnical services and one (1) to three (3) years of Project Management Experience.
  • Possess a competent understanding of construction plans and specifications, as well as good, accepted construction practices to be used in the review of assigned engineering reports and construction documents
  • Possess valid driver’s license in applicable jurisdiction and meet firm’s auto insurability requirements

Project Management skills to manage all aspects of small and large projects (proposal development, contract negotiations, and project execution). Possess knowledge of the testing procedures used in a geotechnical and construction materials testing laboratory (ASTM, TxDOT, AASTHO, USACE, etc.).

Ability to read and understand instructions, labels, reports, etc. Good oral and written communications skills and ability to work in teams at different levels within the organization. Intermediate in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst based in Brazil.

This is a senior cybersecurity role focused on determining the real-world risk posed by newly discovered vulnerabilities. You’ll provide the technical depth needed to validate exploitability, understand active exploitation, and translate complex findings into actionable intelligence for customers. The role combines vulnerability research, exploit validation, detection engineering, automation, and threat intelligence in a highly technical environment. You’ll design and maintain honeypots, isolated analysis environments, and tooling that help a specialized team assess vulnerabilities at scale. As a technical lead, you’ll establish standards for vulnerability assessment while mentoring junior analysts and expanding intelligence capabilities. The position is remote-friendly and offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals dedicated to staying ahead of evolving threats.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the technical direction of the vulnerability intelligence practice, establishing rigorous standards for vulnerability validation, assessment, and communication.

  • Research newly disclosed vulnerabilities and determine whether reported exploitation claims are technically valid and relevant to real-world environments.

  • Acquire, modify, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in controlled virtual environments to confirm or refute exploitability claims.

  • Design, build, and operate honeypots and sensor systems capable of monitoring real-world exploitation activity.

  • Develop practical mitigation strategies for situations where patching is delayed, unavailable, or insufficient, including configuration hardening, network segmentation, access controls, feature disabling, and other defensive measures.

  • Develop techniques for identifying both attempted and successful exploitation, including the artifacts and indicators defenders should monitor and hunt for.

  • Produce detailed vulnerability intelligence reports explaining how exploits work, who is using them, who is being targeted, and what actions defenders should take.

  • Build and maintain automation that streamlines vulnerability assessment, PoC testing, triage, intelligence collection, and analysis workflows.

  • Identify and evaluate new sources of vulnerability intelligence and integrate valuable sources into the intelligence lifecycle from ingestion through enrichment and delivery.

  • Train, mentor, and support junior team members, raising the technical capabilities and analytical standards of the wider team.

  • Contribute to continuous improvements in vulnerability research methodologies, tooling, detection approaches, and intelligence coverage.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level knowledge of vulnerability research and intelligence, with substantial experience analyzing and validating vulnerabilities in production or research environments.

    • Proven ability to validate and test proof-of-concept exploits and independently assess whether exploitation claims are technically credible.

    • Strong programming ability in at least one language such as Python, Go, C, C++, or a similar language, sufficient to understand exploit code, modify PoCs, and develop custom tooling.

    • Hands-on experience working with virtual machines, containers, and reusable laboratory environments for safe exploitation testing and technical analysis.

    • Strong computer science fundamentals and a thorough understanding of core computing and internet technologies, including TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication, authorization, and real-world system deployment.

    • Ability to develop mitigations beyond simply recommending patches and understand how defensive controls affect exploitation risk.

    • Experience developing methods to detect attempted and successful exploitation and translating technical findings into actionable defensive guidance.

    • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to produce clear and detailed vulnerability intelligence reports for security professionals.

    • A strong bias toward automation and demonstrated ability to build systems that make vulnerability assessment, triage, and analysis more efficient.

    • Experience mentoring or training less experienced security professionals and raising technical standards across a team.

    • Ability to identify new vulnerability intelligence sources and evaluate their reliability, relevance, and potential value.

    • Experience building honeypots or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity is highly desirable.

    • Experience automating proof-of-concept testing and validation is a strong advantage.

    • Experience integrating intelligence sources end-to-end, including evaluation, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and delivery.

    • Additional valuable experience includes original vulnerability research or CVE credits, reverse engineering, detection engineering with Sigma, Snort/Suricata, or YARA, SOC operations, and familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog.

    • Public speaking, conference participation, or published technical security writing is also advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation: Market-competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

      • Remote-friendly culture: Work remotely while collaborating with an experienced international cybersecurity team.

      • Wellness programs: Access programs designed to support employee health and wellbeing.

      • Professional development: A variety of opportunities to expand your technical knowledge, cybersecurity expertise, and career development.

      • Technical impact: Work directly on high-priority vulnerability intelligence challenges and help organizations better understand and defend against emerging threats.

      • Experienced environment: Collaborate with professionals with backgrounds spanning intelligence services, military, law enforcement, cybersecurity, and private-sector threat intelligence.

      • Collaborative culture: Join a supportive, fast-paced environment built around openness, inclusion, integrity, customer focus, and continuous learning.

      • Mission-driven work: Contribute to protecting organizations from evolving cyber threats through timely, technically rigorous intelligence.

      • International scope: Work on vulnerability and exploitation trends affecting organizations and threat actors across global markets.

**Job Title: Director, Program Scheduler**

**Job Code: 45313**

**Job Location: Palm Bay, FL OR Rochester, NY OR Remote**

**Job Schedule: 9/80 (Every other Friday off)**

**Job Description:**

Serve as the senior Program Planning & Scheduling functional leader for the Space Sector, providing technical direction, workforce leadership, and functional oversight across a large portfolio of programs and scheduling professionals. This role is the senior scheduling subject matter expert and advisor to Sector Program Management and business leadership on schedule strategy, execution, risk, forecasting, Earned Value Management (EVM), and integrated program performance. The position is responsible for driving consistent scheduling standards, practices, tools, analytical methods, and quality expectations across the Sector. It also strengthens integration between schedule, cost, EVM, technical performance, risk, supply chain, and resource information while supporting complex program activities including baselines, replans, proposals, recoveries, schedule risk assessments, and independent reviews. The role also leads development of the scheduling discipline through mentoring, workforce planning, succession planning, training, certification, and career development, while representing the Space Sector scheduling function in broader enterprise initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

• Provide senior technical and functional leadership for the Space Sector scheduling organization supporting multiple programs and scheduling teams

• Establish and reinforce Sector-wide scheduling standards, best practices, analytical methods, and schedule quality expectations

• Advise senior leadership on schedule performance, critical-path drivers, forecast credibility, EVM indicators, schedule risk, and recovery strategies

• Lead complex scheduling activities including baselines, replans, proposals, schedule risk assessments, independent reviews, and recovery planning

• Strengthen integration of schedule, EVM/cost, technical performance, risk, supply chain, and resource information

• Drive effective use of scheduling tools, enterprise analytics, and digital capabilities to improve schedule quality, visibility, and decision support

• Lead workforce planning for the scheduling function including staffing strategy, resource balancing, succession planning, capability development, and identification of critical skill gaps

• Provide functional leadership, mentoring, coaching, and technical development to Schedule Managers, senior schedulers, and emerging leaders

• Partner with Sector Program Management and program leadership to align scheduling capability with business priorities and program execution needs

• Identify systemic schedule-performance issues and trends across the Sector portfolio and lead corrective actions and process improvements

• Represent the Space Sector scheduling function in cross-Sector, Segment, and enterprise planning and scheduling initiatives

• Influence development of organizational policies, processes, standards, tools, and operating practices affecting Program Planning and Scheduling

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 15 years of prior related experience; Or, Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience; Or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 19 years of prior related experience

• 10 plus years of experience in Program Planning and Scheduling supporting large, complex programs or portfolios

• Advanced knowledge of Integrated Master Schedule development, maintenance, execution, critical-path analysis, forecasting, and schedule performance analysis

• Strong working knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVMS) and the integration of schedule, cost, technical performance, risk, and program execution data

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

• Experience leading complex scheduling activities such as baselines, replans, proposals, schedule recovery efforts, Schedule Risk Assessments, and integrated program reviews

• Experience leading a large planning and scheduling organization or providing functional leadership across multiple programs and scheduling teams

• Ability to assess schedule quality, identify systemic performance issues, and translate schedule information into actionable recommendations for senior leadership

• Experience developing workforce strategy, technical capability, standards, and organizational practices for a scheduling function

• Ability to work across Program Management, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and other functional organizations to drive integrated planning and execution

• Ability to influence senior leaders and establish alignment around scheduling standards, practices, priorities, and corrective actions

• Subject matter expertise in Program Planning, Scheduling, EVMS, and integrated program controls

• Experience providing functional oversight for a large portfolio of programs and scheduling professionals

• Experience establishing or improving scheduling standards, processes, metrics, tools, training, or governance across multiple programs

• Advanced experience with Microsoft Project and enterprise scheduling/data analytics tools

• Experience with schedule risk analysis, predictive schedule metrics, integrated cost/schedule analysis, and program recovery planning

• Experience developing scheduling talent through mentoring, competency development, succession planning, and career development

• Ability to identify trends across multiple programs and lead cross-program or enterprise-level improvement initiatives

• Experience briefing senior leaders and influencing decisions on matters of strategic importance to the scheduling function

• Experience building or sustaining a professional scheduling community through standards, lessons learned, peer reviews, training, and technical collaboration

The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont, and Virginia is $125,500-$233,500. title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Platform Engineer based in Germany.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on raising the standard for how software is built, tested, delivered, and operated.
You will shape the platform foundations that product teams and AI coding agents rely on to move quickly and reliably.
The role spans developer experience, CI/CD, infrastructure, automated testing, observability, security, and secure software delivery.
You will establish engineering standards, build reusable tooling and golden paths, and help teams adopt workflows that create measurable leverage.
A key focus will be AI harness engineering: designing development environments and engineering systems where AI agents can work effectively and safely.
You will operate as a builder and technical leader, staying close to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and the evolving needs of engineering teams.
This is an opportunity to have organization-wide impact while helping define how modern software teams collaborate with increasingly capable AI agents.

Accountabilities:

  • Shape the platform and infrastructure foundations that product teams build and operate their services on, balancing standardization with team autonomy.
  • Improve the complete engineering development loop, including local development, CI/CD, deployment processes, production feedback, and developer workflows.
  • Define and drive engineering standards for automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and secure software delivery, while helping product teams adopt them effectively.
  • Build shared tooling, templates, reusable components, and golden paths that reduce friction and provide practical leverage across the engineering organization.
  • Own secure delivery practices end to end by integrating security scanning, secrets management, dependency controls, software supply-chain protections, and penetration-testing workflows into core development and delivery pipelines.
  • Monitor and respond to the evolving security landscape, particularly as AI coding agents change how vulnerabilities are introduced, discovered, and potentially exploited.
  • Improve repositories, development conventions, tooling, documentation, test coverage, and feedback loops so AI coding agents can navigate codebases efficiently and produce reliable results.
  • Measure the effectiveness of platform initiatives through DORA metrics and qualitative feedback from engineering teams, using those insights to continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by setting direction while remaining deeply involved in code, infrastructure, automation, and pipeline implementation.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and operating production-grade systems.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and developing internal platforms, with strong judgment around what should be abstracted, exposed, standardized, or left flexible.
    • Deep expertise in CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, developer tooling, and modern software delivery practices.
    • Strong understanding of software security and secure delivery approaches, including shift-left security and SecDevOps principles.
    • Product-oriented mindset toward internal platforms, treating engineers and AI agents as users and measuring whether tooling genuinely improves their productivity.
    • Practical fluency with AI coding agents, including an understanding of how they operate, where they encounter friction, and how engineering environments can be designed to make them more effective.
    • Ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can define strategy while personally contributing to code, infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.
    • Strong systems thinking and the ability to identify organization-wide opportunities for standardization, automation, reliability, and developer productivity.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence product teams and drive adoption of shared engineering practices.
    • Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright and knowledge of how to scale automated testing environments is a strong plus.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment where established processes and playbooks may still be evolving.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to shape the future of software development and AI-assisted engineering.
      • High level of ownership with direct visibility into the impact of your technical decisions.
      • Individual-contributor-focused culture that values engineers who lead through execution and create momentum by building.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with highly experienced AI and software engineering professionals.
      • Global and flexible remote work environment, with an emphasis on results rather than location.
      • Equity participation designed to align individual success with the long-term growth of the organization.
      • Significant opportunity to influence platform strategy, engineering standards, security practices, and AI-enabled development workflows.
      • Inclusive environment committed to diversity and equal opportunity.

title: Costume Coordinator
description:
PROCTORS COLLABORTIVE

Title: After School Costume Coordinator

Department: Collaborative School of The Arts

Reports to: Assistant Director of School Programs

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Proctors is the Capital District’s leading regional arts organization with performing arts venues in Albany, Schenectady, and Saratoga, that frames education, civic engagement, and economic development initiatives throughout the region. The Collaborative School of the Arts is the education wing of the organization, offering a robust series of training programs, classes, and engagement programs in each venue, in schools and throughout the community.

Proctors is seeking is seeking an experienced Costume Coordinator to support the production of two after-school youth theatre training programs at Proctors and in Schenectady city middle schools. The Costume Coordinator supports Proctors Collaborative’s Acting Academy and TheatreTECH programs, providing costume sourcing, construction, fittings, and student instruction for four middle‑school productions. This role blends hands‑on costume work with youth mentorship, fostering a safe, inclusive, and engaging learning environment.

Responsibilities

  • Costume Sourcing — Pull from CSOA stock, rental houses, retail, thrift, or student wardrobes; adapt pieces under director supervision.
  • Fittings & Wardrobe — Oversee measurements, fittings, rehearsals, dress rehearsals, performances, and strike.
  • Student Instruction — Teach sewing (machine & hand), alterations, distressing, dyeing, wardrobe maintenance; makeup/wig skills a plus.
  • Program Support — Facilitate workshops, assist TheatreTECH students in building show costumes, maintain safe and compliant learning spaces.
  • Communication — Keep Program Manager informed of challenges, needs, and site updates.

Qualifications

  • Experience working with diverse youth populations.
  • Background in musical theatre, performance, or costume production.
  • Strong organizational, time‑management, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to collaborate, resolve conflicts, and meet deadlines.
  • Professional conduct and reliability.

Program Period: October 2026 – May 2027


Schedule: After‑school, typically 3:30–5:30 p.m.; final schedule subject to review with school partners.


Rate: $6,500. This is a Contracted position with no benefits.

title: Principal, Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Principal, Cloud Solutions Architect to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job Information

This role is responsible for hands-on development across the full cloud technology stack, strategic architecture decisions, and serving as the primary technical interface to client and U.S. FinTech leadership. Ensures delivery of scalable, secure securitization platforms while maintaining high engineering standards.

This role requires a strong technical and engineering foundation combined with technology governance expertise. The leader must be capable of engaging credibly with senior engineers, architects, cybersecurity professionals, data/AI functions, infrastructure/cloud teams, and application teams; understanding complex technology and related risks and controls; and translating business requirements into technical considerations.

  • Ensure application security, performance, uptime, and scale through sound cloud infrastructure engineering.
  • Evaluate complex technology issues spanning cloud infrastructure, resiliency, performance, vulnerability management, technology lifecycle, observability, automation and emerging technologies.
  • Apply engineering and systems-thinking principles to evaluate technology risks, controls, architecture decisions, operational practices, and remediation approaches, ensuring governance is technically sound, proportionate to risk, and practical within U.S. FinTech's operating environment.
  • Drive modernization of Technology Governance through automation, data analytics and AI, including opportunities to automate control evidence, compliance monitoring, technology-risk identification, management reporting and governance workflows.
  • Partner with Technology and Risk stakeholders to establish pragmatic governance approaches for emerging technologies, including AI, ensuring controls and oversight remain risk-based, scalable and appropriate to the underlying use case.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, fostering collaboration, alignment, and effective communication to support business priorities and successful delivery of initiatives.
  • Serve as external face of the engineering team to client organizations and U.S. FinTech leadership.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and operations teams.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience working in an AWS environment.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer H-1B sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Experience creating infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK/SAM preferred).
  • Experience in building web applications (React experience a plus).
  • Experience designing and building relational database transactional applications.
  • Experience in designing and integrating RESTful APIs (GraphQL a plus).

  • Experience with AWS serverless architecture and cloud infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with AI development tools (eg. Amazon Q Developer/Kiro) and AI services (eg. Amazon Bedrock).
  • Excellent debugging and optimization skills.
  • Experience in unit/integration testing.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop engineering talent.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Thorough understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment methodologies.

Pay Range $208,500 to $235,750

title: Systems Platform QA and AI engineer
description:

This role drives end-to-end quality engineering for enterprise storage platforms within a large-scale hybrid cloud environment.
You will work across complex hardware and software layers, including firmware, BIOS, BMC/iLO, operating systems, drivers, storage protocols, and platform software.
The position combines advanced test automation, systems troubleshooting, and AI/ML techniques to solve challenging engineering and quality problems.
You will design scalable Python-based frameworks and reusable tools that improve validation, observability, productivity, and test coverage.
The role requires strong systems thinking and the ability to investigate dependencies across multiple technology layers.
You will contribute to innovation, continuous learning, collaboration, and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
This is a full-time remote/teleworker opportunity based in Bengaluru, with meaningful scope to influence the reliability of enterprise technology.

Accountabilities:

  • Drive end-to-end quality engineering for enterprise storage platforms, validating interactions between hardware, firmware, BIOS, BMC/iLO, operating systems, kernels, device drivers, storage protocols, backend networks, and platform software.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and engineering tools, primarily using Python, to increase test coverage, validation effectiveness, debugging capabilities, and overall productivity.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across system layers and dependencies within large-scale enterprise storage environments, conducting root cause analysis and supporting timely resolution.
  • Apply AI and machine learning approaches to engineering and quality challenges, including failure analysis, test optimization, anomaly detection, workflow automation, generative AI, and AI-assisted testing.
  • Build reusable tools and utilities that improve engineering productivity, test effectiveness, system observability, and the ability to diagnose complex platform behaviors.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve customer issues, improve system reliability, and address quality challenges throughout the development and validation lifecycle.
  • Promote innovation, continuous learning, collaboration, mentoring, and knowledge sharing while contributing to improvements in engineering practices and quality processes.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical discipline.
    • 3–5 years of professional experience, with strong exposure to enterprise storage systems or comparable large-scale distributed systems.
    • Strong Python programming skills, including practical experience developing automation frameworks, tools, test systems, or engineering utilities.
    • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals, debugging methodologies, automation design, and system validation.
    • Good knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues within complex technical environments.
    • Demonstrated experience resolving customer issues, performing system-level debugging, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.
    • Strong understanding of enterprise storage environments and their hardware, firmware, driver, and platform software layers is highly desirable.
    • Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to engineering or quality challenges, including GenAI/LLMs, prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing, anomaly detection, or similar applications, is preferred.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a QA and systems-thinking mindset focused on reliability, scalability, edge cases, and root cause analysis.
    • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and work effectively with diverse engineering stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated interest and ability in mentoring, knowledge sharing, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.

      • Benefits

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer - Alti Team
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Alti Team based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale an AI agent product at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and customer-facing technology.
You will develop product features end to end, spanning conversational AI, intelligent agents, automated routines, and LLM-powered experiences.
The position combines hands-on product engineering with RAG, evaluation, observability, and machine learning in production.
You will work within a small, highly collaborative squad alongside engineering, product, and design professionals.
Your work will directly influence how customers use AI to solve real business problems and automate important workflows.
The environment is fast-paced and product-driven, with significant ownership across the delivery lifecycle and opportunities to shape technical practices as the product scales.
This is an exciting opportunity for a senior engineer who wants to build practical AI products and contribute to their evolution from early-stage growth to production scale.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and ship AI product features end to end, including conversational AI experiences, intelligent agents, and automated routines that deliver measurable value to customers.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt strategies.
  • Develop and maintain LLM evaluation pipelines to measure output quality, identify regressions, and continuously improve AI-powered experiences.
  • Establish monitoring and observability practices for AI features, including prompts, models, usage patterns, and system performance.
  • Support the transition of machine learning models into production environments, implementing monitoring and continuous feedback loops to improve their effectiveness over time.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to identify meaningful customer problems where AI and machine learning can provide practical and scalable solutions.
  • Contribute across multiple stages of the delivery lifecycle, taking ownership of technical decisions and helping strengthen engineering practices as the product and team grow.
  • Work collaboratively in a small squad environment, sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements

    • Solid professional experience as a software engineer building and successfully shipping customer-facing product features.
    • Hands-on experience developing AI products within the last 12 months, particularly involving LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered features.
    • Practical experience with at least one of the following: chatbots or conversational AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or LLM evaluation pipelines.
    • Strong programming skills in at least one of Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python.
    • A strong product mindset, with a focus on delivering useful experiences to end users rather than concentrating solely on model development.
    • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where engineers take ownership of multiple parts of the delivery and product lifecycle.
    • Professional working proficiency in English.
    • Experience with prompt engineering, AI monitoring and observability tools, autonomous or personal agents operating across channels such as Slack, Teams, or WhatsApp is highly desirable.
    • Experience taking machine learning models, including predictive models, into production with monitoring and feedback loops is an advantage.
    • Background in fintech, payments, or financial products is a plus.
    • Experience building and scaling ML or LLM-powered products is highly valued.
    • Previous experience in an early-stage startup environment, particularly from Seed through Series B, is considered a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary tailored to experience, skills, and expertise.
      • Total target compensation of $90,000–$105,000, plus equity.
      • Equity opportunities that allow employees to share in the organization’s growth and success.
      • Unlimited paid time off with flexibility when needed.
      • Annual learning and development stipend to support professional growth.
      • Fully remote position based in Brazil.
      • Opportunity to work on high-impact AI and fintech-related technology projects.
      • Collaborative, diverse, and supportive environment with significant ownership and opportunities for career growth.
      • Culture focused on transparency, resourcefulness, partnership, bold thinking, and accountability.

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer - Sell Side Engine
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer - Sell Side Engine based in Ireland.

This is a highly hands-on Staff Engineer role focused on solving complex technical problems within a rapidly scaling energy technology environment.
You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth.
The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed.
You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms.
A major focus will be turning manual and error-prone commercial processes into scalable, automated products that can support new business categories.
You will work with significant autonomy, operating within ambiguity and taking complex problems from definition through production delivery.
This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineer to directly influence critical market infrastructure while helping build the technology behind a more transparent and efficient energy ecosystem.

Accountabilities:

  • Own architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems, clearly defining system boundaries, contracts, dependencies, and failure modes.
  • Design and build the technical foundations connecting new-product initiatives with pricing, settlement, data, billing, and other core platforms.
  • Take commercially driven and sometimes ambiguous problems, define practical technical approaches, and turn them into shippable plans within the squad's strategic direction.
  • Help develop and launch new product categories, contributing to the technical work required to bring new offerings from concept through production and qualified commercial pipeline.
  • Automate and productise tendering, pricing, contracting, onboarding, and other manual workflows that currently limit scalability and create operational risk.
  • Design deal-gating and risk-management tooling that enables the business to safely support new categories of commercial risk.
  • Work effectively across organizational boundaries, delivering integrations and technical outcomes that depend on teams you do not directly manage.
  • Build high-quality software across backend services and, when appropriate, contribute to React and TypeScript frontend development.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, participate actively in code reviews, and contribute to stronger engineering practices and documentation.
  • Help measure and improve the reliability, scalability, and business impact of the systems you build.

    • Requirements:

    • Deep technical expertise in backend engineering and systems design, with a proven track record of making architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems.
    • Strong professional experience with Python and AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
    • Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems.
    • Full Stack or Backend Engineering experience in a startup, scale-up, or fast-paced product environment, with ownership of complex projects from inception through delivery.
    • Ability to work effectively without a complete specification, turning an ambiguous problem into a practical, well-scoped, and shippable technical plan.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering projects where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, requiring strong collaboration and influence without direct authority.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes and customer or business value.
    • Comfortable working hands-on across the stack, with React and TypeScript experience considered a plus rather than a core requirement.
    • Strong engineering judgment, attention to quality, and ability to reason about scalability, reliability, system boundaries, and failure modes.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across technical and organizational boundaries.
    • Experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction is desirable but not required.
    • Experience in energy, fintech, or another regulated or high-stakes commercial environment is advantageous.
    • Exposure to workflow orchestration, real-time pricing engines, or event-driven systems is a plus.
    • Experience creating new product lines or technical capabilities from scratch is highly desirable.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive base salary of £104,000, or the equivalent in local currency.
      • Compensation benchmarked against role and level, with pay adjustments based on demonstrated evidence rather than a fixed annual review cycle.
      • Stock options, providing employees with ownership in the long-term success of the business.
      • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the flexibility to exchange public holidays for alternative days that are more meaningful to you.
      • Additional day off for your birthday.
      • Fully remote and flexible working environment with clear core hours.
      • No internal meetings on Friday afternoons.
      • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually for home-working and remote setup expenses, including equipment and coworking passes.
      • Up to £150 / €150 per month for wellbeing expenses, which can be used for options such as therapy, gym memberships, or meditation apps.
      • Inclusive environment welcoming people from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

title: Senior Design Program Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Design Program Manager based in Canada.

This role drives operational excellence and strategic execution across a high-performing Design organization.
You will lead complex, multi-quarter initiatives while building scalable systems, processes, and tools that enable creative teams to work more effectively.
The position sits at the intersection of design, product, engineering, technical operations, and strategic program management.
You will leverage AI and automation to streamline workflows, improve visibility, and increase organizational efficiency.
The role also involves managing critical design tooling vendors, optimizing resources, and supporting design system governance and adoption.
You will partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
This is an opportunity to shape the operational infrastructure behind world-class digital experiences in a flexible, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Drive end-to-end execution of complex, high-visibility, multi-quarter design programs across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development, and other cross-functional teams, ensuring clear ownership, alignment, milestones, and predictable outcomes.
  • Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management activities such as status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communications while increasing operational efficiency across Design.
  • Manage strategic vendor relationships and contracts for design tooling, including platforms for design, prototyping, asset management, and collaboration, while negotiating agreements, optimizing licensing costs, and ensuring infrastructure can scale with organizational growth.
  • Manage contractor and agency relationships and collaborate with Finance, Legal, and IT to support compliance, procurement, cost efficiency, and effective resource utilization.
  • Lead capacity planning, roadmapping, resource allocation, operational metrics, and tooling integrations that create streamlined workflows and improve team health and visibility.
  • Partner with design systems teams to align programs with system evolution, component adoption, governance, and scalable implementation across product teams.
  • Translate design strategy and leadership priorities into actionable programs, roadmaps, operating models, milestone reviews, and measurable outcomes.
  • Apply design thinking and product sense to operational challenges, creating systems that balance creative flexibility, consistency, scalability, user needs, and business impact.
  • Act as a strategic cross-functional partner, facilitating planning cycles, resolving complexity, and maintaining alignment between design initiatives and broader product and business roadmaps.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in program management and/or design operations within design or product organizations, with demonstrated success driving operational excellence and supporting high-performing teams.
    • Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with the ability to understand design workflows and translate creative and product strategies into effective programs and operating models.
    • Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, including successfully launching products or experiences end-to-end.
    • Technical fluency sufficient to collaborate effectively with design systems and engineering teams, including an understanding of system architecture, component APIs, design-to-code workflows, and technical constraints.
    • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional programs from 0→1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments.
    • Practical experience using AI tools, LLMs, automation platforms, or similar technologies to improve efficiency and scale program management or creative operations.
    • Strong vendor and contract management experience, including software negotiations, relationship management, licensing optimization, compliance, and cost control.
    • Deep familiarity with design and program management ecosystems such as Figma, Linear, Jira, Dovetail, asset management platforms, and prototyping tools.
    • Strong organizational change and influencing skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex situations and align stakeholders around shared outcomes.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including confidence presenting to senior and executive leadership.
    • Experience with design systems, component libraries, design tokens, documentation, governance, and adoption programs is highly valuable.
    • Experience building AI-powered workflows, translating leadership vision into actionable roadmaps, working within embedded or hybrid team models, and using data and storytelling to secure leadership buy-in is considered an advantage.
    • Ability to balance hands-on execution with strategic oversight while managing competing priorities in an evolving environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive base salary of $185,000–$195,000 CAD for Canadian-based candidates.
      • Eligibility for a new-hire equity grant.
      • Eligibility for annual equity refresh grants.
      • Flexible remote-first working arrangement.
      • Flexibility to work from home, an office, or another suitable location while participating in regular in-person team events.
      • Market-competitive benefits designed for employees across eligible Canadian locations.
      • Opportunity to work on high-impact design, product, AI, and operational programs at significant scale.
      • Collaborative environment with strong cross-functional exposure and opportunities to influence organizational strategy and ways of working.
      • Opportunity to develop and apply expertise in AI-enabled operations, design systems, program management, and technical tooling.

company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.
